001.title: Travelling with your best friend
001.transcriptNote: A conversation between two teachers, 素清 Sù Qīng and 贝拉 Bèilā (from Taiwan). Fillers like 嗯 and 呃 are mostly left out of the text.

lines: 大家好！欢迎来到Lazy Chinese的播客。
Dàjiā hǎo! Huānyíng láidào ⁢Lazy⁢ ⁢Chinese⁢ de bōkè.
Hello everyone! Welcome to the Lazy Chinese podcast.
今天是我素清和……好。
Jīntiān shì wǒ Sù Qīng hé…… Hǎo.
Today it's me, Su Qing, and… OK.
贝拉老师最近去旅游很长时间，对不对？嗯，差不多。
Bèilā lǎoshī zuìjìn qù lǚyóu hěn chángshíjiān, duì bù duì? Èn, chàbuduō.
Teacher Bella has just been travelling for a long time, right? Yes, more or less.
本来打算两个月，但是后来变成四个月。哦，四个月，很长很长的时间。
Běnlái dǎsuàn liǎnggè yuè, dànshì hòulái biànchéng sìgè yuè. O, sìgè yuè, hěncháng hěncháng de shíjiān.
I'd planned two months, but it turned into four. Oh, four months, that's a really long time.
对，所以我觉得我们可以今天聊一聊旅行。
Duì, suǒyǐ wǒ juéde wǒmen kěyǐ jīntiān liáoyīliáo lǚxíng.
Right, so I thought today we could talk about travel.
贝拉，我看你常常一个人旅行，对不对？
Bèilā, wǒ kàn nǐ chángcháng yíge rén lǚxíng, duì bù duì?
Bella, I see you often travel alone, right?
你有和好朋友一起旅行过吗？
Nǐ yǒu hé hǎo péngyou yìqǐ lǚxíng guo ma?
Have you ever travelled with a good friend?
有，这次我有和一个好朋友一起旅行。
Yǒu, zhècì wǒ yǒu hé yíge hǎo péngyou yìqǐ lǚxíng.
Yes, this time I travelled with a good friend.
哦，好的。那我们今天来聊一聊和好朋友一起旅行。
O, hǎo de. Nà wǒmen jīntiān láiliáo yīliáo hé hǎo péngyou yìqǐ lǚxíng.
Oh, OK. Then today let's talk about travelling with a good friend.
是什么体验，什么感觉，是好还是不好？
Shì shénme tǐyàn, shénme gǎnjué, shì hǎo háishi bùhǎo?
What it's like, how it feels, whether it's good or not?
OK，没问题。
⁢OK⁢, méi wèntí.
OK, no problem.
blocks.h: 开场 · Hello and today's topic

lines: 好，那贝拉，你的好朋友是台湾人吗？
Hǎo, nà Bèilā, nǐ de hǎo péngyou shì táiwānrén ma?
OK, so Bella, is your good friend Taiwanese?
他不是台湾人，他是越南人。哦，他是越南人。
Tā búshi táiwānrén, tā shì yuènánrén. O, tā shì yuènánrén.
She's not Taiwanese, she's Vietnamese. Oh, she's Vietnamese.
可是他不住在越南，他住在德国。哦，他住在德国。
Kěshì tā búzhù zài yuènán, tā zhù zài déguó. O, tā zhù zài déguó.
But she doesn't live in Vietnam, she lives in Germany. Oh, she lives in Germany.
好。对，为什么你们是好朋友？
Hǎo. Duì, wèishénme nǐmen shì hǎo péngyou?
OK. So why are you good friends?
差不多八年以前，那个时候我刚到澳大利亚。
Chàbuduō bānián yǐqián, nàge shíhou wǒgāng dào Àodàlìyà.
About eight years ago, when I had just arrived in Australia.
他是我在澳大利亚的室友。
Tā shì wǒ zài Àodàlìyà de shìyǒu.
She was my roommate in Australia.
我们一起住。哦，明白明白。哇，我觉得你可以和一起住的人、和室友变成好朋友，我觉得很厉害。
Wǒmen yìqǐ zhù. O, míngbai míngbai. Wa, wǒ juéde nǐ kěyǐ hé yìqǐ zhù de rén, hé shìyǒu biànchéng hǎo péngyou, wǒ juéde hěn lìhai.
We lived together. Oh, I see. Wow, I think it's impressive that you can become good friends with someone you live with, a roommate.
对，我也觉得很厉害，很厉害。
Duì, wǒ yě juéde hěn lìhai, hěn lìhai.
Yes, I think it's impressive too.
因为一起住，你常常可以看到很多你不喜欢的东西，对吧？
Yīnwèi yìqǐ zhù, nǐ chángcháng kěyǐ kàndào hěnduō nǐ bù xǐhuan de dōngxi, duì ba?
Because when you live together you often see lots of things you don't like, right?
没错没错。好的。
Méicuò méicuò. Hǎo de.
Exactly. OK.
那为什么你会一起旅行？
Nà wèishénme nǐ huì yìqǐ lǚxíng?
So why did you travel together?
在澳大利亚的时候，我们已经常常一起旅行。
Zài Àodàlìyà de shíhou, wǒmen yǐjīng chángcháng yìqǐ lǚxíng.
In Australia we already often travelled together.
跟他旅行的时候，我觉得我们喜欢的东西一样，我们都是很放松的人。
Gēn tā lǚxíng de shíhou, wǒ juéde wǒmen xǐhuan de dōngxi yīyàng, wǒmen dōu shì hěn fàngsōng de rén.
When I travel with her, I feel we like the same things; we're both very relaxed people.
我们都不喜欢去很多地方。
Wǒmen dōu bù xǐhuan qù hěnduō dìfang.
Neither of us likes going to lots of places.
所以我觉得这个朋友适合跟我一起旅行。明白明白。
Suǒyǐ wǒ juéde zhège péngyou shìhé gēn wǒ yìqǐ lǚxíng. Míngbai míngbai.
So I felt this friend was right for travelling with me. I see.
blocks.h: 贝拉的朋友 · Bella's friend

lines: 好的。那你和这个朋友一起旅行的时候，有没有不开心或者生气的时候？
Hǎo de. Nà nǐ hé zhège péngyou yìqǐ lǚxíng de shíhou, yǒuméiyǒu bù kāixīn huòzhě shēngqì de shíhou?
OK. So when you travelled with this friend, were there times you were unhappy or angry?
好，我的这个朋友呢，他很喜欢吃东西。
Hǎo, wǒ de zhège péngyou ne, tā hěn xǐhuan chī dōngxi.
OK, this friend of mine really loves eating.
他来一个地方旅行，吃东西是最重要的。我懂他，我同意，但是对我来说……
Tā lái yíge dìfang lǚxíng, chī dōngxi shì zuì zhòngyào de. Wǒ dǒng tā, wǒ tóngyì, dànshì duì wǒ láishuō……
When she travels somewhere, eating is the most important thing. I get her, I agree, but for me…
我不想花很多钱去吃很贵的餐厅。明白。
Wǒ bùxiǎng huā hěnduō qián qù chī hěn guì de cāntīng. Míngbai.
I don't want to spend lots of money eating at expensive restaurants. I see.
这次旅行，我们去了一家餐厅。
Zhècì lǚxíng, wǒmen qù le yìjiā cāntīng.
On this trip we went to a restaurant.
这家餐厅在我们的饭店附近。那天他说：
Zhèjiā cāntīng zài wǒmen de fàndiàn fùjìn. Nàtiān tā shuō:
This restaurant was near our hotel. That day she said:
“贝拉，我找到这间餐厅，在我们的饭店附近，走路五分钟，我看他们的菜好像很好吃。”
"Bèilā, wǒ zhǎodào zhè jiān cāntīng, zài wǒmen de fàndiàn fùjìn, zǒulù wǔfēnzhōng, wǒ kàn tāmen de cài hǎoxiàng hěn hǎochī."
"Bella, I found this restaurant near our hotel, five minutes' walk; their food looks delicious."
我说：“OK，我没有意见，我们可以一起去。”
Wǒ shuō: "⁢OK⁢, wǒ méiyǒu yìjiàn, wǒmen kěyǐ yìqǐ qù."
I said: "OK, I don't mind, we can go together."
但是我告诉他，我没有很饿，所以我只想吃小小的东西。
Dànshì wǒ gàosu tā, wǒ méiyǒu hěn è, suǒyǐ wǒ zhǐ xiǎng chī xiǎoxiǎode dōngxi.
But I told her I wasn't very hungry, so I only wanted something small.
他说：“没问题，没问题。”所以到了那个饭店以后……
Tā shuō: "méi wèntí, méi wèntí."suǒyǐ dào le nàge fàndiàn yǐhòu……
She said: "No problem, no problem." So after we got to that restaurant…
我说：“等一下，贝拉，等一下。在中国大陆呢，饭店是吃饭的地方，但是在台湾，饭店是什么？”
Wǒ shuō: "děng yīxià, Bèilā, děng yīxià. Zài zhōngguó dàlù ne, fàndiàn shì chīfàn de dìfang, dànshì zài táiwān, fàndiàn shì shénme?"
I said: "Wait, Bella, wait. In mainland China a 饭店 is a place to eat, but in Taiwan what is a 饭店?"
是住的地方？
Shì zhù de dìfang?
It's a place to stay?
对。所以贝拉说，我去了一个餐厅。
Duì. Suǒyǐ Bèilā shuō, wǒ qù le yíge cāntīng.
Right. So Bella is saying she went to a restaurant.
对，然后这个餐厅在我的饭店旁边，对吧？
Duì, ránhòu zhège cāntīng zài wǒ de fàndiàn pángbiān, duì ba?
Right, and this restaurant was next to my hotel, right?
对对对，不是不是，我去了吃饭的地方，吃饭的地方。
Duì duì duì, búshi búshi, wǒ qù le chīfàn de dìfang, chīfàn de dìfang.
Yes, yes — no, no, I went to a place to eat, a place to eat.
对，到了吃饭的地方，我看……
Duì, dào le chīfàn de dìfang, wǒ kàn……
Right, when we got to the place to eat, I looked…
“哇，这个餐厅看起来很贵，应该不便宜。”
"wa, zhège cāntīng kànqǐlai hěn guì, yīnggāi bù piányi."
"Wow, this restaurant looks expensive, it can't be cheap."
可是我的朋友说：“不是不是，这个餐厅不是很贵。”
Kěshì wǒ de péngyou shuō: "búshi búshi, zhège cāntīng búshi hěn guì."
But my friend said: "No, no, this restaurant isn't very expensive."
所以我觉得OK，没关系，那我们就吃饭吧。
Suǒyǐ wǒ juéde ⁢OK⁢, méiguānxi, nà wǒmen jiù chīfàn ba.
So I thought, OK, fine, let's eat then.
因为我的朋友他想吃。坐下以后呢……
Yīnwèi wǒ de péngyou tā xiǎng chī. Zuòxia yǐhòu ne……
Because my friend wanted to eat. After we sat down…
因为通常吃饭，我的朋友他会点他想吃的东西。
Yīnwèi tōngcháng chīfàn, wǒ de péngyou tāhuìdiǎn tā xiǎng chī de dōngxi.
Because usually when we eat, my friend orders what she wants to eat.
对我来说，因为到了一个新的地方，我什么都没吃过，所以我都愿意试试看。
Duì wǒ láishuō, yīnwèi dào le yíge xīn de dìfang, wǒ shénme dōu méichīguò, suǒyǐ wǒ dōu yuànyì shìshìkàn.
For me, since it's a new place and I haven't tried anything, I'm happy to try anything.
所以他说：“那我们点一个海鲜汤，点一个这个，点一个这个，我觉得这样子应该够了。”
Suǒyǐ tā shuō: "nà wǒmen diǎn yíge hǎixiān tāng, diǎn yíge zhège, diǎn yíge zhège, wǒ juéde zhè yàngzi yīnggāi gòu le."
So she said: "Let's order a seafood soup, one of these and one of these; I think that should be enough."
但是我们去旅行的那个地方，他给我们的菜单不是台币，也不是美金，是那个地方的钱。
Dànshì wǒmen qù lǚxíng de nàge dìfang, tā gěi wǒmen de càidān búshi táibì, yě búshi měijīn, shì nàge dìfang de qián.
But where we were travelling, the menu wasn't in Taiwan dollars or US dollars; it was in the local money.
你等一下，你们在什么地方旅行？
Nǐ děng yīxià, nǐmen zài shénme dìfang lǚxíng?
Wait, where were you travelling?
我在秘鲁。
Wǒ zài Bìlǔ.
I was in Peru.
对，我们说“秘鲁”。秘鲁，对对对，我们在Peru这个地方旅行。
Duì, wǒmen shuō "Bìlǔ". Bìlǔ, duì duì duì, wǒmen zài ⁢Peru⁢ zhège dìfang lǚxíng.
Right, we say 秘鲁. Peru, yes, we were travelling in Peru.
所以他们那个地方的钱不是美金，也不是台币，也不是我们知道的钱。
Suǒyǐ tāmen nàge dìfang de qián búshi měijīn, yě búshi táibì, yě búshi wǒmen zhīdào de qián.
So the money there wasn't US dollars or Taiwan dollars, or any money we knew.
所以你看菜单的时候，你真的不知道这是贵还是便宜。
Suǒyǐ nǐ kàn càidān de shíhou, nǐ zhēnde bù zhīdào zhè shì guì háishi piányi.
So when you look at the menu, you really don't know if it's expensive or cheap.
所以呢我们点了菜。我的朋友说：“我们点这个海鲜汤。”然后我说：“你想吃什么就点吧。”
Suǒyǐ ne wǒmen diǎn le cài. Wǒ de péngyou shuō: "wǒmen diǎn zhège hǎixiān tāng."ránhòu wǒ shuō: "nǐ xiǎng chī shénme jiù diǎn ba."
So we ordered. My friend said: "Let's get this seafood soup." And I said: "Order whatever you want."
我没有意见，我没有问题。
Wǒ méiyǒu yìjiàn, wǒ méiyǒu wèntí.
I don't mind, it's fine with me.
好，所以我们吃吃吃，然后……
Hǎo, suǒyǐ wǒmen chī chī chī, ránhòu……
OK, so we ate and ate, and then…
因为我旅行的时候，我还工作。
Yīnwèi wǒ lǚxíng de shíhou, wǒ hái gōngzuò.
Because I still work while I travel.
所以我告诉我的朋友，我可能一个小时以后需要回去饭店工作。
Suǒyǐ wǒ gàosu wǒ de péngyou, wǒ kěnéng yíge xiǎoshí yǐhòu xūyào huíqu fàndiàn gōngzuò.
So I told my friend I'd probably need to go back to the hotel to work in an hour.
然后他说：“没有问题，这个餐厅他们很快就会给我们食物，不用担心。”
Ránhòu tā shuō: "méiyǒu wèntí, zhège cāntīng tāmen hěnkuài jiù huì gěi wǒmen shíwù, búyòng dānxīn."
And she said: "No problem, this restaurant will bring us the food quickly, don't worry."
我们等了三四十分钟，菜还没有来。
Wǒmen děng le sān sìshífēnzhōng, cài hái méiyǒu lái.
We waited thirty or forty minutes and the food still hadn't come.
我开始有一点紧张。我说：“我需要快点回去上课，还是你吃，然后你把食物带回来给我吃？”然后他说：“不用担心，不用担心，很快来。”
Wǒ kāishǐ yǒu yìdiǎn jǐnzhāng. Wǒ shuō: "wǒ xūyào kuàidiǎn huíqu shàngkè, háishi nǐ chī, ránhòu nǐ bǎ shíwù dài huílai gěi wǒ chī?"ránhòu tā shuō: "búyòng dānxīn, búyòng dānxīn, hěnkuài lái."
I started to get a bit nervous. I said: "I need to hurry back for my class — or you eat, and bring the food back for me?" And she said: "Don't worry, don't worry, it's coming soon."
所以菜来了。
Suǒyǐ càilái le.
Then the food came.
然后我只剩二十分钟可以快点吃饭。
Ránhòu wǒ zhǐ shèng èrshífēnzhōng kěyǐ kuàidiǎn chīfàn.
And I only had twenty minutes left to eat quickly.
所以我已经有一点点不开心。
Suǒyǐ wǒ yǐjīng yǒu yìdiǎndiǎn bù kāixīn.
So I was already a little unhappy.
因为在出门以前，我已经告诉他我需要工作。
Yīnwèi zài chūmén yǐqián, wǒ yǐjīng gàosu tā wǒ xūyào gōngzuò.
Because before we went out I had already told her I needed to work.
但是我觉得也不是他的问题，因为他想吃。
Dànshì wǒ juéde yě búshi tā de wèntí, yīnwèi tā xiǎng chī.
But I felt it wasn't her fault either, because she wanted to eat.
所以我吃吃吃，然后呢，我要付钱的时候，我们看了一下账单。
Suǒyǐ wǒ chī chī chī, ránhòu ne, wǒyào fùqián de shíhou, wǒmen kàn le yīxià zhàngdān.
So I ate and ate, and then when I went to pay, we looked at the bill.
非常非常的贵。
Fēicháng fēicháng de guì.
It was very, very expensive.
那个海鲜汤，有几只虾子。
Nàge hǎixiān tāng, yǒu jǐzhī xiāzi.
That seafood soup had a few prawns in it.
老师，你可以猜猜看多少钱。
Lǎoshī, nǐ kěyǐ cāicāikàn duōshǎoqián.
Teacher, can you guess how much it was?
我不知道秘鲁这个国家的东西贵不贵，但是你说非常非常贵。
Wǒ bù zhīdào Bìlǔ zhège guójiā de dōngxi guìbùguì, dànshì nǐ shuō fēicháng fēicháng guì.
I don't know if things are expensive in Peru, but you said it was very, very expensive.
好，我猜一猜。可能非常非常贵是多少呢？可能……
Hǎo, wǒ cāi yī cāi. Kěnéng fēicháng fēicháng guìshì duōshao ne? Kěnéng……
OK, let me guess. How much is "very, very expensive"? Maybe…
四十美金差不多一碗汤。四十美金。
Sìshí měijīn chàbuduō yīwǎn tāng. Sìshí měijīn.
About forty US dollars for a bowl of soup. Forty dollars.
我告诉大家，在我们旅行的那个地方……
Wǒ gàosu dàjiā, zài wǒmen lǚxíng de nàge dìfang……
Let me tell you all: where we were travelling…
大部分我们去餐厅吃饭……
Dàbùfen wǒmen qù cāntīng chīfàn……
most of the time when we ate at a restaurant…
差不多两个人一共二十美金，所以一个人差不多应该是十美金。
Chàbuduō liǎnggè rén yīgòng èrshí měijīn, suǒyǐ yíge rén chàbuduō yīnggāi shì shí měijīn.
it came to about twenty dollars for two people, so about ten dollars each.
对，但是这个汤要四十美金。没错。然后我觉得太贵了。
Duì, dànshì zhège tāngyào sìshí měijīn. Méicuò. Ránhòu wǒ juéde tàiguì le.
Right, but this soup cost forty dollars. Exactly. And I thought it was too expensive.
然后我也觉得我吃得没有很开心，因为我二十分钟以后要上课，我需要吃得很快，我完全没有享受这个晚餐。
Ránhòu wǒ yě juéde wǒ chī de méiyǒu hěn kāixīn, yīnwèi wǒ èrshífēnzhōng yǐhòu yào shàngkè, wǒ xūyào chī de hěnkuài, wǒ wánquán méiyǒu xiǎngshòu zhège wǎncān.
And I didn't enjoy eating either, because I had a class in twenty minutes and had to eat fast; I didn't enjoy that dinner at all.
最后我告诉我的朋友：“对不起，我需要先回去饭店工作，你可以慢慢来，没关系。”
Zuìhòu wǒ gàosu wǒ de péngyou: "duìbuqǐ, wǒ xūyào xiānhuíqù fàndiàn gōngzuò, nǐ kěyǐ mànmànlái, méiguānxi."
In the end I told my friend: "Sorry, I need to go back to the hotel to work first; take your time, it's fine."
然后我就很快地想要离开这个饭店。
Ránhòu wǒ jiù hěnkuài dì xiǎngyào líkāi zhège fàndiàn.
And then I wanted to leave the restaurant quickly.
在饭店的门口，因为我走太快了，所以我摔了一跤。你摔倒了！然后我摔倒了。
Zài fàndiàn de ménkǒu, yīnwèi wǒ zǒu tàikuài le, suǒyǐ wǒ shuāileyījiāo. Nǐ shuāidǎo le! Ránhòu wǒ shuāidǎo le.
At the restaurant door, because I was walking too fast, I fell over. You fell! Yes, I fell.
全部的人都说：“小姐，你还好吗？”
Quánbù de rén dōu shuō: "xiǎojie, nǐ háihǎo ma?"
Everyone said: "Miss, are you OK?"
那个时候我的心里是想：为什么我要付这么贵的晚餐，还要在大家面前摔倒？
Nàge shíhou wǒ de xīnli shì xiǎng: wèishénme wǒ yàofù zhème guì de wǎncān, háiyào zài dàjiā miànqián shuāidǎo?
At that moment I was thinking: why did I have to pay for such an expensive dinner and then fall over in front of everyone?
然后我还对我的朋友那么不开心。
Ránhòu wǒ hái duì wǒ de péngyou nàme bù kāixīn.
And on top of that I was so unhappy with my friend.
我为什么要在这里？明白明白。
Wǒ wèishénme yào zài zhèlǐ? Míngbai míngbai.
Why am I even here? I see.

lines: 那你们因为这个东西有没有吵架？
Nà nǐmen yīnwèi zhège dōngxi yǒuméiyǒu chǎojià?
So did you two fight because of this?
我觉得我的朋友自己也觉得很怪。
Wǒ juéde wǒ de péngyou zìjǐ yě juéde hěnguài.
I think my friend felt it was strange herself.
所以他知道他没有看清楚，因为我离开前我告诉他，我只想吃小的东西，我不想要去很贵的餐厅。
Suǒyǐ tā zhīdào tā méiyǒu kànqīngchǔ, yīnwèi wǒ líkāi qián wǒ gàosu tā, wǒ zhǐ xiǎng chī xiǎo de dōngxi, wǒ bù xiǎngyào qù hěn guì de cāntīng.
So she knew she hadn't looked carefully, because before we left I told her I only wanted something small and didn't want to go to an expensive restaurant.
所以他自己知道他自己没有看清楚这个餐厅是贵还是便宜。
Suǒyǐ tā zìjǐ zhīdào tā zìjǐ méiyǒu kànqīngchǔ zhège cāntīng shì guì háishi piányi.
So she knew she hadn't checked carefully whether the restaurant was expensive or cheap.
所以他回来以后，他也开玩笑：“哇，刚才那一餐很贵哎！”
Suǒyǐ tā huílai yǐhòu, tā yě kāiwánxiào: "wa, gāngcái nà yīcān hěnguì āi!"
So when she came back she joked about it too: "Wow, that meal was expensive!"
所以我觉得他没有很生气地跟我吵架。
Suǒyǐ wǒ juéde tā méiyǒu hěn shēngqì dì gēn wǒ chǎojià.
So I don't think she was angry or fought with me.
所以我觉得算了，旅行有时候你不知道吃饭会吃很贵的餐厅还是很便宜的餐厅。
Suǒyǐ wǒ juéde suànle, lǚxíng yǒushíhou nǐ bù zhīdào chīfàn huì chī hěn guì de cāntīng háishi hěn piányi de cāntīng.
So I thought, never mind; when you travel you sometimes don't know if you'll end up eating somewhere expensive or cheap.
所以我觉得不是一个很大的问题。
Suǒyǐ wǒ juéde búshi yíge hěndà de wèntí.
So I don't think it was a big problem.
所以我就觉得没事。
Suǒyǐ wǒ jiù juéde méishì.
So I felt it was fine.
明白明白。因为我觉得如果你的朋友说我们去这个餐厅，然后你说我不要去很贵的餐厅，你的朋友他不知道，所以是没有办法。
Míngbai míngbai. Yīnwèi wǒ juéde rúguǒ nǐ de péngyou shuō wǒmen qù zhège cāntīng, ránhòu nǐ shuō wǒ búyào qù hěn guì de cāntīng, nǐ de péngyou tā bù zhīdào, suǒyǐ shì méiyǒu bànfǎ.
I see. Because if your friend says let's go to this restaurant and you say you don't want an expensive one, but your friend doesn't know, then there's nothing you can do.
有的时候你在一个新的地方……
Yǒu de shíhou nǐ zài yíge xīn de dìfang……
Sometimes when you're in a new place…
我记得我在巴厘岛的时候，因为巴厘岛的那个钱很大很大，对吧？
Wǒ jìde wǒ zài Bālí Dǎo de shíhou, yīnwèi Bālí Dǎo de nàge qián hěndà hěndà, duì ba?
I remember when I was in Bali — the money in Bali has really big numbers, right?
对对，一样的问题，也有这个问题。
Duì duì, yīyàng de wèntí, yě yǒu zhège wèntí.
Yes, the same problem, it has this problem too.
然后我在巴厘岛的超市买了一包薯片。
Ránhòu wǒ zài Bālí Dǎo de chāoshì mǎi le yībāo shǔpiàn.
And I bought a bag of crisps in a supermarket in Bali.
然后我觉得：“我想试一试这里的薯片。”但是那个薯片不是巴厘岛的，是德国的，我记得。
Ránhòu wǒ juéde: "wǒ xiǎng shìyīshì zhèlǐ de shǔpiàn."dànshì nàge shǔpiàn búshi Bālí Dǎo de, shì déguó de, wǒ jìde.
And I thought: "I want to try the crisps here." But they weren't from Bali; they were German, I remember.
然后呢，你在巴厘岛想试试看德国的薯片？知道为什么？
Ránhòu ne, nǐ zài Bālí Dǎo xiǎng shìshìkàn déguó de shǔpiàn? Zhīdào wèishénme?
So you were in Bali and wanted to try German crisps? Do you know why?
那个时候我的脑子有一点不清楚。
Nàge shíhou wǒ de nǎozi yǒu yìdiǎn bù qīngchu.
My head wasn't very clear at the time.
然后是因为它的那个价格是黄色的，一般来说黄色的那个价格是更便宜的，对吧？
Ránhòu shìyīnwèi tā de nàge jiàgé shì huángsè de, yìbānláishuō huángsè de nàge jiàgé shì gèng piányi de, duì ba?
And it was because its price tag was yellow; usually a yellow price tag means it's cheaper, right?
因为他要让你看，这里有一个便宜的东西。所以呢我想OK，如果现在很便宜，我可以试一试。
Yīnwèi tā yào ràng nǐ kàn, zhèlǐ yǒu yíge piányi de dōngxi. Suǒyǐ ne wǒ xiǎng ⁢OK⁢, rúguǒ xiànzài hěn piányi, wǒ kěyǐ shìyīshì.
Because they want you to see there's something cheap here. So I thought OK, if it's cheap now, I can try it.
那巴厘岛的钱太大了，所以呢我没有想清楚。
Nà Bālí Dǎo de qián tàidà le, suǒyǐ ne wǒ méiyǒu xiǎng qīngchu.
The numbers on Bali money are so big that I didn't think it through.
所以我少了很多很多零。
Suǒyǐ wǒshǎo le hěnduōhěnduō líng.
So I missed lots and lots of zeros.
所以我觉得那个东西差不多是一美金。
Suǒyǐ wǒ juéde nàge dōngxi chàbuduō shì yī měijīn.
So I thought it was about one US dollar.
但是我付了以后，我知道是差不多十美金。薯片！
Dànshì wǒfù le yǐhòu, wǒ zhīdào shì chàbuduō shí měijīn. Shǔpiàn!
But after I paid, I realised it was about ten dollars. For crisps!
对，这个比美国还贵。
Duì, zhège bǐ měiguó háiguì.
Yes, that's even more expensive than in America.
对，是的，比澳大利亚也更贵。
Duì, shì de, bǐ Àodàlìyà yě gèng guì.
Yes, more expensive than in Australia too.
然后呢，我想十美金一包薯片，我不要。
Ránhòu ne, wǒ xiǎng shí měijīn yībāo shǔpiàn, wǒ búyào.
Then I thought, ten dollars for a bag of crisps, I don't want it.
所以呢我可能大概走了一米两米，然后我回去。我说：“你好，这个东西我看错了价格，我以为它是一美金，我不知道它是十美金。”
Suǒyǐ ne wǒ kěnéng dàgài zǒu le yīmǐ liǎngmǐ, ránhòu wǒ huíqu. Wǒ shuō: "nǐhǎo, zhège dōngxi wǒ kàn cuò le jiàgé, wǒ yǐwéi tā shì yī měijīn, wǒ bù zhīdào tā shì shí měijīn."
So I'd walked maybe a metre or two, then I went back. I said: "Hello, I misread the price; I thought it was one dollar, I didn't know it was ten."
然后我说：“我可不可以退给你，你把钱还给我？”
Ránhòu wǒ shuō: "wǒ kěbùkěyǐ tuì gěi nǐ, nǐ bǎ qián huángěi wǒ?"
Then I said: "Can I return it and you give me my money back?"
然后呢，他说：“不可以，不可以。”在巴厘岛的超市，你买了一个东西，你不可以退给他们。
Ránhòu ne, tā shuō: "bù kěyǐ, bù kěyǐ."zài Bālí Dǎo de chāoshì, nǐ mǎi le yíge dōngxi, nǐ bù kěyǐ tuì gěi tāmen.
Then they said: "No, you can't." In a supermarket in Bali, once you've bought something you can't return it.
所以我想问问素清老师，这个薯片好吃吗？
Suǒyǐ wǒ xiǎng wènwèn Sù Qīng lǎoshī, zhège shǔpiàn hǎochī ma?
So I'd like to ask teacher Su Qing: were the crisps good?
不好吃，是真的不好吃。不是因为很贵，是真的不好吃。
Bù hǎochī, shì zhēnde bù hǎochī. Búshi yīnwèi hěn guì, shì zhēnde bù hǎochī.
Not good, really not good. Not because they were expensive — they really weren't good.
因为我觉得我吃过很好的薯片，我觉得英国的薯片很好吃，所以呢这个德国的薯片真的不好吃。
Yīnwèi wǒ juéde wǒ chī guo hěn hǎo de shǔpiàn, wǒ juéde yīngguó de shǔpiàn hěn hǎochī, suǒyǐ ne zhège déguó de shǔpiàn zhēnde bù hǎochī.
Because I've had really good crisps; I think British crisps are delicious, so these German ones really weren't good.
又贵又难吃啊。
Yòu guì yòu nánchī a.
Both expensive and bad.
但是所以我可以明白，你去到一个新的国家，有的时候你的脑子想不清楚这个钱是多少钱，是贵还是便宜。
Dànshì suǒyǐ wǒ kěyǐ míngbai, nǐ qù dào yíge xīn de guójiā, yǒu de shíhou nǐ de nǎozi xiǎng bù qīngchu zhège qián shì duōshǎoqián, shì guì háishi piányi.
But that's why I understand: when you go to a new country, sometimes you can't work out how much the money is, whether something is expensive or cheap.
对，所以可以明白。好的。
Duì, suǒyǐ kěyǐ míngbai. Hǎo de.
Right, so I understand. OK.

lines: 那我也和好朋友旅行过，有的时候很开心。我和志飞老师，小瓜Chinese的志飞老师一起旅行。
Nà wǒ yě hé hǎo péngyou lǚxíng guo, yǒu de shíhou hěn kāixīn. Wǒ hé Zhìfēi lǎoshī, Xiǎoguā ⁢Chinese⁢ de Zhìfēi lǎoshī yìqǐ lǚxíng.
I've also travelled with good friends, and sometimes it was great. I travelled with teacher Zhifei, Zhifei from Xiaogua Chinese.
然后呢，每一次都很开心，因为我们可以聊很多东西，所以呢很开心。
Ránhòu ne, měi yīcì dōu hěn kāixīn, yīnwèi wǒmen kěyǐ liáo hěnduō dōngxi, suǒyǐ ne hěn kāixīn.
And every time was fun, because we could talk about lots of things, so it was great.
但是我在中国的时候，我也有和别的中国的朋友一起旅行。
Dànshì wǒ zài zhōngguó de shíhou, wǒ yě yǒu hé biéde zhōngguó de péngyou yìqǐ lǚxíng.
But when I was in China I also travelled with another Chinese friend.
我在中国有一个非常好的朋友。
Wǒ zài zhōngguó yǒu yíge fēicháng hǎo de péngyou.
I have a very good friend in China.
然后呢，我们差不多很像。我们应该有两三次一起旅行，然后有两次我们都吵架，非常非常生气。为什么？
Ránhòu ne, wǒmen chàbuduō hěn xiàng. Wǒmen yīnggāi yǒu liǎngsāncì yìqǐ lǚxíng, ránhòu yǒu liǎngcì wǒmen dōu chǎojià, fēicháng fēicháng shēngqì. Wèishénme?
We're pretty much alike. We've travelled together two or three times, and twice we had a fight and got really, really angry. Why?
有的时候我觉得是很小的事情，就是我都不明白为什么吵架。
Yǒu de shíhou wǒ juéde shì hěnxiǎo de shìqing, jiùshì wǒ dōu bù míngbai wèishénme chǎojià.
Sometimes I think it was something very small; I don't even understand why we fought.
然后上一次我知道为什么。上一次是他买票，然后他买错了，所以呢他浪费了四百块钱。
Ránhòu shàng yīcì wǒ zhīdào wèishénme. Shàng yīcì shì tā mǎipiào, ránhòu tā mǎi cuò le, suǒyǐ ne tā làngfèi le sìbǎikuài qián.
But the last time I know why. Last time she bought the tickets, and she bought the wrong ones, so she wasted four hundred yuan.
四百块大概多少钱？
Sìbǎikuài dàgài duōshǎoqián?
How much is four hundred yuan, roughly?
四百块，大概我想一想，台币应该是两千。
Sìbǎikuài, dàgài wǒ xiǎngyīxiǎng, táibì yīnggāi shì liǎngqiān.
Four hundred yuan, let me think — in Taiwan dollars it should be about two thousand.
两千，对，有一点多。美金大概是五十多。
Liǎngqiān, duì, yǒu yìdiǎnduō. Měijīn dàgài shì wǔshíduō.
Two thousand, yes, a bit more. In US dollars it's a bit over fifty.
在中国四百块可以做很多很多事情，对吧？
Zài zhōngguó sìbǎikuài kěyǐ zuò hěnduōhěnduō shìqing, duì ba?
In China you can do lots and lots of things with four hundred yuan, right?
在台湾也是。对，然后我说：“没有关系。”因为他浪费了四百块。
Zài táiwān yě shì. Duì, ránhòu wǒ shuō: "méiyǒu guānxi."yīnwèi tā làngfèi le sìbǎikuài.
In Taiwan too. Right, so I said: "It doesn't matter." Because she had wasted four hundred yuan.
然后他帮我们两个人买，然后呢我说：“我可以给你我的两百。”
Ránhòu tā bāng wǒmen liǎnggè rénmǎi, ránhòu ne wǒ shuō: "wǒ kěyǐ gěi nǐ wǒ de liǎngbǎi."
And she had bought for both of us, so I said: "I can give you my two hundred."
“然后呢，所以你不要太难过。”
"ránhòu ne, suǒyǐ nǐ búyào tài nánguò."
"So don't be too upset."
然后他说：“不要不要不要，因为是我的错，我不要你的钱。”
Ránhòu tā shuō: "búyào búyào búyào, yīnwèi shì wǒ de cuò, wǒ búyào nǐ de qián."
And she said: "No, no, no, it was my mistake, I don't want your money."
然后我说：“好，如果你不要，那我可以以后多付钱，我可以付饭店的钱。”没有很多钱，很便宜。
Ránhòu wǒ shuō: "hǎo, rúguǒ nǐ búyào, nà wǒ kěyǐ yǐhòu duō fùqián, wǒ kěyǐ fù fàndiàn de qián."méiyǒu hěnduō qián, hěn piányi.
Then I said: "OK, if you don't want it, I can pay more later; I can pay for the hotel." It wasn't much money, it was cheap.
酒店，中国人说酒店。然后呢，我可以付饭的钱。
Jiǔdiàn, zhōngguó rén shuō jiǔdiàn. Ránhòu ne, wǒ kěyǐ fùfàn de qián.
酒店 — Chinese people say 酒店 for hotel. And I could pay for the meals.
对，然后从那个开始，我努力付钱。
Duì, ránhòu cóng nàge kāishǐ, wǒ nǔlì fùqián.
Right, and from then on I made a point of paying.
你知道如果你付钱，你会觉得你付了很多很多钱，对吧？
Nǐ zhīdào rúguǒ nǐ fùqián, nǐ huì juéde nǐfù le hěnduōhěnduō qián, duì ba?
You know, when you pay, you feel you've paid a lot, right?
因为你这边付一点点，然后那边付一点点，你会感觉你付了很多钱。
Yīnwèi nǐ zhèbiān fù yìdiǎndiǎn, ránhòu nàbian fù yìdiǎndiǎn, nǐ huì gǎnjué nǐfù le hěnduō qián.
Because you pay a little here and a little there, and you feel you've paid a lot.
可能没有真的很多钱，但是你会感觉你付了很多钱。每个人都是这样的，就是你做了一些事情，你会觉得你做了很多事情。
Kěnéng méiyǒu zhēnde hěnduō qián, dànshì nǐ huì gǎnjué nǐfù le hěnduō qián. Měigè rén dōu shì zhèyàng de, jiùshì nǐ zuò le yìxiē shìqing, nǐ huì juéde nǐ zuò le hěnduō shìqing.
Maybe it's not really that much, but you feel you've paid a lot. Everyone's like that: when you do some things, you feel you've done a lot.
但是你看不到别人做了什么。
Dànshì nǐ kànbúdào biéren zuò le shénme.
But you can't see what other people have done.
然后呢，我觉得我付钱很多次以后……
Ránhòu ne, wǒ juéde wǒ fùqián hěn duōcì yǐhòu……
Then, after I had paid many times…
第二天，他又想到这个四百块钱，然后他很不开心。
Dìèrtiān, tā yòu xiǎngdào zhège sìbǎikuài qián, ránhòu tā hěn bù kāixīn.
the next day she thought about the four hundred yuan again and got very unhappy.
然后他就说：“素清，你把那个两百块钱给我。”
Ránhòu tā jiù shuō: "Sù Qīng, nǐ bǎ nàge liǎngbǎikuài qián gěi wǒ."
And she said: "Su Qing, give me that two hundred yuan."
第二天他说这个，因为我觉得我已经付了很多钱，所以我也不开心。
Dìèrtiān tā shuō zhège, yīnwèi wǒ juéde wǒ yǐjīng fù le hěnduō qián, suǒyǐ wǒ yě bù kāixīn.
She said this the next day, and because I felt I'd already paid a lot, I was unhappy too.
然后我说：“为什么？”然后他就说：“你把那个两百块钱给我。”
Ránhòu wǒ shuō: "wèishénme?"ránhòu tā jiù shuō: "nǐ bǎ nàge liǎngbǎikuài qián gěi wǒ."
So I said: "Why?" And she just said: "Give me that two hundred yuan."
然后我就说……我说得不太好听，就是在中文我们说“占便宜”。
Ránhòu wǒ jiù shuō…… Wǒ shuō de bùtàihǎo tīng, jiùshì zài zhōngwén wǒmen shuō "zhànpiányi".
Then I said… I put it rather rudely; in Chinese we say 占便宜, "to take advantage".
我说：“你不要占我的便宜。”大概就是从我这里拿钱。
Wǒ shuō: "nǐ búyào zhàn wǒ de piányi."dàgài jiù shìcóng wǒ zhèlǐ ná qián.
I said: "Don't take advantage of me." Roughly, taking money from me.
然后他非常非常生气。
Ránhòu tā fēicháng fēicháng shēngqì.
And she got very, very angry.
他说：“我没有真的要你的钱。”
Tā shuō: "wǒ méiyǒu zhēnde yào nǐ de qián."
She said: "I wasn't really asking for your money."
他说：“这个是一个笑话，哈哈哈，这个是一个笑话。”
Tā shuō: "zhège shì yíge xiàohua, hāhāhā, zhège shì yíge xiàohua."
She said: "It was a joke, hahaha, it was a joke."
但是他一直说一直说，所以我觉得很麻烦。
Dànshì tā yìzhí shuō yìzhí shuō, suǒyǐ wǒ juéde hěn máfan.
But she kept saying it, so I found it really annoying.
对，所以呢我就说：“你不要想占便宜。”
Duì, suǒyǐ ne wǒ jiù shuō: "nǐ búyào xiǎng zhànpiányi."
Right, so I said: "Don't try to take advantage."
然后因为我说了这个，他非常生气。因为这个东西，我们两个吵架，非常不开心。
Ránhòu yīnwèi wǒ shuō le zhège, tā fēicháng shēngqì. Yīnwèi zhège dōngxi, wǒmen liǎnggè chǎojià, fēicháng bù kāixīn.
And because I said that, she got very angry. Because of this we had a fight and were very unhappy.
但是因为这件事情，我觉得第一个是我不应该和他一起旅行。
Dànshì yīnwèi zhèjiàn shìqing, wǒ juéde dìyígè shì wǒ bù yīnggāi hé tā yìqǐ lǚxíng.
But because of this, I think first of all I shouldn't travel with her.
哦，不应该？对，我觉得不应该。
O, bù yīnggāi? Duì, wǒ juéde bù yīnggāi.
Oh, you shouldn't? Right, I don't think I should.
其实我们一起旅行，我们是开心的。
Qíshí wǒmen yìqǐ lǚxíng, wǒmen shì kāixīn de.
Actually, when we travel together we're happy.
但是如果有了一个问题，我没有办法和他很好地聊天。
Dànshì rúguǒ yǒu le yíge wèntí, wǒ méiyǒu bànfǎ hé tā hěn hǎo dì liáotiān.
But if a problem comes up, I can't talk it through with her properly.
懂了。因为他在哭，然后我想要说清楚，但是他觉得我是一个不好的人。
Dǒng le. Yīnwèi tā zài kū, ránhòu wǒ xiǎngyào shuō qīngchu, dànshì tā juéde wǒ shì yíge bùhǎo de rén.
I see. Because she was crying, and I wanted to explain clearly, but she thought I was a bad person.
对，所以我觉得这是一个很大的问题，我们没有办法很好地聊天。
Duì, suǒyǐ wǒ juéde zhèshì yíge hěndà de wèntí, wǒmen méiyǒu bànfǎ hěn hǎo dì liáotiān.
Right, so I think that's a big problem: we can't talk things through.
然后我也因为这个事情，我在想，可能我们不做朋友。
Ránhòu wǒ yě yīnwèi zhège shìqing, wǒ zài xiǎng, kěnéng wǒmen bù zuò péngyou.
And because of this I've been thinking maybe we shouldn't be friends.
哇，这么不好？这么严重？对，是这么严重。
Wa, zhème bùhǎo? Zhème yánzhòng? Duì, shì zhème yánzhòng.
Wow, that bad? That serious? Yes, it's that serious.
我真的因为这个事情，他让我想了很多很多，然后真的让我觉得可能我们不应该做朋友。
Wǒ zhēnde yīnwèi zhège shìqing, tā ràng wǒ xiǎng le hěnduōhěnduō, ránhòu zhēnde ràng wǒ juéde kěnéng wǒmen bù yīnggāi zuò péngyou.
This really made me think a lot, and it really made me feel maybe we shouldn't be friends.
因为有了这个事情以后，我觉得我的心很累很累。
Yīnwèi yǒu le zhège shìqing yǐhòu, wǒ juéde wǒ de xīn hěn lèi hěn lèi.
Because after this happened, my heart felt really, really tired.
懂了懂了。
Dǒng le dǒng le.
I see, I see.
所以我们还聊天，然后有的时候会说我们一起去旅行，可是因为这个事情，其实我心里很害怕，我真的害怕。
Suǒyǐ wǒmen hái liáotiān, ránhòu yǒu de shíhou huì shuō wǒmen yìqǐ qù lǚxíng, kěshì yīnwèi zhège shìqing, qíshí wǒ xīnli hěn hàipà, wǒ zhēnde hàipà.
So we still chat, and sometimes we say let's travel together, but because of this I'm actually scared inside; I'm really scared.
所以我觉得有可能我们不要做朋友比较好。
Suǒyǐ wǒ juéde yǒu kěnéng wǒmen búyào zuò péngyou bǐjiào hǎo.
So I think maybe it would be better if we weren't friends.
不是只因为这个事情，我在去想……
Búshi zhǐ yīnwèi zhège shìqing, wǒ zài qù xiǎng……
It's not only because of this; I've been thinking…
以前我们是差不多的两个人，我们很像很像。
Yǐqián wǒmen shì chàbuduō de liǎnggè rén, wǒmen hěn xiàng hěn xiàng.
We used to be two very similar people; we were very, very alike.
但是现在慢慢地越来越不一样。
Dànshì xiànzài mànmàn dì yuèláiyuè bù yīyàng.
But now we're slowly becoming more and more different.
所以我觉得，有可能慢慢地他不是我的朋友。
Suǒyǐ wǒ juéde, yǒu kěnéng mànmàn dì tā búshi wǒ de péngyou.
So I think maybe, slowly, she's no longer my friend.
以前他是我最好的朋友。
Yǐqián tā shì wǒ zuìhǎo de péngyou.
She used to be my best friend.
对，但是可能你们现在住在不一样的地方，做不一样的事情，慢慢地想法有不一样的。对，想法。
Duì, dànshì kěnéng nǐmen xiànzài zhù zài bù yīyàng de dìfang, zuò bù yīyàng de shìqing, mànmàn dì xiǎngfǎ yǒu bù yīyàng de. Duì, xiǎngfǎ.
Right, but maybe now you live in different places and do different things, so slowly your ideas become different. Yes, ideas.
对对对，是的。然后我觉得，就是你和好朋友在一起，应该是很放松的、很开心的，对不对？
Duì duì duì, shì de. Ránhòu wǒ juéde, jiùshì nǐ hé hǎo péngyou zài yìqǐ, yīnggāi shì hěn fàngsōng de, hěn kāixīn de, duì bù duì?
Yes, exactly. And I think when you're with a good friend, it should be relaxed and happy, right?
可是每次我想到这个事情，我都觉得我的心很累。
Kěshì měicì wǒ xiǎngdào zhège shìqing, wǒ dōu juéde wǒ de xīn hěn lèi.
But every time I think about this, my heart feels tired.
因为我觉得我没有办法和他聊天，因为他在哭。然后他说：“你为什么要和我说清楚？”然后他会说：“你不爱我。”我觉得很累，真的很累。
Yīnwèi wǒ juéde wǒ méiyǒu bànfǎ hé tā liáotiān, yīnwèi tā zài kū. Ránhòu tā shuō: "nǐ wèishénme yào hé wǒ shuō qīngchu?"ránhòu tāhuì shuō: "nǐ bù ài wǒ."wǒ juéde hěnlèi, zhēnde hěnlèi.
Because I feel I can't talk to her; she was crying. And she said: "Why do you have to spell it out to me?" And she'd say: "You don't love me." I find it exhausting, really exhausting.
blocks.h: 素清和朋友的旅行 · Su Qing's trip with a friend

lines: 老师，你有没有觉得，有一些朋友，比如说这个朋友是适合一起旅行的？
Lǎoshī, nǐ yǒuméiyǒu juéde, yǒu yìxiē péngyou, bǐrúshuō zhège péngyou shì shìhé yìqǐ lǚxíng de?
Teacher, have you ever felt that some friends are, for example, right for travelling together?
这个朋友我可以跟他一起吃饭，吃完饭以后我们拜拜，再见。
Zhège péngyou wǒ kěyǐ gēn tā yìqǐ chīfàn, chīwánfàn yǐhòu wǒmen bàibai, zàijiàn.
With this friend I can have a meal, and after the meal we say bye-bye.
这个朋友你可以跟他聊天，聊你发生什么事情。
Zhège péngyou nǐ kěyǐ gēn tā liáotiān, liáo nǐ fāshēng shénme shìqing.
This friend you can chat with about what's happening to you.
这个朋友可能你可以跟他一起买东西，因为他知道买什么东西最便宜。
Zhège péngyou kěnéng nǐ kěyǐ gēn tā yìqǐ mǎi dōngxi, yīnwèi tā zhīdào mǎi shénme dōngxi zuì piányi.
With this friend you can go shopping, because she knows where things are cheapest.
所以我有很多不一样的朋友做不一样的事情。我不会找我跟他旅行觉得不舒服的朋友跟他一起旅行。
Suǒyǐ wǒ yǒu hěnduō bù yīyàng de péngyou zuò bù yīyàng de shìqing. Wǒ búhuì zhǎo wǒ gēn tā lǚxíng juéde bù shūfu de péngyou gēn tā yìqǐ lǚxíng.
So I have lots of different friends for different things. I won't travel with a friend I feel uncomfortable travelling with.
因为我知道我跟他吃饭可能是比较舒服的。
Yīnwèi wǒ zhīdào wǒ gēn tā chīfàn kěnéng shì bǐjiào shūfu de.
Because I know eating with her is probably more comfortable.
对对对，是的，我非常同意。我觉得每个好朋友他们是不一样的。
Duì duì duì, shì de, wǒ fēicháng tóngyì. Wǒ juéde měigè hǎo péngyou tāmen shì bù yīyàng de.
Yes, exactly, I totally agree. I think every good friend is different.
所以有的朋友，像贝拉说的，是更适合一起旅行，有的朋友更适合聊天。
Suǒyǐ yǒu de péngyou, xiàng Bèilā shuō de, shì gèng shìhé yìqǐ lǚxíng, yǒu de péngyou gèng shìhé liáotiān.
So some friends, like Bella said, are better for travelling together, and some are better for chatting.
但是我可能以前和他一起旅行，是因为他是我的好朋友。
Dànshì wǒ kěnéng yǐqián hé tā yìqǐ lǚxíng, shìyīnwèi tā shì wǒ de hǎo péngyou.
But I probably travelled with her before because she was my good friend.
所以呢有时候你想，他是好朋友，所以他可以一起做所有的东西。
Suǒyǐ ne yǒushíhou nǐ xiǎng, tā shì hǎo péngyou, suǒyǐ tā kěyǐ yìqǐ zuò suǒyǒu de dōngxi.
So sometimes you think, she's a good friend, so we can do everything together.
但是我现在每一次想到这一次旅行，我都觉得非常非常难受，真的很不舒服。
Dànshì wǒ xiànzài měi yīcì xiǎngdào zhè yīcì lǚxíng, wǒ dōu juéde fēicháng fēicháng nánshòu, zhēnde hěn bù shūfu.
But now every time I think about that trip, I feel really, really bad; it's really uncomfortable.
因为我们在一个房间，然后我们没有办法聊天，因为他在哭。
Yīnwèi wǒmen zài yíge fángjiān, ránhòu wǒmen méiyǒu bànfǎ liáotiān, yīnwèi tā zài kū.
Because we were in one room and couldn't talk, because she was crying.
然后我真的就是那个时候非常非常想离开。
Ránhòu wǒ zhēnde jiùshì nàge shíhou fēicháng fēicháng xiǎng líkāi.
And at that moment I really, really wanted to leave.
但是你不可以离开，对吧？
Dànshì nǐ bù kěyǐ líkāi, duì ba?
But you can't leave, right?
也不是不可以，但是就是你要说清楚嘛，对不对？
Yě búshi bù kěyǐ, dànshì jiùshì nǐ yàoshuō qīngchu ma, duì bù duì?
It's not that you can't, but you have to talk it out, don't you?
你还是要说清楚，没有办法说现在就离开。我们真的是很好的朋友，我们有三个人，我们睡在一张床上。
Nǐ háishi yàoshuō qīngchu, méiyǒu bànfǎ shuō xiànzài jiù líkāi. Wǒmen zhēnde shì hěn hǎo de péngyou, wǒmen yǒu sāngè rén, wǒmen shuì zài yīzhāng chuángshàng.
You still have to talk it out; you can't just say "I'm leaving now". We really were very good friends — there were three of us, sleeping in one bed.
对，所以就是真的有一点点尴尬，就是一个人在大哭。
Duì, suǒyǐ jiùshì zhēnde yǒu yìdiǎndiǎn gāngà, jiùshì yíge rén zài dàkū.
Right, so it was really a bit awkward, with one person sobbing.
然后呢我想不清楚。然后还有中间的那个朋友怎么办？
Ránhòu ne wǒ xiǎng bù qīngchu. Ránhòu háiyǒu zhōngjiān de nàge péngyou zěnmebàn?
And I couldn't think straight. And what about the friend in the middle?
哦，中间的人也很苦。
O, zhōngjiān de rén yě hěn kǔ.
Oh, the person in the middle had a hard time too.
对，他想要帮我们两个，但是我们的问题，我觉得可能别的人很难帮。
Duì, tā xiǎngyào bāng wǒmen liǎnggè, dànshì wǒmen de wèntí, wǒ juéde kěnéng biéde rén hěn nán bāng.
Right, she wanted to help us both, but I think our problem was hard for anyone else to help with.
可能就是我们真的不一样。
Kěnéng jiùshì wǒmen zhēnde bù yīyàng.
Maybe we're just really different.
所以为什么一起旅行，对吧？
Suǒyǐ wèishénme yìqǐ lǚxíng, duì ba?
So why travel together, right?
对，所以以后应该不要一起旅行比较好。
Duì, suǒyǐ yǐhòu yīnggāi búyào yìqǐ lǚxíng bǐjiào hǎo.
Right, so in future it's better not to travel together.
但是我觉得可能不一起旅行，你还是可以是好朋友，吃饭的朋友、聊天的朋友。
Dànshì wǒ juéde kěnéng bù yìqǐ lǚxíng, nǐ háishi kěyǐ shì hǎo péngyou, chīfàn de péngyou, liáotiān de péngyou.
But I think even if you don't travel together, you can still be good friends — friends to eat with, friends to chat with.
我感觉可以。
Wǒ gǎnjué kěyǐ.
I feel you can.
但是我觉得因为这一次的旅行，我发现了新的东西。
Dànshì wǒ juéde yīnwèi zhè yīcì de lǚxíng, wǒ fāxiàn le xīn de dōngxi.
But I feel that because of this trip, I discovered something new.
所以我觉得，可能我们现在真的是很不一样的人。
Suǒyǐ wǒ juéde, kěnéng wǒmen xiànzài zhēnde shì hěn bù yīyàng de rén.
So I think maybe we really are very different people now.
我们以前小的时候是好朋友，但是现在我们变成了不一样的人。可能是我变了，我不知道，可能是他变了。我觉得应该是我变了。
Wǒmen yǐqián xiǎo de shíhou shì hǎo péngyou, dànshì xiànzài wǒmen biànchéng le bù yīyàng de rén. Kěnéng shì wǒ biàn le, wǒ bù zhīdào, kěnéng shì tā biàn le. Wǒ juéde yīnggāi shì wǒ biàn le.
We were good friends when we were young, but now we've become different people. Maybe I've changed, I don't know, maybe she has. I think it's probably me who changed.
所以呢，可能因为这个，现在我们不一定要做好朋友。
Suǒyǐ ne, kěnéng yīnwèi zhège, xiànzài wǒmen bù yídìng yào zuòhǎo péngyou.
So maybe because of this, we don't necessarily have to be good friends now.
我觉得……懂了懂了。OK，这个就是我们和好朋友一起旅行的故事。
Wǒ juéde…… Dǒng le dǒng le. ⁢OK⁢, zhège jiùshì wǒmen hé hǎo péngyou yìqǐ lǚxíng de gùshi.
I see, I see. OK, those are our stories of travelling with good friends.
blocks.h: 不同的朋友 · Different friends for different things

lines: 那贝拉，你觉得一个人旅行怎么样？
Nà Bèilā, nǐ juéde yíge rén lǚxíng zěnmeyàng?
So Bella, what do you think about travelling alone?
我以前喜欢一个人去旅行，因为我觉得当你有朋友和你一起的时候，你不容易看其他的东西，你不容易做你想做的事情。
Wǒ yǐqián xǐhuan yíge rénqù lǚxíng, yīnwèi wǒ juéde dāng nǐ yǒu péngyou hé nǐ yìqǐ de shíhou, nǐ bù róngyì kàn qítā de dōngxi, nǐ bù róngyì zuò nǐ xiǎng zuò de shìqing.
I used to like travelling alone, because I think when a friend is with you, it's not easy to look at other things or do what you want to do.
你不容易认识新的朋友。
Nǐ bù róngyì rènshi xīn de péngyou.
It's not easy to make new friends.
可是自己一个人旅行，你想做什么，你就去做。
Kěshì zìjǐ yíge rén lǚxíng, nǐ xiǎng zuò shénme, nǐ jiù qù zuò.
But when you travel alone, you do whatever you want.
因为还有一个很大的原因是，我通常旅行的时候，我还会工作。
Yīnwèi háiyǒu yíge hěndà de yuányīn shì, wǒ tōngcháng lǚxíng de shíhou, wǒ hái huì gōngzuò.
Because another big reason is that when I travel, I usually still work.
对，我还教中文。
Duì, wǒ hái jiào zhōngwén.
Right, I still teach Chinese.
所以我觉得，如果我的朋友因为我的工作，他需要等我，他需要在饭店里面等我……
Suǒyǐ wǒ juéde, rúguǒ wǒ de péngyou yīnwèi wǒ de gōngzuò, tā xūyào děng wǒ, tā xūyào zài fàndiàn lǐmiàn děng wǒ……
So I feel that if my friend has to wait for me because of my work, has to wait in the hotel…
可能一个小时、两个小时，我会觉得很不好意思。所以因为这个原因，我觉得我自己旅行可能会比跟朋友旅行好。
Kěnéng yíge xiǎoshí, liǎnggè xiǎoshí, wǒhuì juéde hěn bùhǎoyìsi. Suǒyǐ yīnwèi zhège yuányīn, wǒ juéde wǒ zìjǐ lǚxíng kěnéng huì bǐ gēn péngyou lǚxíng hǎo.
maybe for an hour or two, I'd feel really bad. So for that reason I think travelling by myself may be better than with a friend.
因为很多人去旅行，他付了很多钱，他请假请了十天，是因为他真的想要去看这个地方，不是因为他想要坐在饭店里面等我。
Yīnwèi hěnduō rénqù lǚxíng, tāfù le hěnduō qián, tā qǐngjià qǐng le shítiān, shìyīnwèi tā zhēnde xiǎngyào qù kàn zhège dìfang, búshi yīnwèi tā xiǎngyào zuòzài fàndiàn lǐmiàn děng wǒ.
Because when people travel, they pay a lot of money and take ten days off because they really want to see the place, not because they want to sit in a hotel waiting for me.
所以我觉得自己一个人旅行，我可以选择我什么时候工作，什么时候去看东西。
Suǒyǐ wǒ juéde zìjǐ yíge rén lǚxíng, wǒ kěyǐ xuǎnzé wǒ shénme shíhou gōngzuò, shénme shíhou qù kàn dōngxi.
So I think when I travel alone, I can choose when to work and when to go sightseeing.
但是如果有朋友，我可能需要问他：“你想做什么？”可是我有工作，太麻烦了。
Dànshì rúguǒ yǒu péngyou, wǒ kěnéng xūyào wèn tā: "nǐ xiǎng zuò shénme?"kěshì wǒ yǒu gōngzuò, tài máfan le.
But if I'm with a friend, I might need to ask: "What do you want to do?" But I have work, it's too complicated.
明白明白。那现在呢？现在你这个想法有没有改变？
Míngbai míngbai. Nà xiànzài ne? Xiànzài nǐ zhège xiǎngfǎ yǒuméiyǒu gǎibiàn?
I see. And now? Has your view changed?
有改变，因为我觉得有时候我自己去了很有名很有名的地方。
Yǒu gǎibiàn, yīnwèi wǒ juéde yǒushíhou wǒ zìjǐ qù le hěn yǒumíng hěn yǒumíng de dìfang.
It has changed, because sometimes I go to really famous places by myself.
我看了那些很漂亮很漂亮的风景，可是我是一个人，我没有人跟我一起看，我可以说：“哇，这个地方很漂亮，你觉得呢？”
Wǒ kàn le nàxiē hěnpiàoliàng hěnpiàoliàng de fēngjǐng, kěshì wǒ shì yíge rén, wǒ méiyǒu rén gēn wǒ yìqǐ kàn, wǒ kěyǐ shuō: "wa, zhège dìfang hěnpiàoliàng, nǐ juéde ne?"
I see that gorgeous scenery, but I'm alone; there's no one to look at it with me so I could say: "Wow, this place is beautiful, what do you think?"
我是一个人看，我觉得有时候觉得一点点难过。我非常同意。
Wǒ shì yíge rén kàn, wǒ juéde yǒushíhou juéde yìdiǎndiǎn nánguò. Wǒ fēicháng tóngyì.
I'm looking at it alone, and sometimes I feel a bit sad. I totally agree.
我以前也一个人旅行过，然后我发现我看到了很有意思的东西，但是我的旁边没有人可以一起分享这个。
Wǒ yǐqián yě yíge rén lǚxíng guo, ránhòu wǒ fāxiàn wǒ kàndào le hěn yǒuyìsi de dōngxi, dànshì wǒ de pángbiān méiyǒu rén kěyǐ yìqǐ fēnxiǎng zhège.
I've also travelled alone before, and I found that I saw really interesting things, but there was no one beside me to share them with.
我觉得一个人旅行可能四五天，我可能还是OK的。
Wǒ juéde yíge rén lǚxíng kěnéng sìwǔtiān, wǒ kěnéng háishi ⁢OK⁢ de.
I think travelling alone for four or five days is probably still OK for me.
但是如果四个月、五个月，那我觉得还是和朋友、男朋友一起可能会比较好。
Dànshì rúguǒ sìgè yuè, wǔgè yuè, nà wǒ juéde háishi hé péngyou, nánpéngyou yìqǐ kěnéng huì bǐjiào hǎo.
But for four or five months, I think it's probably better with friends or a boyfriend.
我同意，我同意。
Wǒ tóngyì, wǒ tóngyì.
I agree, I agree.
所以我现在喜欢可能一半自己旅行，一半跟朋友旅行。听起来很好，很好。
Suǒyǐ wǒ xiànzài xǐhuan kěnéng yíbàn zìjǐ lǚxíng, yíbàn gēn péngyou lǚxíng. Tīng qǐlai hěn hǎo, hěn hǎo.
So now I like maybe half travelling alone and half with friends. That sounds great.
OK，好的。那我们问一问学生，你们觉得一个人旅行还是和朋友旅行，哪一个更好？
⁢OK⁢, hǎo de. Nà wǒmen wènyīwèn xuésheng, nǐmen juéde yíge rén lǚxíng háishi hé péngyou lǚxíng, na yíge gènghǎo?
OK. So let's ask our students: which do you think is better, travelling alone or with friends?
留言告诉我们，如果你们也和你们的好朋友在一起旅行的时候吵架……
Liúyán gàosu wǒmen, rúguǒ nǐmen yě hé nǐmen de hǎo péngyou zài yìqǐ lǚxíng de shíhou chǎojià……
Leave a comment and tell us, if you've also had a fight with your good friend while travelling…
对，告诉我们你们的故事。
Duì, gàosu wǒmen nǐmen de gùshi.
Yes, tell us your story.
好的，今天的视频到这里，我们下个视频见，拜拜！拜拜！
Hǎo de, jīntiān de shìpín dào zhèlǐ, wǒmen xiàge shìpín jiàn, bàibai! Bàibai!
OK, that's all for today's video; see you in the next one, bye! Bye!

q: 贝拉这次旅行了四个月。
Bèilā zhècì lǚxíng le sìgè yuè.
Bella's trip this time lasted four months.
tf.why: She planned two months, but it became four.

q: 贝拉的好朋友是台湾人。
Bèilā de hǎo péngyou shì táiwānrén.
Bella's good friend is Taiwanese.
tf.why: The friend is Vietnamese and lives in Germany.

q: 贝拉和这个朋友是在澳大利亚认识的。
Bèilā hé zhège péngyou shì zài Àodàlìyà rènshi de.
Bella met this friend in Australia.
tf.why: They were roommates in Australia about eight years ago.

q: 去餐厅以前，贝拉说她很饿。
Qù cāntīng yǐqián, Bèilā shuō tā hěn è.
Before going to the restaurant, Bella said she was very hungry.
tf.why: She said she wasn't very hungry and only wanted something small.

q: 秘鲁的菜单上写的是美金。
Bìlǔ de càidān shàng xiě de shì měijīn.
The menu in Peru was in US dollars.
tf.why: It was in the local money, not US or Taiwan dollars.

q: 他们等了三四十分钟，菜才来。
Tāmen děng le sān sìshífēnzhōng, cài cái lái.
They waited thirty or forty minutes for the food.
tf.why: After thirty or forty minutes the food still hadn't come.

q: 那碗海鲜汤要四十美金。
Nàwǎn hǎixiān tāngyào sìshí měijīn.
The seafood soup cost forty US dollars.
tf.why: About forty dollars for one bowl.

q: 贝拉和朋友因为这顿饭大吵了一架。
Bèilā hé péngyou yīnwèi zhè dùnfàn dàchǎo le yījià.
Bella and her friend had a big fight over this meal.
tf.why: The friend joked about it and they didn't fight.

q: 素清在巴厘岛买的薯片是巴厘岛本地的。
Sù Qīng zài Bālí Dǎo mǎi de shǔpiàn shì Bālí Dǎo běndì de.
The crisps Su Qing bought in Bali were local Bali crisps.
tf.why: They were German crisps.

q: 超市同意把钱还给素清。
Chāoshì tóngyì bǎ qián huángěi Sù Qīng.
The supermarket agreed to give Su Qing her money back.
tf.why: They said she couldn't return it.

q: 素清的朋友买错了票，浪费了四百块。
Sù Qīng de péngyou mǎicuò le piào, làngfèi le sìbǎikuài.
Su Qing's friend bought the wrong tickets and wasted 400 yuan.
tf.why: She bought the wrong tickets and wasted 400 yuan.

q: 素清和那个朋友后来去看了医生。
Sù Qīng hé nàge péngyou hòulái qù kàn le yīshēng.
Su Qing and that friend later went to see a doctor.
tf.why: Nothing is said about a doctor.

q: 那次旅行一共有三个人。
Nàcì lǚxíng yīgòng yǒu sāngè rén.
There were three people on that trip.
tf.why: There were three of them, sleeping in one bed.

q: 贝拉现在只喜欢一个人旅行。
Bèilā xiànzài zhǐ xǐhuan yíge rén lǚxíng.
Now Bella only likes travelling alone.
tf.why: Now she likes half alone and half with friends.

q: 在台湾，“饭店”是什么意思？
Zài táiwān, "fàndiàn"shì shénme yìsi?
In Taiwan, what does 饭店 mean?
o: a place to stay, a hotel
mc.why: In mainland China 饭店 is a place to eat, in Taiwan it's a place to stay.

q: 贝拉为什么吃得不开心？
Bèilā wèishénme chī de bù kāixīn?
Why didn't Bella enjoy the meal?
o: 她要很快吃完回去上课
Tā yào hěnkuài chī wán huíqu shàngkè
she had to eat quickly and go back to teach
mc.why: She had a class in twenty minutes and had to eat fast.

q: 素清为什么以为薯片很便宜？
Sù Qīng wèishénme yǐwéi shǔpiàn hěn piányi?
Why did Su Qing think the crisps were cheap?
o: 价格是黄色的，而且她看错了零
Jiàgé shì huángsè de, érqiě tā kàn cuò le líng
the price tag was yellow and she misread the zeros
mc.why: The yellow price tag looked like a discount, and she missed lots of zeros.

q: 素清说了什么，让朋友非常生气？
Sù Qīng shuō le shénme, ràng péngyou fēicháng shēngqì?
What did Su Qing say that made her friend very angry?
o: Nǐ búyào zhàn wǒ de piányi
I don't want to travel with you
mc.why: She told her not to take advantage of her.

q: 贝拉为什么以前喜欢一个人旅行？
Bèilā wèishénme yǐqián xǐhuan yíge rén lǚxíng?
Why did Bella use to like travelling alone?
ans: 因为她旅行的时候还要工作，不想让朋友在饭店里等她；一个人可以自己选择什么时候工作，什么时候去玩。
Yīnwèi tā lǚxíng de shíhou háiyào gōngzuò, bùxiǎng ràng péngyou zài fàndiàn lǐ děng tā; yíge rén kěyǐ zìjǐ xuǎnzé shénme shíhou gōngzuò, shénme shíhou qù wán.
Because she still works while travelling and doesn't want a friend waiting for her in the hotel; alone she can choose when to work and when to go sightseeing.

q: 为什么在中国大陆和台湾，“饭店”会让人误会？
Wèishénme zài zhōngguó dàlù hé táiwān, "fàndiàn"huì ràng rén wùhuì?
Why can 饭店 cause misunderstandings between mainland China and Taiwan?
ans: 因为在中国大陆，饭店是吃饭的地方；在台湾，饭店是住的地方。
Yīnwèi zài zhōngguó dàlù, fàndiàn shì chīfàn de dìfang; zài táiwān, fàndiàn shì zhù de dìfang.
Because in mainland China 饭店 is a place to eat, while in Taiwan it's a place to stay.

q: 素清觉得以后还应该和那个朋友一起旅行吗？为什么？
Sù Qīng juéde yǐhòu hái yīnggāi hé nàge péngyou yìqǐ lǚxíng ma? Wèishénme?
Does Su Qing think she should travel with that friend again? Why?
ans: 不应该。因为有了问题以后，她们没有办法好好聊天，而且她们现在变成了很不一样的人。
Bù yīnggāi. Yīnwèi yǒu le wèntí yǐhòu, tāmen méiyǒu bànfǎ hǎohǎo liáotiān, érqiě tāmen xiànzài biànchéng le hěn bù yīyàng de rén.
No. Because when a problem comes up they can't talk properly, and they've become very different people.

002.zh: 关于中国的看法：对还是错？
002.title: Assumptions about China: true or false?
002.transcriptNote: 素清 Sù Qīng, who grew up in mainland China, answers questions from 贝拉 Bèilā, a teacher from Taiwan who has never been to the mainland. Fillers like 嗯 and 呃 are mostly left out; a few unclear words were reconstructed from context.

lines: 大家好！欢迎来到今天的Lazy Chinese的播客。
Dàjiā hǎo! Huānyíng láidào jīntiān de ⁢Lazy⁢ ⁢Chinese⁢ de bōkè.
Hello everyone! Welcome to today's Lazy Chinese podcast.
今天是我素清和贝拉老师。欢迎贝拉老师！你好！
Jīntiān shì wǒ Sù Qīng hé Bèilā lǎoshī. Huānyíng Bèilā lǎoshī! Nǐhǎo!
Today it's me, Su Qing, and teacher Bella. Welcome, Bella! Hello!
今天我觉得台湾人一定对中国大陆有很多很多想法，有很多问题。
Jīntiān wǒ juéde táiwānrén yídìng duì zhōngguó dàlù yǒu hěnduōhěnduō xiǎngfǎ, yǒu hěnduō wèntí.
Today — I think Taiwanese people must have lots of ideas and questions about mainland China.
那我想知道，贝拉老师，你有没有去过中国大陆？
Nà wǒ xiǎng zhīdào, Bèilā lǎoshī, nǐ yǒuméiyǒu qùguò zhōngguó dàlù?
So I'd like to know, Bella, have you ever been to mainland China?
没有。太好了！
Méiyǒu. Tàihǎole!
No. Great!
我就喜欢没去过中国大陆的人对中国大陆有什么想法。
Wǒ jiù xǐhuan méi qùguò zhōngguó dàlù de rén duì zhōngguó dàlù yǒu shénme xiǎngfǎ.
I love hearing what people who've never been to the mainland think about it.
然后呢，今天我想看看贝拉老师的想法和问题，然后我来回答你，我来说说我的看法。
Ránhòu ne, jīntiān wǒ xiǎng kànkan Bèilā lǎoshī de xiǎngfǎ hé wèntí, ránhòu wǒlái huídá nǐ, wǒ láishuō shuō wǒ de kànfǎ.
So today I'd like to hear Bella's ideas and questions, and then I'll answer and give my view.
好，OK，没问题。
Hǎo, ⁢OK⁢, méi wèntí.
OK, no problem.
blocks.h: 开场 · Hello and today's topic

lines: 那第一个看法或者问题是什么？
Nà dìyígè kànfǎ huòzhě wèntí shì shénme?
So what's the first idea or question?
第一个问题是我自己的经验。
Dìyígè wèntí shì wǒ zìjǐ de jīngyàn.
The first question comes from my own experience.
那是很久以前，我在爱尔兰，欧洲的一个国家工作。
Nà shì hěnjiǔyǐqián, wǒ zài àiěrlán, ōuzhōu de yíge guójiā gōngzuò.
It was a long time ago; I was working in Ireland, a country in Europe.
那时候我的工作是卖很贵很贵的包包，那些牌子，LV啊，还是Chanel啊，这些很贵的包包。
Nà shíhou wǒ de gōngzuò shì mài hěn guì hěn guì de bāobāo, nàxiē páizi, ⁢LV⁢ a, háishi ⁢Chanel⁢ a, zhèxiē hěnguì de bāobāo.
At that time my job was selling very expensive handbags — brands like LV or Chanel.
常常会有很多很多中国的大妈，他们是一个旅游团，来我的店买这些很贵很贵的包包。
Chángcháng huì yǒu hěnduōhěnduō zhōngguó de dàmā, tāmen shì yíge lǚyóutuán, lái wǒ de diàn mǎi zhèxiē hěnguì hěn guì de bāobāo.
Lots of middle-aged Chinese women often came to my shop in tour groups to buy these very expensive bags.
他们会看看看，然后呢……
Tāmen huì kànkan kàn, ránhòu ne……
They'd look and look, and then…
有一天，有一个大妈，她看了很久，然后她选了一个包。
Yǒu yītiān, yǒu yíge dàmā, tā kàn le hěn jiǔ, ránhòu tā xuǎn le yígèbāo.
One day one of these ladies looked for a long time, and then she chose a bag.
她说：“诶，小姐，我看一下这个包是不是中国做的。”
Tā shuō: "éi, xiǎojie, wǒ kàn yīxià zhège bāo shìbúshì zhōngguó zuò de."
She said: "Excuse me, miss, let me check whether this bag is made in China."
然后我看了一下，真的是中国做的。
Ránhòu wǒ kàn le yīxià, zhēnde shì zhōngguó zuò de.
So I had a look, and it really was made in China.
可是我觉得很奇怪：你是中国人，你为什么不想买中国做的包包？
Kěshì wǒ juéde hěn qíguài: nǐ shì zhōngguó rén, nǐ wèishénme bùxiǎng mǎi zhōngguó zuò de bāobāo?
But I found it strange: you're Chinese, why don't you want to buy a bag made in China?
你觉得不好吗？为什么？
Nǐ juéde bùhǎo ma? Wèishénme?
Do you think it's not good? Why?
我觉得这真的很好问。我觉得可能有两点。这个大妈现在她人不在中国，她在爱尔兰，对不对？
Wǒ juéde zhè zhēnde hěn hǎo wèn. Wǒ juéde kěnéng yǒu liǎngdiǎn. Zhège dàmā xiànzài tā rén bù zài zhōngguó, tā zài àiěrlán, duì bù duì?
That's a really good question. I think there may be two points. This lady wasn't in China at that moment, she was in Ireland, right?
对。你去了很远的地方，然后你买一个东西……
Duì. Nǐ qù le hěn yuǎn de dìfang, ránhòu nǐ mǎi yíge dōngxi……
Right. You've gone somewhere very far away, and then you buy something…
我觉得可能因为中国做的东西实在是太多太多了。
Wǒ juéde kěnéng yīnwèi zhōngguó zuò de dōngxi shízài shì tàiduōtàiduō le.
I think it's probably because there are just so, so many things made in China.
那可能你去旅游的时候，你要买一个东西，然后说：“啊，这个还是中国做的！”
Nà kěnéng nǐ qù lǚyóu de shíhou, nǐ yào mǎi yíge dōngxi, ránhòu shuō: "a, zhège háishi zhōngguó zuò de!"
So maybe when you travel and want to buy something, you say: "Oh, this is made in China too!"
那中国人会觉得：那我为什么要在爱尔兰买？我在中国就可以买。有道理。这是第一点。
Nà zhōngguó rénhuì juéde: nà wǒ wèishénme yào zài àiěrlán mǎi? Wǒ zài zhōngguó jiù kěyǐ mǎi. Yǒu dàoli. Zhèshì dìyìdiǎn.
Then Chinese people think: why would I buy it in Ireland? I can buy it in China. That makes sense. That's the first point.
有的时候，当然我觉得中国制造，在中国做的东西，大部分的人可能觉得那个质量很难说，有好的也有不好的。
Yǒu de shíhou, dāngrán wǒ juéde zhōngguó zhìzào, zài zhōngguó zuò de dōngxi, dàbùfen de rén kěnéng juéde nàge zhìliàng hěnnánshuō, yǒu hǎo de yě yǒu bùhǎo de.
Sometimes, of course, with "Made in China", things made in China, most people may feel the quality is hard to judge — some good, some not.
所以呢，有的时候是因为这个原因。可是我觉得另一个原因是你去到一个新的国家，你不想要买自己国家做的，你去了那么远。
Suǒyǐ ne, yǒu de shíhou shìyīnwèi zhège yuányīn. Kěshì wǒ juéde lìng yíge yuányīn shì nǐ qù dào yíge xīn de guójiā, nǐ bù xiǎngyào mǎi zìjǐ guójiā zuò de, nǐ qù le nàme yuǎn.
So sometimes it's for that reason. But I think another reason is that when you go to a new country, you don't want to buy things made in your own country — you've come all that way.
对，这是我想的第一点。
Duì, zhè shì wǒ xiǎng de dìyìdiǎn.
Right, that's my first point.
然后第二点，你说：“哎，中国人自己不喜欢中国制造的东西吗？”
Ránhòu dìèrdiǎn, nǐ shuō: "āi, zhōngguó rén zìjǐ bù xǐhuan zhōngguó zhìzào de dōngxi ma?"
And the second point: you ask, "Don't Chinese people like things made in China?"
这个问题真的问得太好了。我的答案是……是什么？
Zhège wèntí zhēnde wèndé tàihǎole. Wǒ de dáàn shì…… Shì shénme?
That's a really great question. My answer is… what is it?
素清老师，为什么你看起来你的脸不知道怎么回答这个问题呢？
Sù Qīng lǎoshī, wèishénme nǐ kànqǐlai nǐ de liǎn bù zhīdào zěnme huídá zhège wèntí ne?
Su Qing, why does your face look like you don't know how to answer?
有一点点复杂。
Yǒu yìdiǎndiǎn fùzá.
It's a little complicated.
OK，我觉得有很长的一段时间……
⁢OK⁢, wǒ juéde yǒu hěncháng de yīduànshíjiān……
OK, I think for a long time…
如果一个中国人看到两个东西，一个是中国制造的，一个是德国制造的，那当然中国人会觉得：“啊，我要买德国制造的。”
Rúguǒ yíge zhōngguó rén kàndào liǎnggè dōngxi, yíge shì zhōngguó zhìzào de, yíge shì déguó zhìzào de, nà dāngrán zhōngguó rénhuì juéde: "a, wǒyào mǎi déguó zhìzào de."
if a Chinese person saw two things, one made in China and one made in Germany, of course they'd think: "I'll buy the German one."
有的时候甚至不是德国，因为德国它是很有名的，做东西做得很好的，对吧？
Yǒu de shíhou shènzhì búshi déguó, yīnwèi déguó tā shì hěn yǒumíng de, zuò dōngxi zuò de hěn hǎo de, duì ba?
Sometimes it's not even Germany — Germany is famous for making things well, right?
德国、日本都是很好的。那有的时候可能是别的国家，比如说澳大利亚，比如说可能泰国。
Déguó, rìběn dōu shì hěn hǎo de. Nàyǒu de shíhou kěnéng shì biéde guójiā, bǐrúshuō Àodàlìyà, bǐrúshuō kěnéng tàiguó.
Germany and Japan are very good. But sometimes it might be other countries, like Australia, or maybe Thailand.
有的时候是别的国家。我觉得中国人有的时候更喜欢外国做的东西。
Yǒu de shíhou shì biéde guójiā. Wǒ juéde zhōngguó rényǒu de shíhou gèng xǐhuan wàiguó zuò de dōngxi.
Sometimes other countries. I think Chinese people sometimes prefer things made abroad.
是因为这个东西可能在中国做的很容易坏？
Shìyīnwèi zhège dōngxi kěnéng zài zhōngguó zuò de hěn róngyì huài?

Shì. Nǐ yǒu zhège xiǎngfǎ ma? Jiùshì……

if it's made in China, it breaks more easily.

So you don't want to buy it, or you just think other countries' things are better than China's?
我觉得中国制造有一个很麻烦的一点，因为我们的价格很不一样，中国有很便宜很便宜的东西。
Wǒ juéde zhōngguó zhìzào yǒu yíge hěn máfan de yìdiǎn, yīnwèi wǒmen de jiàgé hěn bù yīyàng, zhōngguó yǒu hěn piányi hěn piányi de dōngxi.

You can imagine: if something is too cheap, its quality can't be very good.
对不对？对，是吧？
Duì bù duì? Duì, shì ba?

对对对，所以我觉得真的有很长的一段时间，中国人也不太相信中国制造的东西。

lines: 然后呢，但是最近我又觉得，中国人开始觉得：“哦，我们要支持中国做的东西。”
Ránhòu ne, dànshì zuìjìn wǒ yòu juéde, zhōngguó rén kāishǐ juéde: "o, wǒmen yào zhīchí zhōngguó zuò de dōngxi."
But recently I feel Chinese people have started thinking: "We should support things made in China."
比如说有一些东西是护肤的，就是涂在你的脸上的东西。
Bǐrúshuō yǒu yìxiē dōngxi shì hùfū de, jiùshì tú zài nǐ de liǎnshàng de dōngxi.
For example, skincare — things you put on your face.
因为有很多法国的，对吧？可能意大利的护肤品，比较贵，比较好。
Yīnwèi yǒu hěnduō fǎguó de, duì ba? Kěnéng yìdàlì de hùfūpǐn, bǐjiào guì, bǐjiào hǎo.
Because there are lots of French ones, right? Maybe Italian skincare — more expensive, better.
然后呢，那中国的公司可能说：“这个是我们中国的，我们也在努力地做，希望大家可以支持我们。”

Of course Chinese people like cheap things. So if something isn't too expensive and is also good, we'll support it.
然后现在我觉得中国可能不是只做便宜的东西。我们也做便宜的东西，但是我们也开始做贵的东西。
Ránhòu xiànzài wǒ juéde zhōngguó kěnéng búshi zhǐ zuò piányi de dōngxi. Wǒmen yě zuò piányi de dōngxi, dànshì wǒmen yě kāishǐ zuòguì de dōngxi.
And now I think China doesn't only make cheap things. We still make cheap things, but we've also started making expensive ones.
比如说大疆，你知道大疆吗？不知道，这是……
Bǐrúshuō Dàjiāng, nǐ zhīdào Dàjiāng ma? Bù zhīdào, zhèshì……
For example DJI — do you know 大疆? No, what's…
那个相机，运动的。DJI！哦，听过。你听英文就听过了。对对对，那个是大疆，那个是中国的公司。
Nàge xiàngjī, yùndòng de. ⁢DJI⁢! O, tīngguò. Nǐ tīng yīngwén jiù tīng guo le. Duì duì duì, nàge shì Dàjiāng, nàge shì zhōngguó de gōngsī.
That camera, for sport. DJI! Oh, I've heard of it. You know it from the English name. Yes, that's 大疆, it's a Chinese company.
那个是世界上，我觉得现在应该是世界上最好的运动相机。
Nàge shì shìjiè shàng, wǒ juéde xiànzài yīnggāi shì shìjiè shàng zuìhǎo de yùndòng xiàngjī.
It's — I think it's probably the best action camera in the world now.
对。小米，我觉得小米我也觉得很好，这个牌子。小米，小米。
Duì. Xiǎomǐ, wǒ juéde Xiǎomǐ wǒ yě juéde hěn hǎo, zhège páizi. Xiǎomǐ, Xiǎomǐ.
Right. Xiaomi — I think Xiaomi is very good too, that brand. Xiaomi.
我觉得台湾人有用过，台湾人很喜欢买。是吗？是因为便宜吧？是因为蛮便宜的，还是便宜，然后质量也还可以。
Wǒ juéde táiwānrén yǒuyòng guo, táiwānrén hěn xǐhuan mǎi. Shì ma? Shìyīnwèi piányi ba? Shìyīnwèi mán piányi de, háishi piányi, ránhòu zhìliàng yě hái kěyǐ.

对。对，所以我是觉得，如果你说中国制造的东西质量都不好，所以大家不喜欢，我觉得这个是不公平。
Duì. Duì, suǒyǐ wǒ shì juéde, rúguǒ nǐ shuō zhōngguó zhìzào de dōngxi zhìliàng dōu bùhǎo, suǒyǐ dàjiā bù xǐhuan, wǒ juéde zhège shì bù gōngpíng.
Right. So I feel that if you say everything made in China is poor quality and that's why people don't like it, that's not fair.
因为中国制造的东西真的有太便宜的，然后也越来越贵。
Yīnwèi zhōngguó zhìzào de dōngxi zhēnde yǒu tài piányi de, ránhòu yě yuèláiyuè guì.
Because some Chinese-made things really are too cheap, but they're also getting more and more expensive.
所以现在中国开始做一些比较贵的东西，然后我觉得很好。
Suǒyǐ xiànzài zhōngguó kāishǐ zuò yìxiē bǐjiào guì de dōngxi, ránhòu wǒ juéde hěn hǎo.

那中文有一个词叫“性价比”，对不对？对，我知道性价比。

就是你在中国，你就是要在很多很多的东西里选择那个适合你的。

lines: 懂了懂了。因为我自己也很喜欢，就是中国淘宝。

我觉得是错的。那个汉字应该是“淘”，就是在很多很多东西里面，然后淘一个好的东西。
Wǒ juéde shì cuò de. Nàge hànzì yīnggāi shì "táo", jiùshì zài hěnduōhěnduō dōngxi lǐmiàn, ránhòu táo yíge hǎo de dōngxi.
I think it's wrong. The character should be 淘: among lots and lots of things, you sift out a good one.
好的。因为我们台湾人很喜欢说“掏宝”“掏宝”。哦，是淘，那个汉字是淘，不是掏东西，是淘，是找好东西。
Hǎo de. Yīnwèi wǒmen táiwānrén hěn xǐhuan shuō "tāobǎo""tāobǎo". O, shì táo, nàge hànzì shì táo, búshi tāo dōngxi, shì táo, shì zhǎo hǎo dōngxi.
OK. Because we Taiwanese like saying 掏宝. Oh, it's 淘 — the character is 淘, not 掏 as in digging things out; 淘 means finding good things.
哦哦，OK，那我现在要开始说“淘宝”。可是可能其他台湾人会觉得我很奇怪：“为什么你说淘宝？”
O o, ⁢OK⁢, nà wǒ xiànzài yào kāishǐ shuō "Táobǎo". Kěshì kěnéng qítā táiwānrén huì juéde wǒ hěn qíguài: "wèishénme nǐ shuō Táobǎo?"

对，你试试。你去告诉他们，他们是错的。OK，好好好。
Duì, nǐ shìshì. Nǐ qù gàosu tāmen, tāmen shì cuò de. ⁢OK⁢, hǎohǎo hǎo.
Right, try it. Go and tell them they're wrong. OK, OK.
对，淘宝就是……真的就是，怎么说，淘宝的东西就是有贵的，有便宜的，所以你就是真的要花很多时间找。
Duì, Táobǎo jiùshì…… Zhēnde jiùshì, zěnme shuō, Táobǎo de dōngxi jiùshì yǒuguì de, yǒu piányi de, suǒyǐ nǐ jiùshì zhēnde yàohuā hěnduō shíjiān zhǎo.
Right, Taobao is really… how to put it — Taobao has expensive things and cheap things, so you really have to spend a lot of time looking.
所以你说中国人也不喜欢中国制造的东西吗？
Suǒyǐ nǐ shuō zhōngguó rén yě bù xǐhuan zhōngguó zhìzào de dōngxi ma?
So you asked whether Chinese people dislike things made in China?
我会觉得我的感受是很复杂的。
Wǒhuì juéde wǒ de gǎnshòu shì hěn fùzá de.
I'd say my feelings are very complicated.
有的时候我看到是中国制造的，然后又是很便宜的，那我可能觉得这个东西应该不太好。
Yǒu de shíhou wǒ kàndào shì zhōngguó zhìzào de, ránhòu yòu shì hěn piányi de, nà wǒ kěnéng juéde zhège dōngxi yīnggāi bùtàihǎo.
Sometimes I see it's made in China and very cheap, and I think it's probably not very good.
但有的时候我看到一个中国的公司，他们做的东西越来越好。
Dàn yǒu de shíhou wǒ kàndào yíge zhōngguó de gōngsī, tāmen zuò de dōngxi yuèláiyuè hǎo.

那我也觉得很开心，我也觉得：“啊，这个东西又不贵又很好！”只有在中国，又不贵又很好的，真的。
Nà wǒ yě juéde hěn kāixīn, wǒ yě juéde: "a, zhège dōngxi yòu bùguì yòu hěn hǎo!"zhǐyǒu zài zhōngguó, yòu bùguì yòu hěn hǎo de, zhēnde.
Then I'm happy too, and I think: "Wow, this is cheap and really good!" Only in China — cheap and good, really.
对，所以你们如果去中国，你们是可以找到非常好的东西，然后不贵的，就是比你们的国家可能便宜很多的。
Duì, suǒyǐ nǐmen rúguǒ qù zhōngguó, nǐmen shì kěyǐ zhǎodào fēicháng hǎo de dōngxi, ránhòu bùguì de, jiùshì bǐ nǐmen de guójiā kěnéng piányi hěnduō de.
Right, so if you go to China you can find really good things that aren't expensive — maybe much cheaper than in your own country.
对，去淘好东西吧！
Duì, qù táohǎo dōngxi ba!
Right, go and hunt for good things!
对，去淘宝。他们应该付我们钱，因为我们今天帮他们做了很多广告。
Duì, qù Táobǎo. Tāmen yīnggāi fù wǒmen qián, yīnwèi wǒmen jīntiān bāng tāmen zuò le hěnduō guǎnggào.
Yes, go to Taobao. They should pay us; we've given them a lot of advertising today.
但是在中国以前，淘宝是一个App嘛，对不对？
Dànshì zài zhōngguó yǐqián, Táobǎo shì yíge ⁢App⁢ ma, duì bù duì?

淘宝这个App，你可以去买东西。可是呢，因为它可能是最早最早的App，现在“淘宝”……
Táobǎo zhège ⁢App⁢, nǐ kěyǐ qù mǎi dōngxi. Kěshì ne, yīnwèi tā kěnéng shì zuìzǎo zuìzǎo de ⁢App⁢, xiànzài "Táobǎo"……

For example, someone says: "I want to buy clothes, where should I go?" "Go to Taobao." It doesn't really mean the Taobao app; it has come to mean "buy things on an app". I see.
所以现在中国人说“我要去淘宝”，不是真的去淘宝这个App，有可能是去小红书，有可能是去京东。
Suǒyǐ xiànzài zhōngguó rén shuō "wǒyào qù Táobǎo", búshi zhēnde qù Táobǎo zhège ⁢App⁢, yǒu kěnéng shì qù Xiǎohóngshū, yǒu kěnéng shì qù Jīngdōng.

啊，哇哦！因为我们台湾人觉得淘宝就是那个淘宝的App。哦，我学到了新的东西，很好很好。

对，在中国现在就是买东西的App真的太多太多了，然后每个App他们卖的东西又不一样。
