blocks.h: 淘宝还是“掏宝”？ · Taobao — 淘 or 掏?

lines: 好，那这是贝拉老师的第一个问题。你的第二个问题是什么？
Hǎo, nà zhè shì Bèilā lǎoshī de dìyígè wèntí. Nǐ de dìèrgè wèntí shì shénme?
OK, that was Bella's first question. What's your second?
第二个问题是，我最近看新闻……
Dìèrgè wèntí shì, wǒ zuìjìn kàn xīnwén……
My second question: I saw some news recently…
因为我知道在中国的一些大的城市，你都用手机付钱，比如说支付宝、微信这种。
Yīnwèi wǒ zhīdào zài zhōngguó de yìxiē dà de chéngshì, nǐ dōu yòng shǒujī fùqián, bǐrúshuō zhīfùbǎo, wēixìn zhèzhǒng.
Because I know that in some big Chinese cities you pay with your phone, like Alipay or WeChat.
这很方便的。那台湾也有自己的，我用LINE。
Zhè hěn fāngbiàn de. Nà táiwān yě yǒu zìjǐ de, wǒyòng ⁢LINE⁢.
That's very convenient. Taiwan has its own too; I use LINE.
可是在一些比较小的餐厅，我是需要给老板现金，所以有时候还是有一点点不方便。
Kěshì zài yìxiē bǐjiào xiǎo de cāntīng, wǒ shì xūyào gěi lǎobǎn xiànjīn, suǒyǐ yǒushíhou háishi yǒu yìdiǎndiǎn bù fāngbiàn.
But in some smaller restaurants I have to give the owner cash, so sometimes it's still a bit inconvenient.
但是呢，最近我看到一个非常非常酷的东西。
Dànshì ne, zuìjìn wǒ kàndào yíge fēicháng fēicháng kù de dōngxi.
But recently I saw something really, really cool.
那就是现在去中国，你不需要带钱包，不需要带手机，你只需要带你的手。
Nà jiùshì xiànzài qù zhōngguó, nǐ bù xūyào dài qiánbāo, bù xūyào dài shǒujī, nǐ zhǐ xūyào dài nǐ de shǒu.
Now when you go to China, you don't need to bring a wallet or a phone; you only need to bring your hand.
那怎么付钱呢？
Nà zěnme fùqián ne?
So how do you pay?
你只要把你的手放在老板的一个机器上，你就“哔”，你就可以付了。
Nǐ zhǐyào bǎ nǐ de shǒu fàngzài lǎobǎn de yíge jīqì shàng, nǐ jiù "bì", nǐ jiù kěyǐ fù le.
You just put your hand on the owner's machine, it goes "beep", and you've paid.
然后我看到这个，我有一点怕，因为我觉得……
Ránhòu wǒ kàndào zhège, wǒ yǒu yìdiǎn pà, yīnwèi wǒ juéde……
When I saw this I was a little scared, because I thought…
他们怎么知道你有多少钱？那他们是不是可以把你的钱拿走？
Tāmen zěnme zhīdào nǐ yǒu duōshǎoqián? Nà tāmen shìbúshì kěyǐ bǎ nǐ de qián názǒu?
How do they know how much money you have? Could they take your money?
还是，以前可能会有人偷你的钱包，偷你的手机，现在他们可能会偷你的手？
Háishi, yǐqián kěnéng huì yǒurén tōu nǐ de qiánbāo, tōu nǐ de shǒujī, xiànzài tāmen kěnéng huì tōu nǐ de shǒu?
Or — in the past people might steal your wallet or your phone; now they might steal your hand?
这是我觉得有一点点奇怪的。对啊，有一点害怕，有一点可怕。
Zhè shì wǒ juéde yǒu yìdiǎndiǎn qíguài de. Duì a, yǒu yìdiǎn hàipà, yǒu yìdiǎn kěpà.
That's what I find a bit strange. Yes, a bit scary, a bit frightening.
是的，没错。我觉得有一个新的东西出来，害怕是很正常的。
Shì de, méicuò. Wǒ juéde yǒu yíge xīn de dōngxi chulai, hàipà shì hěn zhèngcháng de.
Yes, exactly. I think it's normal to be scared when something new comes out.
这个刷手支付，我应该也是昨天、前天第一次看到，可能也是一个比较新的东西。
Zhège shuāshǒuzhīfù, wǒ yīnggāi yě shì zuótiān, qiántiān dìyīcì kàndào, kěnéng yě shì yíge bǐjiào xīn de dōngxi.
I first saw this palm payment just yesterday or the day before; it's probably fairly new.
那贝拉老师，如果你觉得刷手支付很可怕，那你觉得Apple Pay、Google Pay，还有阿里Pay这些东西，和刷手支付有什么不一样？
Nà Bèilā lǎoshī, rúguǒ nǐ juéde shuāshǒuzhīfù hěn kěpà, nà nǐ juéde ⁢Apple⁢ ⁢Pay⁢, ⁢Google⁢ ⁢Pay⁢, háiyǒu ālǐ ⁢Pay⁢ zhèxiē dōngxi, hé shuāshǒuzhīfù yǒu shénme bù yīyàng?
So Bella, if palm payment scares you, how do you think Apple Pay, Google Pay and Alipay differ from it?
因为我觉得刷手支付，我感觉好像……手机我可以保护，我不要给别人看到我的密码。
Yīnwèi wǒ juéde shuāshǒuzhīfù, wǒ gǎnjué hǎoxiàng…… Shǒujī wǒ kěyǐ bǎohù, wǒ búyào gěi biéren kàndào wǒ de mìmǎ.
Because with palm payment, I feel like… my phone I can protect; I don't let others see my password.
他可以不知道我的东西，可是手没有一个密码。
Tā kěyǐ bù zhīdào wǒ de dōngxi, kěshì shǒu méiyǒu yíge mìmǎ.
They can't know my stuff, but a hand has no password.
没有一个密码，你可以拿我的手就付钱？我不需要给你密码吗？我觉得不可以。
Méiyǒu yíge mìmǎ, nǐ kěyǐ ná wǒ de shǒu jiù fùqián? Wǒ bù xūyào gěi nǐ mìmǎ ma? Wǒ juéde bù kěyǐ.
No password — you can just take my hand and pay? I don't need to give you a password? I don't think that's OK.
你知道密码是可以让大家不会看到你的东西，不会知道你的东西。可是手没有一个这样子的东西，我会觉得是不是我所有的东西你都可以知道。
Nǐ zhīdào mìmǎ shì kěyǐ ràng dàjiā búhuì kàndào nǐ de dōngxi, búhuì zhīdào nǐ de dōngxi. Kěshì shǒu méiyǒu yíge zhè yàngzi de dōngxi, wǒhuì juéde shìbúshì wǒ suǒyǒu de dōngxi nǐ dōu kěyǐ zhīdào.
A password stops people seeing and knowing your things. But a hand has nothing like that, so I feel like you could know everything about me.
你觉得，如果你用的是Apple Pay，苹果支付，那你所有的东西苹果这个公司是知道的，对不对？
Nǐ juéde, rúguǒ nǐ yòng de shì ⁢Apple⁢ ⁢Pay⁢, píngguǒ zhīfù, nà nǐ suǒyǒu de dōngxi píngguǒ zhège gōngsī shì zhīdào de, duì bù duì?
Do you think that if you use Apple Pay, the company Apple knows all your stuff, right?
我觉得如果我把我的信用卡放在一起，那它知道。对，它知道。
Wǒ juéde rúguǒ wǒ bǎ wǒ de xìnyòngkǎ fàngzài yìqǐ, nà tā zhīdào. Duì, tā zhīdào.
I think if I link my credit card to it, then it knows. Right, it knows.
对，好。然后我猜，刷手支付我还没有用过，但是我猜刷手支付也是支付宝的一个东西，阿里Pay的一个东西。
Duì, hǎo. Ránhòu wǒ cāi, shuāshǒuzhīfù wǒ hái méiyǒu yòngguò, dànshì wǒ cāi shuāshǒuzhīfù yě shì zhīfùbǎo de yíge dōngxi, ālǐ ⁢Pay⁢ de yíge dōngxi.
Right. And I'd guess — I haven't used palm payment yet — but I'd guess it's an Alipay thing.
所以呢有可能就是说……我不知道你有没有看过，以前有一些App，它要你的脸的信息。
Suǒyǐ ne yǒu kěnéng jiùshìshuō…… Wǒ bù zhīdào nǐ yǒuméiyǒu kànguò, yǐqián yǒu yìxiē ⁢App⁢, tā yào nǐ de liǎn de xìnxī.
So it may be like… I don't know if you've seen it, but some apps used to ask for your face data.
然后就是现在苹果手机嘛，有的时候你不想要输密码，所以你就用脸，对吧？脸识别。对，那这个和手是一样的。
Ránhòu jiùshì xiànzài píngguǒ shǒujī ma, yǒu de shíhou nǐ bù xiǎngyào shū mìmǎ, suǒyǐ nǐ jiù yòng liǎn, duì ba? Liǎn shíbié. Duì, nà zhège hé shǒu shì yīyàng de.
And now with iPhones, sometimes you don't want to type a password, so you use your face, right? Face recognition. Right, it's the same as the hand.
可能是用脸，可是我还是拿着我的手机，我还是有一个机器，我觉得比较安心，比较安全一点。
Kěnéng shì yòng liǎn, kěshì wǒ háishi ná zhe wǒ de shǒujī, wǒ háishi yǒu yíge jīqì, wǒ juéde bǐjiào ānxīn, bǐjiào ānquán yìdiǎn.
It may use my face, but I'm still holding my phone, I still have a device, so I feel more at ease, a bit safer.
可是现在是没有一个手机，我给你我的手，你就可以拿走我的钱，让我觉得很奇怪。
Kěshì xiànzài shì méiyǒu yíge shǒujī, wǒ gěi nǐ wǒ de shǒu, nǐ jiù kěyǐ názǒu wǒ de qián, ràng wǒ juéde hěn qíguài.
But now there's no phone — I give you my hand and you can take my money. That feels strange to me.
啊，我觉得手听起来比密码更安全。
A, wǒ juéde shǒu tīng qǐlai bǐ mìmǎ gèng ānquán.
Oh, I think a hand sounds safer than a password.
对，所以真的我觉得它一定是更安全的。因为密码，那个黑客他可以去看，去找到你所有的密码。
Duì, suǒyǐ zhēnde wǒ juéde tā yídìng shì gèng ānquán de. Yīnwèi mìmǎ, nàge hēikè tā kěyǐ qù kàn, qù zhǎodào nǐ suǒyǒu de mìmǎ.
Right, I really think it must be safer. Because with passwords, a hacker can go and find all your passwords.
但是手，如果你把我的手砍下来，这个是不可以用的。所以没有人可以真的偷你的手。
Dànshì shǒu, rúguǒ nǐ bǎ wǒ de shǒu kǎnxiàlái, zhège shì bù kěyǐ yòng de. Suǒyǐ méiyǒu rén kěyǐ zhēnde tōu nǐ de shǒu.
But a hand — if you cut my hand off, it can't be used. So nobody can really steal your hand.
这倒是。对对，没错。
Zhèdào shì. Duì duì, méicuò.
That's true. Yes, exactly.
对，然后你说那政府是不是知道你赚的钱。当然政府知道所有的东西，政府当然知道你赚了多少钱。
Duì, ránhòu nǐ shuō nà zhèngfǔ shìbúshì zhīdào nǐ zhuàn de qián. Dāngrán zhèngfǔ zhīdào suǒyǒu de dōngxi, zhèngfǔ dāngrán zhīdào nǐ zhuàn le duōshǎoqián.
And you asked whether the government knows how much you earn. Of course the government knows everything; of course it knows how much you've earned.
对，但是政府如果他想要让一个国家稳定，他为什么要偷你的钱呢？
Duì, dànshì zhèngfǔ rúguǒ tā xiǎngyào ràng yíge guójiā wěndìng, tā wèishénme yào tōu nǐ de qián ne?
Right, but if a government wants the country to be stable, why would it steal your money?
如果你不可以相信你的政府，你不可以相信这个大的银行，那这个国家完蛋了。他为什么要做这样的东西，对不对？
Rúguǒ nǐ bù kěyǐ xiāngxìn nǐ de zhèngfǔ, nǐ bù kěyǐ xiāngxìn zhège dà de yínháng, nà zhège guójiā wándàn le. Tā wèishénme yào zuò zhèyàng de dōngxi, duì bù duì?
If you can't trust your government or the big banks, the country is finished. Why would it do something like that, right?
你们也知道中国政府有钱，他不需要去偷你那一点点钱。所以你这个担心我觉得是不用担心。
Nǐmen yě zhīdào zhōngguózhèngfǔ yǒuqián, tā bù xūyào qù tōu nǐ nà yìdiǎndiǎn qián. Suǒyǐ nǐ zhège dānxīn wǒ juéde shì búyòng dānxīn.
You all know the Chinese government has money; it doesn't need to steal your little bit. So I don't think you need to worry about that.
那素清老师，你觉得——因为你住在澳大利亚——你觉得澳大利亚会不会也开始用这个？
Nà Sù Qīng lǎoshī, nǐ juéde—— yīnwèi nǐ zhù zài Àodàlìyà—— nǐ juéde Àodàlìyà huì búhuì yě kāishǐ yòng zhège?
So Su Qing, since you live in Australia, do you think Australia will start using this too?
我是觉得澳大利亚有一点慢，就是如果他要一个新的东西，他可能会想很多，他可能也有和你一样的担心：会不会不安全？
Wǒ shì juéde Àodàlìyà yǒu yìdiǎn màn, jiùshì rúguǒ tā yào yíge xīn de dōngxi, tā kěnéng huìxiǎng hěnduō, tā kěnéng yě yǒu hé nǐ yīyàng de dānxīn: huì búhuì bù ānquán?
I think Australia is a bit slow: if it wants something new, it thinks a lot; it may have the same worry as you — is it unsafe?
所以在澳大利亚，所有的东西都有一点点慢。
Suǒyǐ zài Àodàlìyà, suǒyǒu de dōngxi dōu yǒu yìdiǎndiǎn màn.
So in Australia everything is a bit slow.
那你是用手机还是信用卡付钱？有道理啊。
Nà nǐ shì yòng shǒujī háishi xìnyòngkǎ fùqián? Yǒu dàoli a.
So do you pay by phone or credit card? That makes sense.
我们在澳大利亚，可能挺多地方是用现金，用钱，然后还有很多地方就是用卡，还有手机，都有。那跟台湾一样，是一样的。
Wǒmen zài Àodàlìyà, kěnéng tǐng duō dìfang shì yòng xiànjīn, yòngqian, ránhòu háiyǒu hěnduō dìfang jiùshì yòngkǎ, háiyǒu shǒujī, dōu yǒu. Nà gēn táiwān yīyàng, shì yīyàng de.
In Australia quite a lot of places use cash, and lots of places use cards, and phones too — all of them. That's the same as Taiwan.
我真的觉得，政府已经知道我所有的信息，不管是澳大利亚还是中国。
Wǒ zhēnde juéde, zhèngfǔ yǐjīng zhīdào wǒ suǒyǒu de xìnxī, bùguǎn shì Àodàlìyà háishi zhōngguó.
I really feel the government already knows all my information, whether it's Australia or China.
所以呢我是觉得，OK，你们知道我的信息。我不知道为什么，可能是因为我是一个中国人，我没有觉得很担心，因为我不要去做不好的事。
Suǒyǐ ne wǒ shì juéde, ⁢OK⁢, nǐmen zhīdào wǒ de xìnxī. Wǒ bù zhīdào wèishénme, kěnéng shìyīnwèi wǒ shì yíge zhōngguó rén, wǒ méiyǒu juéde hěn dānxīn, yīnwèi wǒ búyào qù zuò bùhǎo de shì.
So I think: OK, you know my information. I don't know why — maybe because I'm Chinese — I'm not very worried, because I'm not going to do anything bad.
对，所以呢，OK，你们知道我的信息，你们不要偷我的钱，我就觉得可以。
Duì, suǒyǐ ne, ⁢OK⁢, nǐmen zhīdào wǒ de xìnxī, nǐmen búyào tōu wǒ de qián, wǒ jiù juéde kěyǐ.
Right, so OK, you know my information; as long as you don't steal my money, I'm fine with it.
没关系，让我的生活很方便，用刷手支付，用刷脸支付。
Méiguānxi, ràng wǒ de shēnghuó hěn fāngbiàn, yòng shuāshǒuzhīfù, yòngshuā liǎn zhīfù.
It's fine — make my life convenient: pay with my palm, pay with my face.
我觉得因为有的时候你的手机没有电，对不对？不是那么方便。
Wǒ juéde yīnwèi yǒu de shíhou nǐ de shǒujī méiyǒu diàn, duì bù duì? Búshi nàme fāngbiàn.
Because sometimes your phone has no battery, right? That's not so convenient.
对，可能是。因为我也有在外面，然后忘记带手机，忘记带钱包。
Duì, kěnéng shì. Yīnwèi wǒ yě yǒu zài wàimiàn, ránhòu wàngjì dài shǒujī, wàngjì dài qiánbāo.
Right, maybe. Because I've also been out and forgotten my phone and my wallet.
那我也不可以买东西，所以我还是需要回家，或者是跟我的朋友借钱。
Nà wǒ yě bù kěyǐ mǎi dōngxi, suǒyǐ wǒ háishi xūyào huíjiā, huòzhě shì gēn wǒ de péngyou jièqián.
Then I can't buy anything, so I have to go home or borrow money from a friend.
所以有刷手支付可能会方便一点。可是我不确定我会不会想要用。
Suǒyǐ yǒu shuāshǒuzhīfù kěnéng huì fāngbiàn yìdiǎn. Kěshì wǒ bù quèdìng wǒhuì búhuì xiǎngyào yòng.
So palm payment might be a bit more convenient. But I'm not sure whether I'd want to use it.
对，我觉得害怕新的科技，应该很多人都会有这个问题。但是我不担心。
Duì, wǒ juéde hàipà xīn de kējì, yīnggāi hěnduō rén dōu huì yǒu zhège wèntí. Dànshì wǒ bù dānxīn.
Right, I think lots of people are afraid of new technology. But I'm not worried.
我觉得如果在中国我可以用刷手支付，我一定会用。
Wǒ juéde rúguǒ zài zhōngguó wǒ kěyǐ yòng shuāshǒuzhīfù, wǒ yídìng huì yòng.
If I could use palm payment in China, I'd definitely use it.
好。我觉得一个聪明的政府不会偷我的钱。OK，我的钱也太少了。
Hǎo. Wǒ juéde yíge cōngming de zhèngfǔ búhuì tōu wǒ de qián. ⁢OK⁢, wǒ de qián yě tàishǎo le.
OK. I think a smart government won't steal my money. OK — I have too little money anyway.
不够，不够，他不会找你，他会找更有钱的人。
Búgòu, búgòu, tā búhuì zhǎo nǐ, tāhuì zhǎo gèng yǒuqián de rén.
Not enough — they won't come for you, they'll go after richer people.
我是觉得中国的政府不需要偷钱。这我知道，他们要控制，他们要让这个社会很稳定，他要控制很多东西。
Wǒ shì juéde zhōngguó de zhèngfǔ bù xūyào tōuqián. Zhè wǒ zhīdào, tāmen yào kòngzhì, tāmen yào ràng zhège shèhuì hěn wěndìng, tā yào kòngzhì hěnduō dōngxi.
I think the Chinese government doesn't need to steal money. I know they want control, they want society to be stable; they control a lot.
但是我是觉得，你没有偷我的钱，你让我过我的生活，OK，没问题，没问题。
Dànshì wǒ shì juéde, nǐ méiyǒu tōu wǒ de qián, nǐ ràng wǒ guo wǒ de shēnghuó, ⁢OK⁢, méi wèntí, méi wèntí.
But I feel: you don't steal my money, you let me live my life — OK, no problem.
blocks.h: 刷手付钱 · Paying with your hand

lines: 那还有一个，我想问素清老师。
Nà háiyǒu yíge, wǒ xiǎng wèn Sù Qīng lǎoshī.
There's one more thing I'd like to ask Su Qing.
是因为我知道，中国有一些城市像我刚才说的，刷手支付，然后很方便，用手机。
Shìyīnwèi wǒ zhīdào, zhōngguó yǒu yìxiē chéngshì xiàng wǒ gāngcái shuō de, shuāshǒuzhīfù, ránhòu hěn fāngbiàn, yòng shǒujī.
Because I know some cities in China are like I just said — palm payment, very convenient, phones.
但是有一些城市是没那么方便，可能这些人也没有什么钱。
Dànshì yǒu yìxiē chéngshì shì méi nàme fāngbiàn, kěnéng zhèxiē rén yě méiyǒu shénme qián.
But some cities aren't so convenient, and maybe the people there don't have much money.
那最近在台湾有新闻说，有些中国人可能没有钱，穷到连茶叶蛋都吃不起。这个是真的吗？
Nà zuìjìn zài táiwān yǒu xīnwén shuō, yǒuxiē zhōngguó rén kěnéng méiyǒu qián, qióngdào lián cháyèdàn dōu chībùqǐ. Zhège shì zhēnde ma?
Recently there's been news in Taiwan saying some Chinese people are so poor they can't even afford a tea egg. Is that true?
等一下，贝拉老师，这个是我告诉你的，还是你真的看到……？我好像……但是我有听说有一些地方真的是没有钱。
Děng yīxià, Bèilā lǎoshī, zhège shì wǒ gàosu nǐ de, háishi nǐ zhēnde kàndào……? Wǒ hǎoxiàng…… Dànshì wǒ yǒu tīngshuō yǒu yìxiē dìfang zhēnde shì méiyǒu qián.
Wait, Bella, did I tell you that, or did you really see it…? I think… but I have heard some places really have no money.
就是那个贫富差距，差很多。就是有的人很有钱，没有钱的人，他可能不能去学校，没有钱去学校。刚才素清老师可能有跟我说那个茶叶蛋的故事。

Jiùshì nàge pínfùchājù, chà hěnduō. Jiùshì yǒu de rén hěn yǒuqián, méiyǒu qián de rén, tā kěnéng bùnéng qù xuéxiào, méiyǒu qián qù xuéxiào. Gāngcái Sù Qīng lǎoshī kěnéng yǒu gēn wǒ shuō nàge cháyèdàn de gùshi.
The gap between rich and poor is huge. Some people are very rich, and people without money may not be able to go to school. Earlier Su Qing may have told me that tea-egg story.
对，但是我真的有听说，就是贫富差距很大很大，就是有钱的人很有钱，没有钱的人他可能没有饭吃。
Duì, dànshì wǒ zhēnde yǒu tīngshuō, jiùshì pínfùchājù hěndà hěndà, jiùshì yǒuqián de rén hěn yǒuqián, méiyǒu qián de rén tā kěnéng méiyǒu fàn chī.
Right, but I really have heard that the gap is huge: rich people are very rich, and poor people may not have enough to eat.
我不知道，可能没法去学校，或者是没法吃饭。这是真的吧？是真的。
Wǒ bù zhīdào, kěnéng méifǎ qù xuéxiào, huòzhě shì méifǎ chīfàn. Zhèshì zhēnde ba? Shì zhēnde.
I don't know — maybe they can't go to school or can't eat. That's true, right? It's true.
我觉得当然，中国这样的国家就是有贫富差距的问题。
Wǒ juéde dāngrán, zhōngguó zhèyàng de guójiā jiùshì yǒu pínfùchājù de wèntí.
Of course a country like China does have a wealth-gap problem.
就是有一部分的人没有钱，有一部分的人太有钱。对，当然这是一个很大的问题。
Jiùshì yǒu yībùfen de rén méiyǒu qián, yǒu yībùfen de rén tàiyǒuqián. Duì, dāngrán zhèshì yíge hěndà de wèntí.
Some people have no money, some have too much. Of course that's a big problem.
所以我常常会觉得，在台湾普通人的生活比中国大陆普通人的生活好很多。
Suǒyǐ wǒ chángcháng huì juéde, zài táiwān pǔtōngrén de shēnghuó bǐ zhōngguó dàlù pǔtōngrén de shēnghuó hǎo hěnduō.
So I often feel ordinary people's lives in Taiwan are much better than ordinary people's lives on the mainland.
懂了。对，所以我也觉得，就是我想，在台湾的人，如果他想要相信中国大陆是一个不好的地方，他们一定有很多很多的新闻可以看。
Dǒng le. Duì, suǒyǐ wǒ yě juéde, jiùshì wǒ xiǎng, zài táiwān de rén, rúguǒ tā xiǎngyào xiāngxìn zhōngguó dàlù shì yíge bùhǎo de dìfang, tāmen yídìng yǒu hěnduōhěnduō de xīnwén kěyǐ kàn.
I see. Right, so I also think that if people in Taiwan want to believe the mainland is a bad place, there's surely lots of news for them to read.
如果他们想要相信中国大陆现在有很多好的东西，他们也有新闻可以看。
Rúguǒ tāmen xiǎngyào xiāngxìn zhōngguó dàlù xiànzài yǒu hěnduō hǎo de dōngxi, tāmen yě yǒu xīnwén kěyǐ kàn.
If they want to believe the mainland has lots of good things now, there's news for that too.
所以就是要看你相信的是什么，然后你要看的东西是什么。
Suǒyǐ jiùshì yào kàn nǐ xiāngxìn de shì shénme, ránhòu nǐ yào kàn de dōngxi shì shénme.
So it depends on what you believe and what you choose to look at.
对。那因为我觉得在台湾，就算你是真的真的很没有钱的人，你是可以去学校上学，你是可以学习。
Duì. Nà yīnwèi wǒ juéde zài táiwān, jiùsuàn nǐ shì zhēnde zhēnde hěn méiyǒu qián de rén, nǐ shì kěyǐ qù xuéxiào shàngxué, nǐ shì kěyǐ xuéxí.
Right. Because I think in Taiwan, even if you're really, really poor, you can still go to school and study.
所以这部分，我可能觉得台湾的贫富差距也有，可是没有像中国这么大。
Suǒyǐ zhèbùfèn, wǒ kěnéng juéde táiwān de pínfùchājù yě yǒu, kěshì méiyǒu xiàng zhōngguó zhème dà.
So on this, I'd say Taiwan has a wealth gap too, but not as big as China's.
就是有的人很有钱，没有钱的人很没有钱。
Jiùshì yǒu de rén hěn yǒuqián, méiyǒu qián de rén hěn méiyǒu qián.
Some people are very rich, and the poor are very poor.
所以我是很讨厌中国的有钱人，我真的很讨厌他们。
Suǒyǐ wǒ shì hěn tǎoyàn zhōngguó de yǒuqiánrén, wǒ zhēnde hěn tǎoyàn tāmen.
So I really dislike China's rich people; I really do.
然后我觉得很多时候我们没有机会看到穷人的生活，对不对？
Ránhòu wǒ juéde hěnduō shíhou wǒmen méiyǒu jīhuì kàndào qióngrén de shēnghuó, duì bù duì?
And I think much of the time we don't get to see how poor people live, right?
因为穷人的生活没有什么可以看的。
Yīnwèi qióngrén de shēnghuó méiyǒu shénme kěyǐ kàn de.
Because there's not much to see in poor people's lives.
很多时候看到的是上海啊，你看上海，楼那么高，那么有钱。
Hěnduō shíhou kàndào de shì shànghǎi a, nǐ kàn shànghǎi, lóu nàme gāo, nàme yǒuqián.
What you usually see is Shanghai — look at Shanghai, such tall buildings, so rich.
对，但是我知道中国当然有穷人，因为我现在也有的时候给在中国没有钱去学校的孩子他们钱，所以当然当然有这样的。
Duì, dànshì wǒ zhīdào zhōngguó dāngrán yǒu qióngrén, yīnwèi wǒ xiànzài yě yǒu de shíhou gěi zài zhōngguó méiyǒu qián qù xuéxiào de háizi tāmen qián, suǒyǐ dāngrán dāngrán yǒu zhèyàng de.
Right, but I know of course China has poor people, because I sometimes give money to children in China who can't afford school; so of course they exist.
当然。但是中国人就是吃饭，是可以吃茶叶蛋的。茶叶蛋是应该吃得起，一天一个应该还是可以的。
Dāngrán. Dànshì zhōngguó rén jiùshì chīfàn, shì kěyǐ chī cháyèdàn de. Cháyèdàn shì yīnggāi chīdéqǐ, yītiān yíge yīnggāi háishi kěyǐ de.
Of course. But when it comes to eating, Chinese people can eat tea eggs. They should be able to afford a tea egg — one a day should still be fine.
好，了解了。所以这个新闻是假的。
Hǎo, liǎojiě le. Suǒyǐ zhège xīnwén shì jiǎ de.
OK, got it. So that news is fake.
我觉得很好笑，这个新闻。对，就是在吃饭上，我觉得现在中国应该没有太大的问题。
Wǒ juéde hěn hǎoxiào, zhège xīnwén. Duì, jiùshì zài chīfàn shàng, wǒ juéde xiànzài zhōngguó yīnggāi méiyǒu tàidà de wèntí.
I find that news funny. Yes, when it comes to food, I think China shouldn't have big problems now.
可能吃得一般般，但是大部分的人是可以吃到好的东西。海鲜呢？吃得起吗？
Kěnéng chī de yìbānbān, dànshì dàbùfen de rén shì kěyǐ chī dào hǎo de dōngxi. Hǎixiān ne? Chīdéqǐ ma?
Maybe the food is just so-so, but most people can eat good things. What about seafood? Can they afford it?
海鲜比较贵一点，对吧？
Hǎixiān bǐjiào guì yìdiǎn, duì ba?
Seafood is a bit more expensive, right?
要看地方，因为中国太大了。如果在海边，有海鲜，但是如果不在海边，那他们可能就不常常吃海鲜，他们可能吃牛肉啊……
Yào kàn dìfang, yīnwèi zhōngguó tàidà le. Rúguǒ zài hǎibiān, yǒu hǎixiān, dànshì rúguǒ bù zài hǎibiān, nà tāmen kěnéng jiù bù chángcháng chīhǎixiān, tāmen kěnéng chī niúròu a……
It depends on the place, because China is so big. By the sea there's seafood, but away from the sea people probably don't eat it often; they might eat beef…
猪肉啊、羊肉啊。所以要看地方，每个地方很不一样。
Zhūròu a, yángròu a. Suǒyǐ yào kàn dìfang, měigè dìfang hěn bù yīyàng.
pork, lamb. So it depends on the place; every place is very different.
OK，了解，懂了。
⁢OK⁢, liǎojiě, dǒng le.
OK, got it, I understand.
blocks.h: 穷到吃不起茶叶蛋？ · Too poor to afford a tea egg?

lines: 好，谢谢素清老师帮我解答，告诉我对的答案。
Hǎo, xièxie Sù Qīng lǎoshī bāng wǒ jiědá, gàosu wǒ duì de dáàn.
OK, thank you Su Qing for answering and telling me the right answers.
不是对的答案，是我的看法啊。OK，好好好。
Búshi duì de dáàn, shì wǒ de kànfǎ a. ⁢OK⁢, hǎohǎo hǎo.
They're not the right answers, they're my opinions. OK, OK.
对，我觉得有的时候我很吃惊，就是台湾人对中国的了解很少很少。
Duì, wǒ juéde yǒu de shíhou wǒ hěn chījīng, jiùshì táiwānrén duì zhōngguó de liǎojiě hěnshǎo hěnshǎo.
Yes, I'm sometimes surprised by how little Taiwanese people know about China.
然后呢我觉得，为什么呢？我会觉得有一点点可惜。因为我常常想，有的时候你不喜欢一个地方，没有关系，但是我觉得你应该去看一看。
Ránhòu ne wǒ juéde, wèishénme ne? Wǒhuì juéde yǒu yìdiǎndiǎn kěxī. Yīnwèi wǒ chángcháng xiǎng, yǒu de shíhou nǐ bù xǐhuan yíge dìfang, méiyǒu guānxi, dànshì wǒ juéde nǐ yīnggāi qù kànyīkàn.
And I wonder why. I find it a bit of a pity. Because I often think it's fine not to like a place, but you should go and have a look.
然后你决定：可能这个地方有我不喜欢的地方，但是也有我喜欢的地方。
Ránhòu nǐ juédìng: kěnéng zhège dìfang yǒu wǒ bù xǐhuan de dìfang, dànshì yě yǒu wǒ xǐhuan de dìfang.
And then decide: maybe this place has things I don't like, but also things I like.
我觉得很有道理，因为有时候我们可能是自己想，但是去了那个地方，你才发现……
Wǒ juédehěnyǒu dàoli, yīnwèi yǒushíhou wǒmen kěnéng shì zìjǐ xiǎng, dànshì qù le nàge dìfang, nǐ cái fāxiàn……
I think that makes a lot of sense, because sometimes we just imagine things, but only when you go there do you find…
跟我想的不一样。所以要多去看看。
Gēn wǒ xiǎng de bù yīyàng. Suǒyǐ yào duō qù kànkan.
it's different from what I thought. So you should go and see more.
我觉得所有的人不要完全相信媒体。
Wǒ juéde suǒyǒu de rén búyào wánquán xiāngxìn méitǐ.
I think nobody should completely trust the media.
对，可以去看一看。你去看了，你去了几次，然后你觉得：“哦，我就是不喜欢中国大陆。”
Duì, kěyǐ qù kànyīkàn. Nǐ qù kàn le, nǐ qù le jǐcì, ránhòu nǐ juéde: "o, wǒ jiùshì bù xǐhuan zhōngguó dàlù."
Right, go and have a look. You go and see, you go a few times, and then you think: "I just don't like mainland China."
那好，那我觉得因为你看了，你更知道，所以你不喜欢，没有问题。
Nàhǎo, nà wǒ juéde yīnwèi nǐ kàn le, nǐ gèng zhīdào, suǒyǐ nǐ bù xǐhuan, méiyǒu wèntí.
Fine — because you've seen it and know more, it's no problem if you don't like it.
对，但是如果你只听媒体的，那可能和真实的中国大陆可能还是不太一样的。没错。
Duì, dànshì rúguǒ nǐ zhǐ tīng méitǐ de, nà kěnéng hé zhēnshí de zhōngguó dàlù kěnéng háishi bùtài yīyàng de. Méicuò.
Right, but if you only listen to the media, it may still be quite different from the real mainland. Exactly.
好的。那我要问问大家，你们呢？你们想象的中国大陆是什么样的？
Hǎo de. Nà wǒ yào wènwèn dàjiā, nǐmen ne? Nǐmen xiǎngxiàng de zhōngguó dàlù shì shénmeyàng de?
OK. So let me ask everyone: what about you? What do you imagine mainland China is like?
是不是觉得我们很穷，很可怜，然后我们的政府一直看着我们，我们都很害怕？
Shìbúshì juéde wǒmen hěnqióng, hěn kělián, ránhòu wǒmen de zhèngfǔ yìzhí kànzhe wǒmen, wǒmen dōu hěn hàipà?
Do you think we're very poor and pitiful, and that our government watches us all the time and we're all scared?
对，欢迎大家留言告诉我们。
Duì, huānyíng dàjiā liúyán gàosu wǒmen.
Right, you're welcome to leave a comment and tell us.
blocks.h: 多去看看 · Go and see for yourself

q: 贝拉去过中国大陆很多次。
Bèilā qùguò zhōngguó dàlù hěn duōcì.
Bella has been to mainland China many times.
tf.why: She has never been there.

q: 贝拉以前在爱尔兰卖很贵的包。
Bèilā yǐqián zài àiěrlán mài hěn guì de bāo.
Bella used to sell expensive bags in Ireland.
tf.why: She sold brands like LV and Chanel.

q: 那个大妈买包以前，想看看包是不是中国做的。
Nàge dàmā mǎibāo yǐqián, xiǎng kànkan bāo shìbúshì zhōngguó zuò de.
Before buying, the lady wanted to check whether the bag was made in China.
tf.why: She asked whether the bag was made in China.

q: 素清说，中国人一直都很相信中国制造的东西。
Sù Qīng shuō, zhōngguó rén yìzhí dōu hěn xiāngxìn zhōngguó zhìzào de dōngxi.
Su Qing says Chinese people have always trusted Chinese-made products.
tf.why: For a long time they didn't trust them much.

q: 素清说大疆是一家日本公司。
Sù Qīng shuō Dàjiāng shì yìjiā rìběngōngsī.
Su Qing says DJI is a Japanese company.
tf.why: DJI is a Chinese company.

q: 素清觉得“淘宝”的“淘”是“掏东西”的“掏”。
Sù Qīng juéde "Táobǎo"de "táo"shì "tāo dōngxi"de "tāo".
Su Qing thinks the 淘 in 淘宝 is the 掏 of 'digging things out'.
tf.why: It's the 淘 of 淘金, sifting out good things.

q: 现在在中国说“去淘宝”，可能是去别的App买东西。
Xiànzài zài zhōngguó shuō "qù Táobǎo", kěnéng shì qù biéde ⁢App⁢ mǎi dōngxi.
Nowadays in China, 'going to Taobao' may mean shopping on another app.
tf.why: It can mean Xiaohongshu or JD; it has become a general word.

q: 贝拉已经用过刷手支付。
Bèilā yǐjīng yòngguò shuāshǒuzhīfù.
Bella has already used palm payment.
tf.why: She saw it in the news and was a bit scared of it.

q: 素清觉得刷手支付比密码更安全。
Sù Qīng juéde shuāshǒuzhīfù bǐ mìmǎ gèng ānquán.
Su Qing thinks palm payment is safer than a password.
tf.why: Hackers can find passwords, but nobody can really steal your hand.

q: 素清说澳大利亚已经到处都用刷手支付了。
Sù Qīng shuō Àodàlìyà yǐjīng dàochù dōu yòng shuāshǒuzhīfù le.
Su Qing says palm payment is already used everywhere in Australia.
tf.why: Australia is slow with new things; people use cash, cards and phones.

q: 素清每个月都去上海看穷人的生活。
Sù Qīng měigè yuè dōu qù shànghǎi kàn qióngrén de shēnghuó.
Su Qing goes to Shanghai every month to see how poor people live.
tf.why: She only says she sometimes gives money to children who can't afford school.

q: 素清觉得中国人一般都吃得起茶叶蛋。
Sù Qīng juéde zhōngguó rén yìbān dōu chīdéqǐ cháyèdàn.
Su Qing thinks Chinese people can generally afford tea eggs.
tf.why: One tea egg a day should be fine for most people.

q: 素清希望大家完全相信媒体。
Sù Qīng xīwàng dàjiā wánquán xiāngxìn méitǐ.
Su Qing wants everyone to trust the media completely.
tf.why: She says not to trust the media completely, and to go and see.

q: 素清说，中国人在国外不想买中国做的东西，一个原因是什么？
Sù Qīng shuō, zhōngguó rén zài guówài bùxiǎng mǎi zhōngguó zuò de dōngxi, yíge yuányīn shì shénme?
According to Su Qing, one reason Chinese people abroad don't want China-made goods is…
o: Zài zhōngguó jiù kěyǐ mǎi dào
they can buy them in China
other countries don't sell Chinese goods
the tour guide won't let them
mc.why: Why buy it in Ireland when you can buy it at home?

q: “性价比高”是什么意思？
"xìngjiàbǐ gāo"shì shénme yìsi?
What does 性价比高 mean?
mc.why: 性价比 is value for money.

q: 贝拉为什么觉得刷手支付有一点可怕？
Bèilā wèishénme juéde shuāshǒuzhīfù yǒu yìdiǎn kěpà?
Why does Bella find palm payment a bit scary?
o: 手没有密码，别人可能知道她所有的东西
Shǒu méiyǒu mìmǎ, biéren kěnéng zhīdào tā suǒyǒu de dōngxi
a hand has no password, so others might know everything about her
it can't be used in Taiwan
mc.why: With a phone she has a password; a hand has nothing like that.

q: 在台湾有什么新闻？
Zài táiwān yǒu shénme xīnwén?
What news was there in Taiwan?
o: 有些中国人穷到吃不起茶叶蛋
Yǒuxiē zhōngguó rénqióng dào chībùqǐ cháyèdàn
some Chinese people are too poor to afford a tea egg
tea eggs are getting more expensive
Zhōngguó rén bù xǐhuan chī jīdàn
mc.why: The news said some people couldn't even afford a tea egg.

q: 为什么现在“淘宝”在中国大陆变成了一个普通的词？
Wèishénme xiànzài "Táobǎo"zài zhōngguó dàlù biànchéng le yíge pǔtōng de cí?
Why has 淘宝 become an ordinary word on the mainland?
ans: 因为淘宝可能是最早的购物App，所以现在“去淘宝”就是去App或者网上买东西的意思。
Yīnwèi Táobǎo kěnéng shì zuìzǎo de gòuwù ⁢App⁢, suǒyǐ xiànzài "qù Táobǎo"jiùshì qù ⁢App⁢ huòzhě wǎngshàng mǎi dōngxi de yìsi.
Because Taobao was probably the earliest shopping app, so now 'going to Taobao' just means buying things on an app or online.

q: 素清为什么不太担心政府知道她的信息？
Sù Qīng wèishénme bùtài dānxīn zhèngfǔ zhīdào tā de xìnxī?
Why isn't Su Qing very worried about the government knowing her information?
ans: 因为她觉得政府已经知道所有的信息，她也不做不好的事；只要政府不偷她的钱，让生活更方便就可以。
Yīnwèi tā juéde zhèngfǔ yǐjīng zhīdào suǒyǒu de xìnxī, tā yě bù zuò bùhǎo de shì; zhǐyào zhèngfǔ bùtōu tā de qián, ràng shēnghuó gèng fāngbiàn jiù kěyǐ.
Because she thinks the government already knows everything and she doesn't do anything bad; as long as it doesn't steal her money and makes life more convenient, it's fine.

q: 素清给台湾人什么建议？
Sù Qīng gěi táiwānrén shénme jiànyì?
What advice does Su Qing give to Taiwanese people?
ans: 不要完全相信媒体，应该自己去中国大陆看一看，然后再决定喜欢不喜欢。
Búyào wánquán xiāngxìn méitǐ, yīnggāi zìjǐ qù zhōngguó dàlù kànyīkàn, ránhòu zài juédìng xǐhuan bù xǐhuan.
Don't completely trust the media; go and see the mainland yourself, then decide whether you like it.

003.title: Simplified vs Traditional Chinese
003.transcriptNote: 素清 Sù Qīng (mainland China) talks with 西卡 Xīkǎ, a teacher from Taiwan. Fillers like 嗯 and 呃 are mostly left out; a few unclear words were reconstructed from context.

lines: 你们好！欢迎来到Lazy Chinese的播客。
Nǐmenhǎo! Huānyíng láidào ⁢Lazy⁢ ⁢Chinese⁢ de bōkè.
Hello! Welcome to the Lazy Chinese podcast.
今天是我素清和西卡。Hello！
Jīntiān shì wǒ Sù Qīng hé Xīkǎ. ⁢Hello⁢!
Today it's me, Su Qing, and Xika. Hello!
那今天呢，我们想要聊一个话题，我们觉得你们可能想过这个问题。
Nà jīntiān ne, wǒmen xiǎngyào liáo yíge huàtí, wǒmen juéde nǐmen kěnéng xiǎngguò zhège wèntí.
Today we want to talk about a topic we think you may have wondered about.
你们知道，在中国大陆我们用的汉字是比较简单的。
Nǐmen zhīdào, zài zhōngguó dàlù wǒmen yòng de hànzì shì bǐjiàojiǎndān de.
As you know, the characters we use in mainland China are relatively simple.
在台湾呢，你们用的汉字是比较难的。不一样。
Zài táiwān ne, nǐmen yòng de hànzì shì bǐjiào nán de. Bù yīyàng.
In Taiwan, the characters you use are more difficult. They're different.
是的。那我们用的汉字叫简体字，你们用的汉字叫繁体字，对吧？对，繁体字。
Shì de. Nà wǒmen yòng de hànzì jiào jiǎntǐzì, nǐmen yòng de hànzì jiào fántǐzì, duì ba? Duì, fántǐzì.
Yes. The characters we use are called simplified characters, and yours are called traditional characters, right? Right, traditional.
好，那你们可能想过：所以我们学习了简体字，那我们可以看得懂繁体字吗？
Hǎo, nà nǐmen kěnéng xiǎngguò: suǒyǐ wǒmen xuéxí le jiǎntǐzì, nà wǒmen kěyǐ kàndedǒng fántǐzì ma?
OK, so you may have wondered: if we've learned simplified characters, can we read traditional ones?
然后台湾人可以看得懂简体字吗？对。
Ránhòu táiwānrén kěyǐ kàndedǒng jiǎntǐzì ma? Duì.
And can Taiwanese people read simplified characters? Right.
今天我们就要来聊一聊这个问题。好的。
Jīntiān wǒmen jiùyào láiliáo yīliáo zhège wèntí. Hǎo de.
Today we're going to talk about this question. OK.
blocks.h: 开场 · Today's topic

lines: 那西卡，你现在简体字和繁体字，你都看得懂吗？
Nà Xīkǎ, nǐ xiànzài jiǎntǐzì hé fántǐzì, nǐ dōu kàndedǒng ma?
So Xika, can you read both simplified and traditional characters now?
对，我都看得懂，两个都可以。
Duì, wǒ dōu kàndedǒng, liǎnggè dōu kěyǐ.
Yes, I can read both; either is fine.
你会不会觉得看繁体字更容易、更轻松？
Nǐ huì búhuì juéde kàn fántǐzì gèng róngyì, gèng qīngsōng?
Do you find reading traditional characters easier, more relaxed?
我觉得一样。哦，你觉得一样。
Wǒ juéde yīyàng. O, nǐ juéde yīyàng.
I think it's the same. Oh, you think it's the same.
是的，我觉得我看简体，看繁体，是差不多的。
Shì de, wǒ juéde wǒ kàn jiǎntǐ, kàn fántǐ, shì chàbuduō de.
Yes, I think reading simplified and reading traditional are about the same for me.
可能有时候有一个字，一个简体字，我会停一下，我想：这是什么字？
Kěnéng yǒushíhou yǒu yíge zì, yíge jiǎntǐzì, wǒhuì tíng yīxià, wǒ xiǎng: zhèshì shénme zì?
Maybe sometimes there's a character, a simplified one, where I stop for a moment and think: what character is this?
可是因为你可以从句子的意思，然后词，你可以知道：哦，是这个字。
Kěshì yīnwèi nǐ kěyǐ cóng jùzi de yìsi, ránhòu cí, nǐ kěyǐ zhīdào: o, shì zhège zì.
But from the meaning of the sentence and the word, you can tell: oh, it's this character.
所以会突然停一下，可是大部分的时候我觉得是一样的，没有问题。
Suǒyǐ huì tūrán tíng yīxià, kěshì dàbùfen de shíhou wǒ juéde shì yīyàng de, méiyǒu wèntí.
So I might suddenly pause, but most of the time it's the same, no problem.
哇，那你觉得别的台湾人和你一样吗？他们也可以看得懂简体字吗？
Wa, nà nǐ juéde biéde táiwānrén hé nǐ yīyàng ma? Tāmen yě kěyǐ kàndedǒng jiǎntǐzì ma?
Wow, so do you think other Taiwanese people are like you? Can they read simplified characters too?
我觉得他们是看得懂的。如果他们需要看简体字，没问题。
Wǒ juéde tāmen shì kàndedǒng de. Rúguǒ tāmen xūyào kàn jiǎntǐzì, méi wèntí.
I think they can. If they need to read simplified characters, it's no problem.
可能看得不是很快，可是看得懂。
Kěnéng kàn de búshi hěnkuài, kěshì kàndedǒng.
Maybe they don't read very fast, but they understand.
明白。你觉得你可以看得懂很多简体字的原因是什么呢？
Míngbai. Nǐ juéde nǐ kěyǐ kàndedǒng hěnduō jiǎntǐzì de yuányīn shì shénme ne?
I see. Why do you think you can read so many simplified characters?
我觉得……我想，因为台湾用的繁体是比较难的，就是有比较多笔画。
Wǒ juéde…… Wǒ xiǎng, yīnwèi táiwān yòng de fántǐ shì bǐjiào nán de, jiùshì yǒu bǐjiào duō bǐhuà.
I think… I think because the traditional characters used in Taiwan are harder; they have more strokes.
所以如果你从比较难的东西开始，然后看比较简单的，会比较容易。我觉得这是一个原因。
Suǒyǐ rúguǒ nǐ cóng bǐjiào nán de dōngxi kāishǐ, ránhòu kàn bǐjiàojiǎndān de, huì bǐjiào róngyì. Wǒ juéde zhèshì yíge yuányīn.
So if you start with the harder thing and then read the simpler one, it's easier. I think that's one reason.
有可能。我也觉得。西卡，那我是学习简体字的人，你觉得我看繁体字会不会觉得很难？
Yǒu kěnéng. Wǒ yě juéde. Xīkǎ, nà wǒ shì xuéxí jiǎntǐzì de rén, nǐ juéde wǒ kàn fántǐzì huì búhuì juéde hěnnán?
Possibly. I think so too. Xika, I learned simplified characters — do you think I'd find traditional characters hard?
对，我很好奇。
Duì, wǒ hěn hàoqí.
Yes, I'm curious.
可是我觉得，你也一样，可能你看得懂，可是比较难，你会觉得要想一下。
Kěshì wǒ juéde, nǐ yě yīyàng, kěnéng nǐ kàndedǒng, kěshì bǐjiào nán, nǐ huì juéde yào xiǎng yīxià.
But I think it's the same for you: you can probably read them, but it's harder; you'd have to think a bit.
可是如果你看很多很多，你习惯了，你觉得没问题。
Kěshì rúguǒ nǐ kàn hěnduōhěnduō, nǐ xíguàn le, nǐ juéde méi wèntí.
But if you read a lot, you get used to it and it's no problem.
是吗？我以前觉得在中国所有人都可以看得懂简体和繁体。
Shì ma? Wǒ yǐqián juéde zài zhōngguó suǒyǒurén dōu kěyǐ kàndedǒng jiǎntǐ hé fántǐ.
Really? I used to think everyone in China could read both simplified and traditional.
但是最近我发现，可能不是这样的。
Dànshì zuìjìn wǒ fāxiàn, kěnéng búshi zhèyàng de.
But recently I've found that maybe it's not like that.
我在中国的App小红书看到，有更年轻的人他们说，他们看繁体觉得有一点点难。
Wǒ zài zhōngguó de ⁢App⁢ Xiǎohóngshū kàndào, yǒu gèng niánqīng de rén tāmen shuō, tāmen kàn fántǐ juéde yǒu yìdiǎndiǎn nán.
On the Chinese app Xiaohongshu I saw younger people saying they find traditional characters a bit hard to read.
然后我说：“诶？”所以有的人是觉得看繁体是比较难的。
Ránhòu wǒ shuō: "éi?"suǒyǐ yǒu de rén shì juéde kàn fántǐ shì bǐjiào nán de.
And I thought: "Huh?" So some people do find traditional harder to read.
但是我，我没有很大的问题。
Dànshì wǒ, wǒ méiyǒu hěndà de wèntí.
But for me it's not a big problem.
没有很大的问题，但是不是非常容易。
Méiyǒu hěndà de wèntí, dànshì búshi fēichángróngyì.
Not a big problem, but not very easy either.
对，因为平时我发信息给素清的时候……
Duì, yīnwèi píngshí wǒfā xìnxī gěi Sù Qīng de shíhou……
Right, because when I send Su Qing messages…
我用繁体字，我没有把它换成简体字。
Wǒyòng fántǐzì, wǒ méiyǒu bǎ tā huànchéng jiǎntǐzì.
I use traditional characters; I don't change them to simplified.
哦，那个很简单，就是日常说的东西，我们每一天说的东西，对我是没有问题的。
O, nàge hěn jiǎndān, jiùshì rìcháng shuō de dōngxi, wǒmen měi yītiān shuō de dōngxi, duì wǒ shì méiyǒu wèntí de.
Oh, that's easy — everyday things, things we say every day, are no problem for me.
然后我们发信息的时候都是很短的东西，没有问题。
Ránhòu wǒmen fā xìnxī de shíhou dōu shì hěn duǎn de dōngxi, méiyǒu wèntí.
And when we message it's always short things, so no problem.
但是我和你一样，可能有的时候有一两个字，我说：“哎，这个是什么？这个我没有见过。”
Dànshì wǒ hé nǐ yīyàng, kěnéng yǒu de shíhou yǒu yīliǎnggè zì, wǒ shuō: "āi, zhège shì shénme? Zhège wǒ méiyǒu jiànguò."
But I'm like you: sometimes there are one or two characters and I say: "Hey, what's this? I've never seen it."
blocks.h: 西卡看得懂简体字吗？ · Can Xika read simplified characters?

lines: 那西卡，你看得懂简体字，你觉得是你需要学习的吗？
Nà Xīkǎ, nǐ kàndedǒng jiǎntǐzì, nǐ juéde shì nǐ xūyào xuéxí de ma?
So Xika, you can read simplified characters — do you think it's something you had to study?
我觉得不需要，因为我不记得我特别说：“好，我现在要学习简体字。”没有。
Wǒ juéde bù xūyào, yīnwèi wǒ bù jìde wǒ tèbié shuō: "hǎo, wǒ xiànzài yào xuéxí jiǎntǐzì."méiyǒu.
I don't think so, because I don't remember specially saying: "OK, now I'm going to study simplified characters." No.
我看多了以后，我看得懂。我不需要坐下来说我要学习简体字，然后我看得懂。
Wǒ kàn duō le yǐhòu, wǒ kàndedǒng. Wǒ bù xūyào zuòxia láishuō wǒyào xuéxí jiǎntǐzì, ránhòu wǒ kàndedǒng.
After reading a lot, I could read them. I didn't need to sit down and say I'm going to study simplified characters; I just could.
我以前也觉得很简单：如果你知道简体字，你就可以看得懂繁体字，或者你知道繁体字，你就可以看得懂简体字。
Wǒ yǐqián yě juéde hěn jiǎndān: rúguǒ nǐ zhīdào jiǎntǐzì, nǐ jiù kěyǐ kàndedǒng fántǐzì, huòzhě nǐ zhīdào fántǐzì, nǐ jiù kěyǐ kàndedǒng jiǎntǐzì.
I also used to think it was simple: if you know simplified, you can read traditional, or if you know traditional, you can read simplified.
但是我现在想一想，哎，可能我有学习过繁体字。怎么学？
Dànshì wǒ xiànzài xiǎngyīxiǎng, āi, kěnéng wǒ yǒu xuéxí guo fántǐzì. Zěnme xué?
But now that I think about it, maybe I did study traditional characters. How?
有两个。第一个是在中国的学校，我们有书法。
Yǒu liǎnggè. Dìyígè shì zài zhōngguó de xuéxiào, wǒmen yǒu shūfǎ.
Two ways. First, in Chinese schools we have calligraphy.
我们用毛笔。对，你要写。
Wǒmen yòng máobǐ. Duì, nǐ yào xiě.
We use a brush. Right, you have to write.
是的，我们写书法的时候呢，我们不写简体字，我们需要写繁体字，因为繁体字比较多笔画，所以比较漂亮，比较大。
Shì de, wǒmen xiě shūfǎ de shíhou ne, wǒmen bùxiě jiǎntǐzì, wǒmen xūyào xiě fántǐzì, yīnwèi fántǐzì bǐjiào duō bǐhuà, suǒyǐ bǐjiào piàoliang, bǐjiào dà.
Yes, when we do calligraphy we don't write simplified characters; we write traditional ones, because they have more strokes, so they're prettier and bigger.
这个是第一个。小的时候我写书法，我写繁体字，所以呢我知道繁体字。
Zhège shì dìyígè. Xiǎo de shíhou wǒ xiě shūfǎ, wǒ xiě fántǐzì, suǒyǐ ne wǒ zhīdào fántǐzì.
That's the first. As a child I did calligraphy in traditional characters, so I know them.
然后第二个，我觉得很有意思。我小的时候发现有很多……
Ránhòu dìèrgè, wǒ juédehěnyǒu yìsi. Wǒ xiǎo de shíhou fāxiàn yǒu hěnduō……
And the second, which I find interesting. When I was little I noticed there were lots of…
MV，不知道英语是不是说MV。啊，是音乐的视频。对。
⁢MV⁢, bù zhīdào yīngyǔ shìbúshì shuō ⁢MV⁢. A, shì yīnyuè de shìpín. Duì.
MVs — I'm not sure if English says MV. Oh, music videos. Right.
对，小的时候我发现，就是可能小的时候中国还没有很多钱，可是呢那个时候台湾更有钱。
Duì, xiǎo de shíhou wǒ fāxiàn, jiùshì kěnéng xiǎo de shíhou zhōngguó hái méiyǒu hěnduō qián, kěshì ne nàge shíhou táiwān gèng yǒuqián.
Right, when I was little — China didn't have much money yet back then, but Taiwan was richer.
然后呢，我看了很多台湾来的MV，还有香港来的MV。
Ránhòu ne, wǒ kàn le hěnduō táiwān lái de ⁢MV⁢, háiyǒu xiānggǎng lái de ⁢MV⁢.
So I watched lots of music videos from Taiwan and Hong Kong.
所有的那个字幕都是繁体字。
Suǒyǒu de nàge zìmù dōu shì fántǐzì.
All the subtitles were in traditional characters.
啊，对对对，歌词，对吗？他们会有歌词，唱歌的时候的，这个字是繁体的，是吗？
A, duì duì duì, gēcí, duì ma? Tāmen huì yǒu gēcí, chànggē de shíhou de, zhège zì shì fántǐ de, shì ma?
Oh, right, the lyrics? There are lyrics while they sing, and those were in traditional characters?
对对对。好的，很有趣。
Duì duì duì. Hǎo de, hěn yǒuqù.
Yes, yes. OK, that's interesting.
所以我觉得其实我是学习了，不是说很认真坐下来学。我也写过繁体字，书法写了一点点。
Suǒyǐ wǒ juéde qíshí wǒ shì xuéxí le, búshi shuō hěn rènzhēn zuòxia láixué. Wǒ yě xiě guo fántǐzì, shūfǎ xiě le yìdiǎndiǎn.
So I think I actually did learn them — not by seriously sitting down to study. I've written traditional characters too, a little in calligraphy.
但是我觉得，如果我没有写过繁体字，如果MV的歌词不是繁体字，那我还可以认识吗？我不知道。
Dànshì wǒ juéde, rúguǒ wǒ méiyǒu xiěguò fántǐzì, rúguǒ ⁢MV⁢ de gēcí búshi fántǐzì, nà wǒ hái kěyǐ rènshi ma? Wǒ bù zhīdào.
But I wonder: if I'd never written traditional characters, and the MV lyrics weren't in traditional, would I still recognise them? I don't know.
哦，这个算CI吗？对，我觉得这个就是我以前的CI。
O, zhège suàn ⁢CI⁢ ma? Duì, wǒ juéde zhège jiùshì wǒ yǐqián de ⁢CI⁢.
Oh, does that count as comprehensible input? Yes, I think that was my comprehensible input back then.
然后我想：为什么现在有中国的年轻人说他们不太认识繁体字？是不是因为现在他们看的很多MV就是简体字，没有繁体字了？
Ránhòu wǒ xiǎng: wèishénme xiànzài yǒu zhōngguó de niánqīngrén shuō tāmen bùtài rènshi fántǐzì? Shìbúshì yīnwèi xiànzài tāmen kàn de hěnduō ⁢MV⁢ jiùshì jiǎntǐzì, méiyǒu fántǐzì le?
And I wondered: why do young people in China now say they don't really know traditional characters? Is it because the MVs they watch are all in simplified now?
对，因为中国有自己的东西，所以所有的东西是简体字。
Duì, yīnwèi zhōngguó yǒu zìjǐ de dōngxi, suǒyǐ suǒyǒu de dōngxi shì jiǎntǐzì.
Right, because China has its own stuff, so everything is in simplified.
是的，现在中国大陆也有钱。
Shì de, xiànzài zhōngguó dàlù yě yǒuqián.
Yes, now mainland China has money too.
所以呢在中国大陆有越来越多的歌手，然后呢我们也有越来越多的MV。
Suǒyǐ ne zài zhōngguó dàlù yǒu yuèláiyuè duō de gēshǒu, ránhòu ne wǒmen yě yǒu yuèláiyuè duō de ⁢MV⁢.
So the mainland has more and more singers, and more and more MVs.

Wǒ bù zhīdào, kěnéng.
I don't know, maybe.

lines: 对。然后所以你小的时候，你小的时候就看过繁体字。对。

Duì duì duì. Wǒ juéde wǒ dìyīcì kàndào jiǎntǐzì shì zài xuéxiào, xuéxiào de lǎoshīshàngkè xiě hēibǎn de shíhou, tāmen yòng jiǎntǐzì.
Yes. I think the first time I saw simplified characters was at school — when teachers wrote on the blackboard in class, they used simplified characters.
知道吗？不是全部的字，可是有一些字他用，因为比较快。
Zhīdào ma? Búshi quánbù de zì, kěshì yǒu yìxiē zì tāyòng, yīnwèi bǐjiào kuài.

然后我们学生写笔记，我们也写简体字，因为比较快，就是只有几个字。
Ránhòu wǒmen xuésheng xiě bǐjì, wǒmen yě xiě jiǎntǐzì, yīnwèi bǐjiào kuài, jiùshì zhǐyǒu jǐge zì.
And we students wrote simplified characters in our notes too, because it's quicker — just a few characters.
我们那个时候……我不知道很多简体字。
Wǒmen nàge shíhou…… Wǒ bù zhīdào hěnduō jiǎntǐzì.

现在我也不会写。我会看，可是我觉得我可能写不出来。
Xiànzài wǒ yě búhuì xiě. Wǒhuì kàn, kěshì wǒ juéde wǒ kěnéng xiě bù chulai.
Even now I can't write them. I can read them, but I probably couldn't write them.
可是我第一个，我最早知道的简体字是“动”。
Kěshì wǒ dìyígè, wǒ zuìzǎo zhīdào de jiǎntǐzì shì "dòng".
But the first simplified character I learned was 动.
哎，我们给学生看一下是哪一个“动”。我写一个简体，然后写一个繁体的“动”。
Āi, wǒmen gěi xuésheng kàn yīxià shì na yíge "dòng". Wǒ xiě yíge jiǎntǐ, ránhòu xiě yíge fántǐ de "dòng".
Let's show the students which 动 it is. I'll write the simplified one and then the traditional 动.
对。我最记得的有两个字，就是“动”，还有“体”，身体的“体”。
Duì. Wǒ zuì jìde de yǒu liǎnggè zì, jiùshì "dòng", háiyǒu "tǐ", shēntǐ de "tǐ".
Right. The two I remember best are 动 and 体, the 体 of 身体 "body".
哦，身体的“体”，繁体字很难，简体字很简单，对不对？对对。
O, shēntǐ de "tǐ", fántǐzì hěnnán, jiǎntǐzì hěn jiǎndān, duì bù duì? Duì duì.

好有意思啊。我真的很吃惊，就是台湾的老师会写简体字。
Hǎo yǒuyìsi a. Wǒ zhēnde hěn chījīng, jiùshì táiwān de lǎoshī huì xiě jiǎntǐzì.

Duì. Hǎo, zhège shì "yùndòng"de "dòng". Duì.

那这个我觉得是它的发音，对不对？可能，我也不知道。
Nà zhège wǒ juéde shì tā de fāyīn, duì bù duì? Kěnéng, wǒ yě bù zhīdào.

因为这里少一个东西，我完全想不起来。

Because something is missing here, and I can't remember it at all.
OK，所以如果你们觉得繁体字很难，没有关系，西卡老师也觉得很难。对，很难。
⁢OK⁢, suǒyǐ rúguǒ nǐmen juéde fántǐzì hěnnán, méiyǒu guānxi, Xīkǎ lǎoshī yě juéde hěnnán. Duì, hěnnán.

现在大家都打字，对吗？
Xiànzài dàjiā dōu dǎzì, duì ma?

我记得它的形状，它长什么样子，可是是大概的样子。你叫我写，我想不起来。

简体真的好简单啊！哇，是的。你们的“忧郁”，这个是什么？我不知道，我也不记得。厉害厉害，已经很好了。

那个乌龟的“龟”真的好难。所以真的你也不记得所有的汉字，这个应该可以让学生感觉好一点：他们也不记得，你也不记得。
