我觉得不新鲜了。我同意，我同意。
Wǒ juéde bù xīnxiān le. Wǒ tóngyì, wǒ tóngyì.
I think they're not fresh any more. I agree, I agree.
对，有的时候在澳大利亚，你看到他们卖的荔枝是黑色的，黑色的荔枝。对，因为已经非常不新鲜。
Duì, yǒu de shíhou zài Àodàlìyà, nǐ kàndào tāmen mài de lìzhī shì hēisè de, hēisè de lìzhī. Duì, yīnwèi yǐjīng fēicháng bù xīnxiān.
Right, in Australia sometimes the lychees they sell are black. Black lychees. Yes, because they're very stale.
现在我明白为什么有很多人说他们不喜欢吃荔枝。我觉得是因为他们没有吃到新鲜的荔枝。
Xiànzài wǒ míngbai wèishénme yǒu hěnduō rén shuō tāmen bù xǐhuan chī lìzhī. Wǒ juéde shìyīnwèi tāmen méiyǒu chī dào xīnxiān de lìzhī.
Now I understand why lots of people say they don't like lychees. I think it's because they've never had fresh ones.
我同意。我也听过有一个英国人觉得荔枝不好吃，为什么呢？因为他只吃过罐头的荔枝，他没有吃过新鲜的荔枝。
Wǒ tóngyì. Wǒ yě tīng guo yǒu yíge yīngguórén juéde lìzhī bù hǎochī, wèishénme ne? Yīnwèi tā zhǐ chī guo guàntou de lìzhī, tā méiyǒu chī guo xīnxiān de lìzhī.
I agree. I heard of an English person who thought lychees didn't taste good. Why? Because he'd only had tinned lychees, never fresh ones.
太浪费了！太浪费了，太可惜了，对不对？太可惜了。
Tài làngfèi le! Tài làngfèi le, tài kěxī le, duì bù duì? Tài kěxī le.
What a waste! Such a waste, such a pity, right? Such a pity.
是的，我觉得荔枝新鲜的真的不一样。真的不一样。我知道，我懂我懂。
Shì de, wǒ juéde lìzhī xīnxiān de zhēnde bù yīyàng. Zhēnde bù yīyàng. Wǒ zhīdào, wǒ dǒng wǒ dǒng.
Yes, fresh lychees really are different. Really different. I know, I get it.
blocks.h: 荔枝 · Lychees

lines: 那阿慧老师，现在你在你的老家吗？哦，我不在。
Nà Ā Huì lǎoshī, xiànzài nǐ zài nǐ de lǎojiā ma? O, wǒ bù zài.
So A Hui, are you in your hometown now? Oh, no, I'm not.
我不在，我已经离开我的老家很长一段时间了。
Wǒ bù zài, wǒ yǐjīng líkāi wǒ de lǎojiā hěncháng yīduànshíjiān le.
I'm not; I left my hometown a long time ago.
我现在在贵州，我现在在贵州另一个城市。
Wǒ xiànzài zài guìzhōu, wǒ xiànzài zài guìzhōu lìng yíge chéngshì.
I'm in Guizhou now, in another city in Guizhou.
它离我的老家有点远。如果我坐高铁，要差不多六个小时。
Tā lí wǒ de lǎojiā yǒudiǎn yuǎn. Rúguǒ wǒ zuò gāotiě, yào chàbuduō liùgè xiǎoshí.
It's a bit far from my hometown. By high-speed train it takes about six hours.
六个小时，对啊，很远。但是我也不想回我的老家。
Liùgè xiǎoshí, duì a, hěn yuǎn. Dànshì wǒ yě bùxiǎng huí wǒ de lǎojiā.
Six hours, right, that's far. But I don't want to go back to my hometown anyway.
我觉得老家离我太近了。对对对。你呢？
Wǒ juéde lǎojiā lí wǒ tàijìn le. Duì duì duì. Nǐ ne?
I feel my hometown is too close to me. Yes. And you?
素清，你有回你的老家吗？最近？
Sù Qīng, nǐ yǒu huí nǐ de lǎojiā ma? Zuìjìn?
Su Qing, have you been back to your hometown? Recently?
最近一次是今年的三月、四月的时候回了老家。
Zuìjìn yīcì shì jīnnián de sānyuè, sìyuè de shíhou huí le lǎojiā.
The last time was this March or April.
我告诉很多人，我真的从小到大都很不喜欢我的老家。
Wǒ gàosu hěnduō rén, wǒ zhēnde cóngxiǎodàodà dōu hěn bù xǐhuan wǒ de lǎojiā.
I've told lots of people that I've really disliked my hometown ever since I was small.
为什么呢？我觉得可能在老家看到的很多东西，我不太明白为什么他们是这样的。
Wèishénme ne? Wǒ juéde kěnéng zài lǎojiā kàndào de hěnduō dōngxi, wǒ bù tài míngbai wèishénme tāmen shì zhèyàng de.
Why? I think there are lots of things I saw at home that I don't really understand.
我给你一个例子。在我的老家，可能这一点和广东有一点点像：有重男轻女的问题。
Wǒ gěi nǐ yíge lìzi. Zài wǒ de lǎojiā, kěnéng zhè yìdiǎn hé guǎngdōng yǒu yìdiǎndiǎn xiàng: yǒu zhòngnánqīngnǚ de wèntí.
Let me give you an example. In my hometown — maybe a bit like Guangdong — people value sons over daughters.
很多人更喜欢儿子，不喜欢女儿，这是一个。
Hěnduō rén gèng xǐhuan érzi, bù xǐhuan nǚér, zhèshì yíge.
Lots of people prefer sons to daughters; that's one thing.
那你不想要待在一个不喜欢女人的地方，对不对？是的。
Nà nǐ bù xiǎngyào dài zài yíge bù xǐhuan nǚren de dìfang, duì bù duì? Shì de.
And you don't want to stay in a place that doesn't like women, right? Yes.
blocks.h: 离开老家 · Leaving home

lines: 还有一个我记得很清楚的点是，每一次我回老家的时候，我会看到女人在做饭、切菜、洗碗。
Háiyǒu yíge wǒ jìde hěn qīngchu de diǎn shì, měi yīcì wǒ huílǎojiā de shíhou, wǒhuì kàndào nǚren zài zuòfàn, qiècài, xǐwǎn.
Another thing I remember clearly is that every time I go home, I see women cooking, chopping vegetables and washing dishes.
对，很辛苦。然后男人先吃。
Duì, hěn xīnkǔ. Ránhòu nánrén xiān chī.
Right, it's hard work. And the men eat first.
男人吃完以后，女人他们的工作忙完了，那他们来吃。
Nánrén chī wán yǐhòu, nǚren tāmen de gōngzuò máng wán le, nà tāmen lái chī.
After the men have eaten and the women have finished their work, then they come to eat.
我很讨厌这个东西。哦，所以在你的老家，他们是男人先吃，女人才能吃饭。
Wǒ hěn tǎoyàn zhège dōngxi. O, suǒyǐ zài nǐ de lǎojiā, tāmen shì nánrén xiān chī, nǚren cáinéng chīfàn.
I hate this. Oh, so in your hometown the men eat first, and only then can the women eat.
不是说女人才能吃，但是因为女人要做太多的工作，所以有的时候她们来吃的时候，可能那个男人已经吃了很多。
Búshi shuō nǚren cáinéng chī, dànshì yīnwèi nǚren yào zuò tài duō de gōngzuò, suǒyǐ yǒu de shíhou tāmen lái chī de shíhou, kěnéng nàge nánrén yǐjīng chī le hěnduō.
It's not that women aren't allowed to eat, but because they have so much work, by the time they come to eat the men may have eaten most of it.
那男人吃到的都是好的饭菜，那女人吃到的都是剩菜。有一点这个感觉。啊，有一点这个感觉。
Nà nánrén chī dào de dōu shì hǎo de fàncài, nà nǚren chī dào de dōu shì shèngcài. Yǒu yìdiǎn zhège gǎnjué. A, yǒu yìdiǎn zhège gǎnjué.
So the men get the good food and the women get the leftovers. It feels a bit like that. Yes, a bit like that.
然后如果你去福建，你会发现福建人非常非常喜欢喝茶。
Ránhòu rúguǒ nǐ qù fújiàn, nǐ huì fāxiàn fújiànrén fēicháng fēicháng xǐhuan hēchá.
And if you go to Fujian, you'll find Fujianese people really love tea.
那大部分的时候你可以看到一个叔叔在泡茶，然后呢，叔叔泡茶、吃东西、抽烟、聊天，然后女人在厨房很忙。
Nà dàbùfen de shíhou nǐ kěyǐ kàndào yíge shūshu zài pàochá, ránhòu ne, shūshu pàochá, chī dōngxi, chōuyān, liáotiān, ránhòu nǚren zài chúfáng hěn máng.
Most of the time you'll see an uncle making tea; the uncles make tea, snack, smoke and chat, while the women are busy in the kitchen.
对。所以我觉得，这个地方真的不太喜欢女人。
Duì. Suǒyǐ wǒ juéde, zhège dìfang zhēnde bùtài xǐhuan nǚren.
Right. So I feel this place really doesn't like women.
blocks.h: 女人在厨房 · Women in the kitchen

lines: 我觉得我们的老家很像，因为我们那边也有一个事情，我记了很久。
Wǒ juéde wǒmen de lǎojiā hěn xiàng, yīnwèi wǒmen nàbian yě yǒu yíge shìqing, wǒjì le hěn jiǔ.
I think our hometowns are very similar, because there's something from mine that I've remembered for a long time.
就是在我家里，我的妈妈和我的爷爷是同一天生日。
Jiùshì zài wǒ jiālǐ, wǒ de māma hé wǒ de yéye shì tóngyītiān shēngrì.
In my family, my mum and my grandfather have the same birthday.
他们是同一天生日。本来这是一件很开心的事情，对吧？
Tāmen shì tóngyītiān shēngrì. Běnlái zhèshì yījiàn hěn kāixīn de shìqing, duì ba?
Same birthday. That should be a happy thing, right?
很好的事情啊。但是每一年，我爷爷生日，他的儿子、他的女儿大家都会过来吃饭，为了给他庆祝他的生日。
Hěn hǎo de shìqing a. Dànshì měi yīnián, wǒ yéye shēngrì, tā de érzi, tā de nǚér dàjiā dōu huì guòlai chīfàn, wèile gěi tā qìngzhù tā de shēngrì.
A lovely thing. But every year on my grandfather's birthday, his sons and daughters all come for a meal to celebrate.
对吧？如果有很多人来家里，你觉得女人会做什么？女人需要做饭，对吧？
Duì ba? Rúguǒ yǒu hěnduō rénlái jiālǐ, nǐ juéde nǚren huì zuò shénme? Nǚren xūyào zuòfàn, duì ba?
Right? If lots of people come over, what do you think the women do? The women have to cook, right?
这也是我们老家的习惯。
Zhè yě shì wǒmen lǎojiā de xíguàn.
That's also the custom in our hometown.
你的妈妈需要做饭。对，是的。在她生日这一天，本来她也是应该要庆祝生日的那个人。
Nǐ de māma xūyào zuòfàn. Duì, shì de. Zài tā shēngrì zhè yītiān, běnlái tā yě shì yīnggāi yào qìngzhù shēngrì de nàge rén.
Your mum has to cook. Yes. On her own birthday, when she should also be celebrated.
但是她被困在了厨房里，她也在厨房里不断做饭、做饭、做饭。
Dànshì tā bèikùn zài le chúfáng lǐ, tā yě zài chúfáng lǐ búduàn zuòfàn, zuòfàn, zuòfàn.
But she's stuck in the kitchen, cooking, cooking, cooking nonstop.
所以她的生日变成了她最忙的那一天。对，就是这样。
Suǒyǐ tā de shēngrì biànchéng le tā zuìmáng de nà yītiān. Duì, jiùshì zhèyàng.
So her birthday turned into her busiest day. Yes, that's how it is.
所以我非常明白。好像这些老家都有一个共性，就是女人在里面过得很辛苦。女人在这个地方会过得很辛苦。
Suǒyǐ wǒ fēicháng míngbai. Hǎoxiàng zhèxiē lǎojiā dōu yǒu yíge gòngxìng, jiùshì nǚren zài lǐmiàn guòdé hěn xīnkǔ. Nǚren zài zhège dìfang huìguò de hěn xīnkǔ.
I completely understand. These hometowns seem to have something in common: women have a hard life there.
我不知道中国别的地方，但是我常常听到福建、广东有这个问题，就是女人真的很辛苦。
Wǒ bù zhīdào zhōngguó biéde dìfang, dànshì wǒ chángcháng tīngdào fújiàn, guǎngdōng yǒu zhège wèntí, jiùshì nǚren zhēnde hěn xīnkǔ.
I don't know about other parts of China, but I often hear that Fujian and Guangdong have this problem: women really have it hard.
需要做很多家里面的事情，很多的家务。
Xūyào zuò hěnduō jiā lǐmiàn de shìqing, hěnduō de jiāwù.
They have to do lots of things at home, lots of housework.
对，然后做饭也需要很长的时间。
Duì, ránhòu zuòfàn yě xūyào hěncháng de shíjiān.
Right, and cooking takes a long time too.
特别是在广东，你们吃的东西又非常好，所以女人在厨房的时间更长了。对，做饭就更麻烦了。
Tèbiéshìzài guǎngdōng, nǐmen chī de dōngxi yòu fēicháng hǎo, suǒyǐ nǚren zài chúfáng de shíjiān gèngcháng le. Duì, zuòfàn jiù gèng máfan le.
Especially in Guangdong, where the food is so good, women spend even longer in the kitchen. Right, cooking is even more work.
做饭要准备很多很多东西。她可能早上八点就起来去买菜，然后做饭，做到午饭，做到两点。
Zuòfàn yào zhǔnbèi hěnduōhěnduō dōngxi. Tā kěnéng zǎoshang bādiǎn jiù qǐlai qù mǎicài, ránhòu zuòfàn, zuòdào wǔfàn, zuòdào liǎngdiǎn.
Cooking means preparing lots of things. She might get up at eight to buy food, then cook until lunch, until two.
好，大家吃完饭之后，要准备开蛋糕了嘛，那你要把所有的碗都收拾好，打扫干净。
Hǎo, dàjiā chīwánfàn zhīhòu, yào zhǔnbèi kāi dàngāo le ma, nà nǐ yào bǎ suǒyǒu de wǎn dōu shōushi hǎo, dǎsǎo gānjìng.
Then after everyone has eaten, it's time to cut the cake, so you have to clear all the bowls and clean up.
好，打扫干净，大家开蛋糕。这个时候呢，家里只有一个蛋糕，因为两个人一起生日，所以只有一个蛋糕。
Hǎo, dǎsǎo gānjìng, dàjiā kāi dàngāo. Zhège shíhou ne, jiālǐ zhǐyǒu yíge dàngāo, yīnwèi liǎnggè rén yìqǐ shēngrì, suǒyǐ zhǐyǒu yíge dàngāo.
OK, cleaned up, time for cake. But there's only one cake, because two people share the birthday.
因为是爷爷的生日嘛，所以我们的蛋糕上面一般是一个桃子，对吧？
Yīnwèi shì yéye de shēngrì ma, suǒyǐ wǒmen de dàngāo shàngmiàn yìbān shì yíge táozi, duì ba?
And since it's grandpa's birthday, the cake usually has a peach on top, right?
中国老人喜欢那个桃子的蛋糕，因为中国有一个东西叫“寿桃”。
Zhōngguó lǎorén xǐhuan nàge táozi de dàngāo, yīnwèi zhōngguó yǒu yíge dōngxi jiào "shòutáo".
Older Chinese people like peach cakes, because in China there's something called 寿桃, the "longevity peach".
就是你吃了这个桃子，然后你会活很长的时间。是的是的，是这个意思吗？
Jiùshì nǐ chī le zhège táozi, ránhòu nǐhuìhuó hěncháng de shíjiān. Shì de shì de, shì zhège yìsi ma?
If you eat this peach you'll live a long time. Yes — is that what it means?
没错，吃了这个桃子，你可以活到一百岁，代表你可以活得很久。
Méicuò, chī le zhège táozi, nǐ kěyǐ huó dào yìbǎisuì, dàibiǎo nǐ kěyǐ huódé hěn jiǔ.
Exactly: eat this peach and you'll live to a hundred; it stands for a long life.
一般这种蛋糕是给老人的，可能是六十岁、七十岁的老人才会用到这个桃子的蛋糕。但是我妈妈也一起用这个蛋糕庆祝她的生日。
Yìbān zhèzhǒng dàngāo shì gěi lǎorén de, kěnéng shì liùshísuì, qīshísuì de lǎo réncái huì yòngdào zhège táozi de dàngāo. Dànshì wǒ māma yě yìqǐ yòng zhège dàngāo qìngzhù tā de shēngrì.
Usually this kind of cake is for old people, sixty or seventy. But my mum celebrated her birthday with the same cake.
对，就是这样。
Duì, jiùshì zhèyàng.
Yes, that's how it was.
所以我会觉得，我的妈妈很辛苦。
Suǒyǐ wǒhuì juéde, wǒ de māma hěn xīnkǔ.
So I feel my mum has a hard life.
如果我在这个地方留下去，我可能也会变成一样的。是的，我会成为另一个我的妈妈的感觉。
Rúguǒ wǒ zài zhège dìfang liúxià qù, wǒ kěnéng yě huì biànchéng yīyàng de. Shì de, wǒhuì chéngwéi lìng yíge wǒ de māma de gǎnjué.
If I stayed in that place, I might end up the same. Yes — like I'd become another version of my mum.
对，我觉得这也是一个我不想留在老家的原因。
Duì, wǒ juéde zhè yě shì yíge wǒ bùxiǎng liúzài lǎojiā de yuányīn.
Right, I think that's also a reason I don't want to stay in my hometown.
blocks.h: 同一天的生日 · The shared birthday

lines: 你还有别的不想留在福建的原因吗？
Nǐ háiyǒu biéde bùxiǎng liúzài fújiàn de yuányīn ma?
Do you have other reasons for not wanting to stay in Fujian?
我觉得福建在中国，它没有很多别的地方的文化。
Wǒ juéde fújiàn zài zhōngguó, tā méiyǒu hěnduō biéde dìfang de wénhuà.
I think Fujian, within China, doesn't have many cultures from other places.
就是我可能比较喜欢住在大城市，我觉得我在北京会感觉比较舒服。
Jiùshì wǒ kěnéng bǐjiào xǐhuan zhù zài dàchéngshì, wǒ juéde wǒ zài běijīng huì gǎnjué bǐjiào shūfu.
I probably prefer living in big cities; I feel more comfortable in Beijing.
因为在福建的时候，我觉得大部分的人想法都是差不多的。
Yīnwèi zài fújiàn de shíhou, wǒ juéde dàbùfen de rén xiǎngfǎ dōu shì chàbuduō de.
Because in Fujian I feel most people think the same way.
可是在北京的时候，我觉得我可以看到更多不一样的想法。
Kěshì zài běijīng de shíhou, wǒ juéde wǒ kěyǐ kàndào gèng duō bù yīyàng de xiǎngfǎ.
But in Beijing I feel I can see many more different ideas.
然后我会更喜欢北京这种大的城市。那我现在在澳大利亚悉尼。
Ránhòu wǒhuì gèng xǐhuan běijīng zhèzhǒng dà de chéngshì. Nà wǒ xiànzài zài Àodàlìyà xīní.
So I prefer big cities like Beijing. And now I'm in Sydney, Australia.
那澳大利亚悉尼的想法又更多，因为有不同国家来的人。对，我会觉得很舒服。
Nà Àodàlìyà xīní de xiǎngfǎ yòu gèng duō, yīnwèi yǒu bùtóng guójiā lái de rén. Duì, wǒhuì juéde hěn shūfu.
Sydney has even more different ideas, because there are people from different countries. Yes, I feel very comfortable.
在福建，你会觉得所有人都做这样的事情，你也应该做这样的事情。
Zài fújiàn, nǐ huì juéde suǒyǒurén dōu zuò zhèyàng de shìqing, nǐ yě yīnggāi zuò zhèyàng de shìqing.
In Fujian you feel everyone does things a certain way, so you should too.
但是我会觉得，在北京或者像悉尼这样的地方，每个人的选择、每个人的生活不一样，你做不一样的东西，大家可以接受。
Dànshì wǒhuì juéde, zài běijīng huòzhě xiàng xīní zhèyàng de dìfang, měigè rén de xuǎnzé, měigè rén de shēnghuó bù yīyàng, nǐ zuò bù yīyàng de dōngxi, dàjiā kěyǐ jiēshòu.
But in places like Beijing or Sydney, everyone's choices and lives are different, and if you do things differently people accept it.
我更喜欢这样的地方，你呢？我觉得也是一样的。但对我来说，我觉得更重要的是……
Wǒ gèng xǐhuan zhèyàng de dìfang, nǐ ne? Wǒ juéde yě shì yīyàng de. Dàn duì wǒ láishuō, wǒ juéde gèng zhòngyào de shì……
I prefer places like that. And you? I feel the same. But for me, what matters more is…
那里的人，有没有比较特别的东西会留下你。
Nàli de rén, yǒuméiyǒu bǐjiào tèbié de dōngxi huì liúxià nǐ.
whether there's something special about the people there that makes you stay.
比如，我相信很多人留在他自己的老家，是因为家里面有他更熟悉的人，他爱的人或者爱他的人会更多一点。
Bǐrú, wǒ xiāngxìn hěnduō rén liúzài tā zìjǐ de lǎojiā, shìyīnwèi jiā lǐmiàn yǒu tā gèng shúxī de rén, tā ài de rén huòzhě ài tā de rénhuì gèng duōyìdiǎn.
For example, I believe many people stay in their hometown because there are more people they know — more people they love or who love them.
对吧？那你去到别的城市，如果那个城市对你来说有新鲜的感觉……
Duì ba? Nà nǐ qù dào biéde chéngshì, rúguǒ nàge chéngshì duì nǐ láishuō yǒu xīnxiān de gǎnjué……
Right? So if you go to another city and it feels fresh to you…
有一种“我不认识它，所以我有很多地方可以去看，我有很多东西可以去吃，有很多我没有做过的事情可以在这个地方做”……
Yǒu yìzhǒng "wǒ bù rènshi tā, suǒyǐ wǒ yǒu hěnduō dìfang kěyǐ qù kàn, wǒ yǒu hěnduō dōngxi kěyǐ qù chī, yǒu hěnduō wǒ méiyǒu zuòguò de shìqing kěyǐ zài zhège dìfang zuò"……
a feeling of "I don't know it, so there are lots of places to see, lots of things to eat, lots of things I've never done that I can do here"…
那我觉得这个城市就很有意思，那我会想要去那个城市去生活一段时间。
Nà wǒ juéde zhège chéngshì jiù hěn yǒuyìsi, nà wǒhuì xiǎngyào qù nàge chéngshì qù shēnghuó yīduànshíjiān.
then I find the city interesting and I'd want to go and live there for a while.
对，这个是我的想法。
Duì, zhège shì wǒ de xiǎngfǎ.
Right, that's my view.
blocks.h: 大城市，不同的想法 · Big cities, different ideas

lines: 那你去过的中国的这些城市里，你觉得哪一个城市对你来说是很有意思的？我现在会觉得泉州……
Nà nǐ qùguò de zhōngguó de zhèxiē chéngshì lǐ, nǐ juéde na yíge chéngshì duì nǐ láishuō shì hěn yǒuyìsi de? Wǒ xiànzài huì juéde Quánzhōu……
Of the Chinese cities you've been to, which one do you find interesting? Now I'd say Quanzhou…
哎，是你的老家！你，福建。我知道。我会觉得泉州对我来说非常的舒服。
Āi, shì nǐ de lǎojiā! Nǐ, fújiàn. Wǒ zhīdào. Wǒhuì juéde Quánzhōu duì wǒ láishuō fēicháng de shūfu.
Hey, that's your home province! Fujian. I know. I find Quanzhou very comfortable.
而且它的文化、它的人，都让我很舒服。他们的性格，他们的生活很慢，对吧？
Érqiě tā de wénhuà, tā de rén, dōu ràng wǒ hěn shūfu. Tāmen de xìnggé, tāmen de shēnghuó hěnmàn, duì ba?
And its culture and people make me feel at ease. Their personality — they live slowly, right?
他们生活很慢，节奏很慢。
Tāmen shēnghuó hěnmàn, jiézòu hěnmàn.
They live slowly; the pace is slow.
但他们也不是说什么事情都不做，他们也会有一些很有新鲜感的事情。
Dàn tāmen yě búshi shuō shénme shìqing dōu bù zuò, tāmen yě huì yǒu yìxiē hěn yǒu xīnxiāngǎn de shìqing.
But it's not that they do nothing; they also do some very fresh things.
比如在广场上面，他们摆了很多凳子在广场上面。
Bǐrú zài guǎngchǎng shàngmiàn, tāmen bǎi le hěnduō dèngzi zài guǎngchǎng shàngmiàn.
For example, they put lots of stools out on the square.
就让大家走过路过的时候，散步的时候，可以到那里坐下去休息一下。
Jiùràng dàjiā zǒuguò lùguò de shíhou, sànbù de shíhou, kěyǐ dào nàli zuòxia qù xiūxi yīxià.
So when people walk past or go for a stroll, they can sit down there and rest.
到那里休息一下。我觉得这些是一些新的元素，它很有意思。
Dào nàli xiūxi yīxià. Wǒ juéde zhèxiē shì yìxiē xīn de yuánsù, tā hěn yǒuyìsi.
Have a rest there. I think those are new elements, and they're interesting.
然后它旧的元素，我也觉得很有意思。
Ránhòu tā jiù de yuánsù, wǒ yě juédehěnyǒu yìsi.
And I find its old elements interesting too.
比如他们信奉很多神仙，对吧？在泉州有非常多的神仙。
Bǐrú tāmen xìnfèng hěnduō shénxiān, duì ba? Zài Quánzhōu yǒu fēicháng duō de shénxiān.
For example, they worship lots of gods, right? Quanzhou has a great many gods.
那人和神的关系在这里就很有意思。
Nàrén hé shén de guānxi zài zhèlǐ jiù hěn yǒuyìsi.
The relationship between people and gods there is really interesting.
人会和神仙去说自己的心事。我觉得这个也很有意思，就是在其他地方你很少见到的人和神的关系。
Rénhuì hé shénxiān qù shuō zìjǐ de xīnshì. Wǒ juéde zhège yě hěn yǒuyìsi, jiùshì zài qítā dìfang nǐ hěnshǎo jiàndào de rén hé shén de guānxi.
People tell the gods what's on their minds. I find that interesting — a relationship between people and gods you rarely see elsewhere.
比如说，我在我的老家，我看到的人和神的关系是：“我希望神能给我什么东西，求求你一定要给我。”
Bǐrúshuō, wǒ zài wǒ de lǎojiā, wǒ kàndào de rén hé shén de guānxi shì: "wǒ xīwàng shénnéng gěi wǒ shénme dōngxi, qiúqiú nǐ yídìng yào gěi wǒ."
For example, in my hometown, the relationship I saw was: "I hope the god gives me something — please, you must give it to me."
但我在泉州感受到的人和神的关系是：“我今天做了一些什么事情，我想来跟神说一说。”就是发发牢骚，说一些闲话。
Dàn wǒ zài Quánzhōu gǎnshòu dào de rén hé shén de guānxi shì: "wǒ jīntiān zuò le yìxiē shénme shìqing, wǒ xiǎnglái gēn shén shuōyīshuō."jiùshì fā fāláosāo, shuō yìxiē xiánhuà.
But in Quanzhou what I felt was: "Here's what I did today; I want to tell the god about it." Just grumbling a bit, making small talk.
聊聊天，就只是这样而已。我就觉得很有意思：哦，原来也可以不用求那么多东西，就只是和神聊聊天，给这个神带一杯奶茶，你知道吗？
Liáoliáotiān, jiù zhǐshì zhèyàng éryǐ. Wǒ jiù juédehěnyǒu yìsi: o, yuánlái yě kěyǐ búyòng qiú nàme duō dōngxi, jiù zhǐshì hé shén liáoliáotiān, gěi zhège shéndài yībēi nǎichá, nǐ zhīdào ma?
Just chatting, that's all. I found it interesting: oh, you don't have to ask for so much; you can just chat with the god and bring them a cup of milk tea, you know?
现在他们去看这个神仙，他们会带奶茶。
Xiànzài tāmen qù kàn zhège shénxiān, tāmen huìdài nǎichá.
Now when they visit the god, they bring milk tea.
对，所以我觉得跟我认识的人和神的关系不一样，有很多有新鲜感的事情，我会觉得很有意思。
Duì, suǒyǐ wǒ juéde gēn wǒ rènshi de rén hé shén de guānxi bù yīyàng, yǒu hěnduō yǒu xīnxiāngǎn de shìqing, wǒhuì juédehěnyǒu yìsi.
Right, so it's different from the people–god relationship I knew; lots of fresh things, which I find interesting.
blocks.h: 泉州：人和神 · Quanzhou: people and gods

lines: 你知道吗？我的老家虽然不是泉州，但是我在我的老家，我们有很多东西可能差不太多。
Nǐ zhīdào ma? Wǒ de lǎojiā suīrán búshi Quánzhōu, dànshì wǒ zài wǒ de lǎojiā, wǒmen yǒu hěnduō dōngxi kěnéng chàbùtàiduō.
You know what? My hometown isn't Quanzhou, but we have many similar things there.
我小的时候，每年春节的时候——春节可能一号、七号，我不知道，十五号——每年春节的时候，我需要带吃的东西去拜神仙。
Wǒ xiǎo de shíhou, měinián chūnjié de shíhou—— chūnjié kěnéng yīhào, qīhào, wǒ bù zhīdào, shíwǔhào—— měinián chūnjié de shíhou, wǒ xūyào dài chī de dōngxi qù bài shénxiān.
When I was little, every Spring Festival — maybe on the 1st, the 7th, I'm not sure, the 15th — I had to take food to worship the gods.
我小的时候非常非常讨厌这个东西。为什么呢？
Wǒ xiǎo de shíhou fēicháng fēicháng tǎoyàn zhège dōngxi. Wèishénme ne?
As a child I really, really hated it. Why?
因为你害怕？很麻烦？哦，不是很麻烦……
Yīnwèi nǐ hàipà? Hěn máfan? O, búshi hěn máfan……
Because you were scared? Because it was a hassle? Oh, not a hassle…
因为我是一个小孩子，我就觉得和爸爸妈妈要去一个很远的地方，然后我也不知道做这个是为了什么。
Yīnwèi wǒ shì yíge xiǎoháizi, wǒ jiù juéde hé bàbàmāmā yào qù yíge hěnyuǎn de dìfang, ránhòu wǒ yě bù zhīdào zuò zhège shì wèile shénme.
Because I was a child, I felt I had to go somewhere far away with my parents, and I didn't know what it was for.
对，所以我小时候非常讨厌这个东西，我觉得很麻烦。
Duì, suǒyǐ wǒ xiǎoshíhou fēicháng tǎoyàn zhège dōngxi, wǒ juéde hěn máfan.
Right, so as a child I hated it; I found it a hassle.
因为你需要准备，你要准备猪肉，可能别的吃的东西，然后你需要带这些东西……
Yīnwèi nǐ xūyào zhǔnbèi, nǐ yào zhǔnbèi zhūròu, kěnéng biéde chī de dōngxi, ránhòu nǐ xūyào dài zhèxiē dōngxi……
Because you had to prepare pork and maybe other food, and carry it all…
走很远的路。对一个孩子，那个路感觉好远好远，好累，太累了。
Zǒu hěn yuǎn de lù. Duì yíge háizi, nàge lù gǎnjué hǎoyuǎn hǎo yuǎn, hǎo lèi, tàilèi le.
and walk a long way. For a child the road felt so, so far, so tiring.
然后在泉州，好像大家就是跟神仙聊聊天。
Ránhòu zài Quánzhōu, hǎoxiàng dàjiā jiùshì gēn shénxiān liáoliáotiān.
And in Quanzhou people seem to just chat with the gods.
但是我小的时候在我的老家，我觉得我爸爸妈妈去拜神仙，就是要求东西的。
Dànshì wǒ xiǎo de shíhou zài wǒ de lǎojiā, wǒ juéde wǒ bàbàmāmā qù bài shénxiān, jiùshì yāoqiú dōngxi de.
But when I was little in my hometown, I felt my parents worshipped the gods to ask for things.
在我的老家，可能和神仙不一样。对。那你去的这个地方，泉州和我的老家有一个最大的不一样，最大的区别是……
Zài wǒ de lǎojiā, kěnéng hé shénxiān bù yīyàng. Duì. Nà nǐ qù de zhège dìfang, Quánzhōu hé wǒ de lǎojiā yǒu yíge zuìdà de bù yīyàng, zuìdà de qūbié shì……
In my hometown it may be different with the gods. Right. And the place you went to, Quanzhou, has one big difference from my hometown…
我觉得泉州比较有钱。哦，有可能，是吧？
Wǒ juéde Quánzhōu bǐjiào yǒuqián. O, yǒu kěnéng, shì ba?
I think Quanzhou is richer. Oh, possibly, right?
因为泉州以前是有很多商人，甚至有很多外国人会到泉州去做生意。
Yīnwèi Quánzhōu yǐqián shì yǒu hěnduō shāngrén, shènzhì yǒu hěnduō wàiguórén huìdào Quánzhōu qù zuòshēngyì.
Because Quanzhou used to have lots of merchants; even many foreigners went there to trade.
对，所以它可能是一个有钱人比较多的城市。对，以前是。
Duì, suǒyǐ tā kěnéng shì yíge yǒuqiánrén bǐjiào duō de chéngshì. Duì, yǐqián shì.
Right, so it may be a city with more rich people. Yes, in the past.
是的。我觉得我去泉州的时候，觉得泉州的东西不是很便宜，是比较贵的。
Shì de. Wǒ juéde wǒ qù Quánzhōu de shíhou, juéde Quánzhōu de dōngxi búshi hěn piányi, shì bǐjiào guì de.
Yes. When I went to Quanzhou I felt things weren't cheap; they were rather expensive.
我觉得他们是比较有钱的，所以可能有了钱以后是可以放松一点。
Wǒ juéde tāmen shì bǐjiào yǒuqián de, suǒyǐ kěnéng yǒuleqián yǐhòu shì kěyǐ fàngsōng yìdiǎn.
I think they're relatively well-off, and with money you can relax a bit.
但是在我的老家，可能还是不太一样。
Dànshì zài wǒ de lǎojiā, kěnéng háishi bùtài yīyàng.
But in my hometown it's probably still different.
哦，这个还蛮特别的。就是你去到同一个城市，可能我们的感受都是不一样的。
O, zhège hái mán tèbié de. Jiùshì nǐ qù dào tóngyīgè chéngshì, kěnéng wǒmen de gǎnshòu dōu shì bù yīyàng de.
Oh, that's quite something: we go to the same kind of place, but we feel differently.
你有这样的感受，是因为你小时候被拉去拜拜，对吧？你要去准备很多东西。
Nǐ yǒu zhèyàng de gǎnshòu, shìyīnwèi nǐ xiǎoshíhou bèilāqù bàibai, duì ba? Nǐ yào qù zhǔnbèi hěnduō dōngxi.
You feel that way because you were dragged along to worship as a child, right? You had to prepare lots of things.
对。但是我作为一个游客去到那个地方，我只是看他们每天的生活是怎么样的。对对，我就觉得很舒服，你不需要做那些活，对不对？
Duì. Dànshì wǒ zuòwéi yíge yóukè qù dào nàge dìfang, wǒ zhǐshì kàn tāmen měitiān de shēnghuó shì zěnmeyàng de. Duì duì, wǒ jiù juéde hěn shūfu, nǐ bù xūyào zuò nàxiē huó, duì bù duì?
Right. But as a tourist I just watch how they live every day. Yes, and I feel comfortable — you don't have to do the work, right?
对，你不需要做这个东西。
Duì, nǐ bù xūyào zuò zhège dōngxi.
Right, you don't have to do it.
是的。有一点像很多游客去到日本，觉得日本那么干净，那么安静，那么方便，太好了。
Shì de. Yǒu yìdiǎn xiàng hěnduō yóukè qù dào rìběn, juéde rìběn nàme gānjìng, nàme ānjìng, nàme fāngbiàn, tàihǎole.
Yes. It's a bit like tourists who go to Japan and think it's so clean, so quiet, so convenient — wonderful.
那如果你在那里工作，还是那么好吗？那不一定，对不对？是的是的，没错。
Nà rúguǒ nǐ zài nàli gōngzuò, háishi nàme hǎo ma? Nà bù yídìng, duì bù duì? Shì de shì de, méicuò.
But if you worked there, would it still be so good? Not necessarily, right? Yes, exactly.
所以我觉得我也是一个喜欢不同文化的人。我去到别的地方，我可以看他们在做什么，我觉得是很有趣的事情。
Suǒyǐ wǒ juéde wǒ yě shì yíge xǐhuan bùtóng wénhuà de rén. Wǒ qù dào biéde dìfang, wǒ kěyǐ kàn tāmen zài zuò shénme, wǒ juéde shì hěn yǒuqù de shìqing.
So I'm also someone who likes different cultures. When I go somewhere else, watching what people do is really interesting to me.
但如果我是生活在这里的人，我可能会觉得很多时候传统的文化有点麻烦。有点麻烦。
Dàn rúguǒ wǒ shì shēnghuó zài zhèlǐ de rén, wǒ kěnéng huì juéde hěnduō shíhou chuántǒng de wénhuà yǒudiǎn máfan. Yǒudiǎn máfan.
But if I lived there, I might often find traditional culture a bit of a hassle. A bit of a hassle.
对。我会对这些事情很好奇，但是可能是因为我没有去做，所以我会好奇。
Duì. Wǒhuì duì zhèxiē shìqing hěn hàoqí, dànshì kěnéng shìyīnwèi wǒ méiyǒu qù zuò, suǒyǐ wǒhuì hàoqí.
Right. I'm curious about these things, but maybe only because I don't have to do them.
但是你已经从小就做了很多，你就觉得：“对我来说只有麻烦，没有好奇。”对吧？
Dànshì nǐ yǐjīng cóngxiǎo jiù zuò le hěnduō, nǐ jiù juéde: "duì wǒ láishuō zhǐyǒu máfan, méiyǒu hàoqí."duì ba?
But you've done it so much since childhood that you feel: "For me it's just a hassle, no curiosity." Right?
对对对，因为我看得太多了，我会觉得：为什么我们要一直做一样的东西？很无聊，我想要快点离开，然后去更放松的地方。
Duì duì duì, yīnwèi wǒ kàn de tài duō le, wǒhuì juéde: wèishénme wǒmen yào yìzhí zuò yīyàng de dōngxi? Hěn wúliáo, wǒ xiǎngyào kuàidiǎn líkāi, ránhòu qù gèng fàngsōng de dìfang.
Yes, because I've seen too much of it; I think: why do we always do the same things? It's boring; I want to leave quickly and go somewhere more relaxed.
blocks.h: 小时候拜神 · Worshipping gods as a child

lines: 哎，那我很好奇，你觉得对你来说，现在你在的这个地方有家的感觉吗？
Āi, nà wǒ hěn hàoqí, nǐ juéde duì nǐ láishuō, xiànzài nǐ zài de zhège dìfang yǒujiā de gǎnjué ma?
So I'm curious: does the place you're in now feel like home to you?
你刚刚说你想要快点离开这个地方，去一个新的让我放松的地方。你觉得现在的地方是你放松的地方吗？
Nǐ gānggang shuō nǐ xiǎngyào kuàidiǎn líkāi zhège dìfang, qù yíge xīn de ràng wǒ fàngsōng de dìfang. Nǐ juéde xiànzài de dìfang shì nǐ fàngsōng de dìfang ma?
You just said you wanted to leave quickly for a new place where you can relax. Is where you are now that relaxing place?
好，很好的问题。现在这个地方，它让我非常的放松。我觉得悉尼是我住过最好的地方。
Hǎo, hěn hǎo de wèntí. Xiànzài zhège dìfang, tā ràng wǒ fēicháng de fàngsōng. Wǒ juéde xīní shì wǒ zhù guo zuìhǎo de dìfang.
Good question. Where I am now makes me feel very relaxed. I think Sydney is the best place I've ever lived.
但是你说它有没有家的感觉——什么是家的感觉？我也在想这个问题。
Dànshì nǐ shuō tā yǒuméiyǒu jiā de gǎnjué—— shénme shì jiā de gǎnjué? Wǒ yě zài xiǎng zhège wèntí.
But you ask whether it feels like home — what does home feel like? I've been thinking about that too.
我觉得家的感觉它不一定是你熟悉的东西。
Wǒ juéde jiā de gǎnjué tā bù yídìng shì nǐ shúxī de dōngxi.
I think the feeling of home isn't necessarily about familiar things.
可能有的人更喜欢待在老家，是因为老家有熟悉的东西。这个吃的东西是小时候吃的，我看到的人、我的朋友、我的家人，都是我觉得很熟悉、很舒服的东西。

Kěnéng yǒu de rén gèng xǐhuan dài zài lǎojiā, shìyīnwèi lǎojiā yǒu shúxī de dōngxi. Zhège chī de dōngxi shì xiǎoshíhou chī de, wǒ kàndào de rén, wǒ de péngyou, wǒ de jiārén, dōu shì wǒ juéde hěn shúxī, hěn shūfu de dōngxi.
Some people prefer staying in their hometown because it's familiar: the food they ate as kids, the people, friends and family — all familiar and comfortable.
可能现在我的想法是，我在悉尼觉得非常的舒服，是因为悉尼的人和我不一样，但是他们可以接受我。
Kěnéng xiànzài wǒ de xiǎngfǎ shì, wǒ zài xīní juéde fēicháng de shūfu, shìyīnwèi xīní de rén hé wǒ bù yīyàng, dànshì tāmen kěyǐ jiēshòu wǒ.
But my thinking now is that I feel very comfortable in Sydney because the people there are different from me, yet they can accept me.
你可以明白我说的东西吗？对。
Nǐ kěyǐ míngbai wǒ shuō de dōngxi ma? Duì.
Do you understand what I mean? Yes.
是的，我也有同样的感觉。当你去到一个不是你家乡的地方……
Shì de, wǒ yě yǒu tóngyàng de gǎnjué. Dāng nǐ qù dào yíge búshi nǐ jiāxiāng de dìfang……
Yes, I feel the same. When you go somewhere that isn't your hometown…
被别人接受好像是一件很重要的事情，对吧？被别人接受。
Bèi biéren jiēshòu hǎoxiàng shì yījiàn hěn zhòngyào de shìqing, duì ba? Bèi biéren jiēshòu.
being accepted by others seems really important, right? Being accepted.
我会觉得，如果我在自己的老家，所有的东西都是我熟悉的东西，那如果我和大家不一样，大家会接受我吗？
Wǒhuì juéde, rúguǒ wǒ zài zìjǐ de lǎojiā, suǒyǒu de dōngxi dōu shì wǒ shúxī de dōngxi, nà rúguǒ wǒ hé dàjiā bù yīyàng, dàjiā huì jiēshòu wǒ ma?
I feel that in my hometown, where everything is familiar, if I were different from everyone, would they accept me?
不会的。大家会觉得你很奇怪：你为什么和大家不一样？
Búhuì de. Dàjiā huì juéde nǐ hěn qíguài: nǐ wèishénme hé dàjiā bù yīyàng?
No. They'd think you were strange: why are you different from everyone?
对。但是因为我在这里，我是一个外国人，可是这个地方有很多人都是外国人，我觉得很舒服。
Duì. Dànshì yīnwèi wǒ zài zhèlǐ, wǒ shì yíge wàiguórén, kěshì zhège dìfang yǒu hěnduō rén dōu shì wàiguórén, wǒ juéde hěn shūfu.
Right. But here I'm a foreigner, and lots of people here are foreigners, so I feel comfortable.
大家都是外国人，所以就没有区别，你就不会变得很奇怪，你就不是那个奇怪的人了。
Dàjiā dōu shì wàiguórén, suǒyǐ jiù méiyǒu qūbié, nǐ jiù búhuì biànde hěn qíguài, nǐ jiù búshi nàge qíguài de rén le.
Everyone's a foreigner, so there's no difference; you don't become strange — you're not the odd one out.
对对对，我一点都不奇怪。
Duì duì duì, wǒ yìdiǎn dōu bù qíguài.
Yes, I'm not strange at all.
blocks.h: 什么是家的感觉？ · What does home feel like?

lines: 然后有一点我非常喜欢的：我自己觉得，我希望每个国家都有很多不一样国家的人。
Ránhòu yǒu yìdiǎn wǒ fēicháng xǐhuan de: wǒ zìjǐ juéde, wǒ xīwàng měigè guójiā dōu yǒu hěnduō bù yīyàng guójiā de rén.
And here's something I really like: I hope every country has lots of people from different countries.
因为这个让你的生活非常有意思。
Yīnwèi zhège ràng nǐ de shēnghuó fēicháng yǒuyìsi.
Because it makes your life really interesting.
就是如果你在中国，大部分的时候我们还是吃中国的菜，对不对？
Jiùshì rúguǒ nǐ zài zhōngguó, dàbùfen de shíhou wǒmen háishi chī zhōngguó de cài, duì bù duì?
If you're in China, most of the time we still eat Chinese food, right?
大部分的时候我们还是听中国的音乐，看中国的电视、电影。
Dàbùfen de shíhou wǒmen háishi tīng zhōngguó de yīnyuè, kàn zhōngguó de diànshì, diànyǐng.
Most of the time we listen to Chinese music and watch Chinese TV and films.
可是在悉尼这个地方，我觉得太有意思了。我随便去一个饭店，不是我要跑很远，我随便去一个饭店……
Kěshì zài xīní zhège dìfang, wǒ juéde tài yǒuyìsi le. Wǒ suíbiàn qù yíge fàndiàn, búshi wǒyào pǎo hěn yuǎn, wǒ suíbiàn qù yíge fàndiàn……
But in Sydney it's so interesting. I just go into any restaurant — I don't have to go far — any restaurant…
然后我问这个饭店的人：“你们是哪里的人？”
Ránhòu wǒ wèn zhège fàndiàn de rén: "nǐmen shì nǎlǐ de rén?"
and I ask the people there: "Where are you from?"
上一次我去了一个很普通的饭店，他们告诉我，他们是叙利亚的人。哦！然后我就觉得太好了。
Shàng yīcì wǒ qù le yíge hěn pǔtōng de fàndiàn, tāmen gàosu wǒ, tāmen shì xùlìyà de rén. O! Ránhòu wǒ jiù juéde tàihǎole.
Last time I went to a very ordinary restaurant, and they told me they were Syrian. Oh! And I thought, wonderful.
那如果我去别的饭店，他们是哪里的人？他们可能是印度的人。
Nà rúguǒ wǒ qù biéde fàndiàn, tāmen shì nǎlǐ de rén? Tāmen kěnéng shì yìndù de rén.
And at another restaurant, where are they from? Maybe India.
就是你每天都可以找到新的东西，不会只有一种你熟悉的文化，每天都可以有不一样的文化。
Jiùshì nǐ měitiān dōu kěyǐ zhǎodào xīn de dōngxi, búhuì zhǐyǒu yìzhǒng nǐ shúxī de wénhuà, měitiān dōu kěyǐ yǒu bù yīyàng de wénhuà.
You can find something new every day — not just the one culture you know, but a different culture every day.
我觉得特别有意思，特别好。
Wǒ juéde tèbié yǒuyìsi, tèbié hǎo.
I find that really interesting, really great.
是的，你会有一种地球村的感觉，是吧？对对对，地球村，真的是。
Shì de, nǐ huì yǒu yìzhǒng dìqiúcūn de gǎnjué, shì ba? Duì duì duì, dìqiúcūn, zhēnde shì.
Yes, you get a "global village" feeling, right? Yes, a global village, really.
然后我太喜欢所有不同的人很开心地住在一起，然后我们可以试一试对方的东西。我觉得这是我想象的最好最好的生活。
Ránhòu wǒ tài xǐhuan suǒyǒu bùtóng de rén hěn kāixīn dì zhùzàiyìqǐ, ránhòu wǒmen kěyǐ shìyīshì duìfāng de dōngxi. Wǒ juéde zhè shì wǒ xiǎngxiàng de zuìhǎo zuìhǎo de shēnghuó.
And I love the idea of all kinds of people living happily together and trying each other's things. That's the best life I can imagine.
对对，我也觉得这是很快乐的，听起来就觉得很快乐。
Duì duì, wǒ yě juéde zhè shì hěn kuàilè de, tīng qǐlai jiù juéde hěn kuàilè.
Yes, I think so too; it sounds very happy.
但如果大家都是这样生活的，可能大家都会变得一样了。对，这也是一个问题。
Dàn rúguǒ dàjiā dōu shì zhèyàng shēnghuó de, kěnéng dàjiā dōu huì biànde yīyàng le. Duì, zhè yě shì yíge wèntí.
But if everyone lived like that, maybe everyone would become the same. Right, that's a problem too.
对，所以我觉得有的时候，我会觉得在悉尼，大家都知道一点点外国的东西，但是大家都不太知道。
Duì, suǒyǐ wǒ juéde yǒu de shíhou, wǒhuì juéde zài xīní, dàjiā dōu zhīdào yìdiǎndiǎn wàiguó de dōngxi, dànshì dàjiā dōu bù tài zhīdào.
Right. So sometimes I feel that in Sydney everyone knows a little about foreign things, but nobody really knows much.
就是你知道那个国家有这个吃的东西，但是那个国家的人，他们的文化你不太知道，你就知道一点点。
Jiùshì nǐ zhīdào nàge guójiā yǒu zhège chī de dōngxi, dànshì nàge guójiā de rén, tāmen de wénhuà nǐ bù tài zhīdào, nǐ jiù zhīdào yìdiǎndiǎn.
You know that country has this food, but you don't really know its people's culture; you only know a little.
是，那还是比较少的，就是知道的东西是比较少的，比较浅的。对对，很浅很浅。
Shì, nà háishi bǐjiào shǎo de, jiùshì zhīdào de dōngxi shì bǐjiào shǎo de, bǐjiào qiǎn de. Duì duì, hěn qiǎn hěn qiǎn.
Yes, that's still not much — what you know is limited and shallow. Right, very shallow.
对，所以你说得对。就是如果你真的想要每个地方有自己的文化，那可能不可以让所有不同的人住在一起，会把所有的地方都变得一样。
Duì, suǒyǐ nǐ shuōdéduì. Jiùshì rúguǒ nǐ zhēnde xiǎngyào měigè dìfang yǒu zìjǐ de wénhuà, nà kěnéng bù kěyǐ ràng suǒyǒu bùtóng de rén zhùzàiyìqǐ, huì bǎ suǒyǒu de dìfang dōu biànde yīyàng.
Right, so you're right: if you really want every place to have its own culture, maybe you can't have everyone living together, or every place becomes the same.
对，也不是说不可以，而是如果所有的人都能够接受所有的文化，那就没有不一样了。
Duì, yě búshi shuō bù kěyǐ, érshì rúguǒ suǒyǒu de rén dōu nénggòu jiēshòu suǒyǒu de wénhuà, nà jiù méiyǒu bù yīyàng le.
Right — not that you can't, but if everyone accepts every culture, there's no difference any more.
对，就像是我们每一个省之间，在中国，每一个省之间都是不一样的。他们每一个地方，他们吃的东西、他们说的话都是不一样的。
Duì, jiù xiàngshì wǒmen měi yíge shěng zhījiān, zài zhōngguó, měi yíge shěng zhījiān dōu shì bù yīyàng de. Tāmen měi yíge dìfang, tāmen chī de dōngxi, tāmen shuō dehuà dōu shì bù yīyàng de.
Right, like our provinces in China: each province is different. Each place eats different things and speaks differently.
所以这也是为什么我会想要在这两三年，我想在中国的每一个城市都待一待，在各个城市都住一段时间。
Suǒyǐ zhè yě shì wèishénme wǒhuì xiǎngyào zài zhè liǎngsānnián, wǒ xiǎng zài zhōngguó de měi yíge chéngshì dōu dài yīdài, zài gègè chéngshì dōu zhù yīduànshíjiān.
That's why, in the next two or three years, I want to stay in every city in China, living in each for a while.
我就想看看：哦，原来离开了我的家之后，我能够感受到不一样的习惯，不一样的吃的东西，不一样的生活，有可能他们的想法也会不一样。
Wǒ jiù xiǎng kànkan: o, yuánlái líkāi le wǒ de jiā zhīhòu, wǒ nénggòu gǎnshòu dào bù yīyàng de xíguàn, bù yīyàng de chī de dōngxi, bù yīyàng de shēnghuó, yǒu kěnéng tāmen de xiǎngfǎ yě huì bù yīyàng.
I want to see: oh, after leaving home I can experience different customs, different food, a different life — maybe different ways of thinking too.
我觉得这个就很有意思。
Wǒ juéde zhège jiù hěn yǒuyìsi.
I think that's really interesting.
对，所以我觉得对于中国来说，其实不同省份之间已经是不同的“悉尼”，不同的印度、不同的叙利亚，各个地方了，因为中国太大了。
Duì, suǒyǐ wǒ juéde duìyú zhōngguó láishuō, qíshí bùtóng shěngfèn zhījiān yǐjīng shì bùtóng de "xīní", bùtóng de yìndù, bùtóng de xùlìyà, gègè dìfang le, yīnwèi zhōngguó tàidà le.
Right, so for China, different provinces are already like a different Sydney, a different India, a different Syria — because China is so big.
你知道中国太大了，而且我们有很多不同的民族。
Nǐ zhīdào zhōngguó tàidà le, érqiě wǒmen yǒu hěnduō bùtóng de mínzú.
China is huge, you know, and we have lots of different ethnic groups.
blocks.h: 地球村 · A global village

lines: 有很多不同的民族，这也是我对贵州很感兴趣的原因。贵州它会有苗族。
Yǒu hěnduō bùtóng de mínzú, zhè yě shì wǒ duì guìzhōu hěngǎnxìngqù de yuányīn. Guìzhōu tāhuì yǒu miáozú.
Lots of different ethnic groups — that's also why I'm interested in Guizhou. Guizhou has the Miao people.
我不知道你有没有听过苗族的一些故事。你对苗族有没有了解？
Wǒ bù zhīdào nǐ yǒuméiyǒu tīngguò miáozú de yìxiē gùshi. Nǐ duì miáozú yǒuméiyǒu liǎojiě?
I don't know if you've heard any Miao stories. Do you know much about the Miao?
我有看过他们的那个帽子，还有他们的衣服，很特别。别的我不知道。
Wǒ yǒu kànguò tāmen de nàge màozi, háiyǒu tāmen de yīfu, hěn tèbié. Biéde wǒ bù zhīdào.
I've seen their hats and their clothes — very distinctive. I don't know anything else.
对，他们的帽子、衣服很特别。然后我之前有听说他们会养一些蛊虫，养一些虫子。
Duì, tāmen de màozi, yīfu hěn tèbié. Ránhòu wǒ zhīqián yǒu tīngshuō tāmen huìyǎng yìxiē gǔchóng, yǎng yìxiē chóngzi.
Right, their hats and clothes are distinctive. And I'd heard they raise gu — poisonous insects.
你知道吗？有一个很有名的，叫“情蛊”。
Nǐ zhīdào ma? Yǒu yíge hěn yǒumíng de, jiào "qínggǔ".
You know? There's a famous one called 情蛊, "love gu".
那情蛊的意思是，苗族的人他们会养一条虫。
Nà qínggǔ de yìsi shì, miáozú de rén tāmen huìyǎng yìtiáo chóng.
情蛊 means that Miao people raise a worm.
这条虫会把所有其他的虫子全都打败，它成为了最厉害的那一条虫。
Zhètiáo chóng huì bǎ suǒyǒu qítā de chóngzi quándōu dǎbài, tā chéngwéi le zuì lìhai de nà yìtiáo chóng.
This worm defeats all the other worms and becomes the strongest one.
那这条虫呢，你可以把你的血喂给这条虫。
Nà zhè tiáochóng ne, nǐ kěyǐ bǎ nǐ de xuè wèigěi zhètiáo chóng.
Then you can feed your blood to this worm.
然后让你喜欢的人把这条虫吃下去，然后他就会喜欢你。
Ránhòu ràng nǐ xǐhuan de rén bǎ zhè tiáochóng chī xiàqù, ránhòu tā jiù huì xǐhuan nǐ.
Then you get the person you like to swallow it, and they'll fall for you.
对，那你喜欢的人就会喜欢你。他如果和你分开，他就会死掉，你的心上人就会死掉。
Duì, nà nǐ xǐhuan de rén jiù huì xǐhuan nǐ. Tā rúguǒ hé nǐ fēnkāi, tā jiù huì sǐ diào, nǐ de xīnshàngrén jiù huì sǐ diào.
Right, the person you love will love you. And if they leave you, they'll die — your beloved will die.
是的，有这么一个故事，也不知道是真的还是假的。但是它是发生在苗族的故事里面的。
Shì de, yǒu zhème yíge gùshi, yě bù zhīdào shì zhēnde háishi jiǎ de. Dànshì tā shì fāshēng zài miáozú de gùshi lǐmiàn de.
Yes, there's a story like that; who knows whether it's true. But it's in Miao stories.
哦，好，等一下，所以你看过苗族的这个虫子吗？我看过视频，但是我没有亲眼看过。
O, hǎo, děng yīxià, suǒyǐ nǐ kànguò miáozú de zhège chóngzi ma? Wǒ kànguò shìpín, dànshì wǒ méiyǒu qīnyǎn kànguò.
Oh, OK, wait — so have you seen this Miao worm? I've seen videos, but not with my own eyes.
对，是的，我觉得很有意思。他们是怎么想出来这个方法的呢？对吧？
Duì, shì de, wǒ juédehěnyǒu yìsi. Tāmen shì zěnme xiǎng chulai zhège fāngfǎ de ne? Duì ba?
Right, I find it fascinating. How did they come up with this method?
它就像前段时间很火的那个电影《痴迷》，你知道这个电影吗？我没有看过。
Tā jiù xiàng qiánduànshíjiān hěnhuǒ de nàge diànyǐng « chīmí», nǐ zhīdào zhège diànyǐng ma? Wǒ méiyǒu kànguò.
It's like that film that was popular a while ago, 《痴迷》 "Obsession" — do you know it? I haven't seen it.
它也是有一个男生很喜欢那个女生，他就要了一根许愿柳，把那个许愿柳给了那个女生，让那个女生爱上了他。
Tā yě shì yǒu yíge nánshēng hěn xǐhuan nàge nǚshēng, tā jiùyào le yīgēn xǔyuàn liǔ, bǎ nàge xǔyuàn liǔ gěi le nàge nǚshēng, ràng nàge nǚshēng àishàng le tā.
In it a guy really likes a girl, so he gets a wishing willow, gives it to her, and makes her fall in love with him.
但是它是有点恐怖的，那个故事听起来有点恐怖。对，是的，我觉得情蛊也有一点点恐怖。
Dànshì tā shì yǒudiǎn kǒngbù de, nàge gùshi tīng qǐlai yǒudiǎn kǒngbù. Duì, shì de, wǒ juéde qínggǔ yě yǒu yìdiǎndiǎn kǒngbù.
But it's a bit scary; the story sounds a bit creepy. Yes, I think love gu is a bit creepy too.
对，就是让一个不喜欢你的人喜欢上你。对对。
Duì, jiùshì ràng yíge bù xǐhuan nǐ de rén xǐhuan shàng nǐ. Duì duì.
Right — making someone who doesn't like you fall for you. Yes.
我觉得就很好奇。我觉得在贵州以外的地方，应该很少人会用这种方法让别人喜欢上你。哦，对吧？哦，OK，我觉得是有点恐怖的。
Wǒ juéde jiù hěn hàoqí. Wǒ juéde zài guìzhōu yǐwài de dìfang, yīnggāi hěnshǎo rénhuìyòng zhèzhǒng fāngfǎ ràng biéren xǐhuan shàng nǐ. O, duì ba? O, ⁢OK⁢, wǒ juéde shì yǒudiǎn kǒngbù de.
I'm really curious. I think outside Guizhou hardly anyone would use this method to make someone fall for them. Oh, right? OK, I think it's a bit scary.
有意思。对，所以说这些东西就是很有意思。
Yǒuyìsi. Duì, suǒyǐ shuō zhèxiē dōngxi jiùshì hěn yǒuyìsi.
Interesting. Right, so these things are really interesting.
如果所有的人都用情蛊，所有的人都知道怎么做情蛊，那我就会觉得这个世界变得全部都一样。
Rúguǒ suǒyǒu de rén dōu yòng qínggǔ, suǒyǒu de rén dōu zhīdào zěnme zuò qínggǔ, nà wǒ jiù huì juéde zhège shìjiè biànde quánbù dōu yīyàng.
If everyone used love gu and everyone knew how to make it, I'd feel the whole world had become the same.
是的是的，整个中国也变得都一样了。这个还是蛮特别的。
Shì de shì de, zhěnggè zhōngguó yě biànde dōu yīyàng le. Zhège háishi mán tèbié de.
Yes, the whole of China would become the same too. It's quite special.
所以我一直觉得，像澳大利亚这样的国家，如果你来旅游，如果你是来看这里的文化，你要看什么文化，对不对？
Suǒyǐ wǒ yìzhí juéde, xiàng Àodàlìyà zhèyàng de guójiā, rúguǒ nǐ lái lǚyóu, rúguǒ nǐ shì láikàn zhèlǐ de wénhuà, nǐ yào kàn shénme wénhuà, duì bù duì?
So I've always felt that in a country like Australia, if you come as a tourist to see the culture — what culture would you see, right?
对。但是如果你去中国，你去贵州，你去看他们很特别的文化，你可以看到很多。
Duì. Dànshì rúguǒ nǐ qù zhōngguó, nǐ qù guìzhōu, nǐ qù kàn tāmen hěn tèbié de wénhuà, nǐ kěyǐ kàndào hěnduō.
Right. But if you go to China, to Guizhou, to see their very special culture, there's a lot to see.
那可能我会觉得住在澳大利亚这样的国家是比较舒服的，因为你每天都有不一样的东西。
Nà kěnéng wǒhuì juéde zhù zài Àodàlìyà zhèyàng de guójiā shì bǐjiào shūfu de, yīnwèi nǐ měitiān dōu yǒu bù yīyàng de dōngxi.
So I may feel living in a country like Australia is more comfortable, because you have different things every day.
但是如果是去旅游，还是要去更特别一点的地方，对吧？
Dànshì rúguǒ shì qù lǚyóu, háishi yào qù gèng tèbié yìdiǎn de dìfang, duì ba?
But for travel, you should still go somewhere more special, right?
可能对我们来说是特别，对他们来说也是我们的普通生活。是的是的。
Kěnéng duì wǒmen láishuō shì tèbié, duì tāmen láishuō yě shì wǒmen de pǔtōng shēnghuó. Shì de shì de.
What's special to us may be ordinary life to them. Yes, yes.
blocks.h: 苗族的“情蛊” · The Miao "love gu"

lines: 好。那阿慧，你上一次回你的老家是什么时候？
Hǎo. Nà Ā Huì, nǐ shàng yīcì huí nǐ de lǎojiā shì shénme shíhou?
OK. So A Hui, when did you last go back to your hometown?
其实就是今年的夏天，夏天回去吃了几颗荔枝。
Qíshí jiùshì jīnnián de xiàtiān, xiàtiān huíqu chī le jǐkē lìzhī.
Actually this summer — I went back and ate a few lychees.
回去吃了几颗荔枝。对，就为了那口荔枝，我就回去了。
Huíqu chī le jǐkē lìzhī. Duì, jiù wèile nàkǒu lìzhī, wǒ jiù huíqu le.
Went back and ate a few lychees. Right, I went back just for a mouthful of lychees.
哦，对。那你现在已经长大了，你对老家的看法和小的时候是一样的吗？
O, duì. Nà nǐ xiànzài yǐjīng zhǎngdà le, nǐ duì lǎojiā de kànfǎ hé xiǎo de shíhou shì yīyàng de ma?
Oh, right. Now that you're grown up, do you see your hometown the same way as when you were little?
我觉得不太一样。我对老家的想法，我觉得是发生了很多次变化。
Wǒ juéde bùtài yīyàng. Wǒ duì lǎojiā de xiǎngfǎ, wǒ juéde shì fāshēng le hěn duōcì biànhuà.
I don't think so. My feelings about my hometown have changed many times.
因为刚才我问你嘛，你觉得家是什么？但对我来说，家是什么？这个问题一直都没有答案。
Yīnwèi gāngcái wǒ wèn nǐ ma, nǐ juéde jiā shì shénme? Dàn duì wǒ láishuō, jiā shì shénme? Zhège wèntí yìzhí dōu méiyǒu dáàn.
Because I just asked you what home is. But for me, what is home? That question has never had an answer.
因为我小的时候不是和我的爸爸妈妈一起住的。
Yīnwèi wǒ xiǎo de shíhou búshi hé wǒ de bàbàmāmā yìqǐ zhù de.
Because when I was little I didn't live with my parents.
所以我不会觉得那个是我的家。我觉得那就是一个我可能暑假、寒假会回去的地方。
Suǒyǐ wǒ búhuì juéde nàge shì wǒ de jiā. Wǒ juéde nà jiùshì yíge wǒ kěnéng shǔjià, hánjià huì huíqu de dìfang.
So I didn't feel it was my home. It was just a place I might go back to in the summer or winter holidays.
那不是我的家，不是我的老家。所以我对家没有特别的感情。
Nà búshi wǒ de jiā, búshi wǒ de lǎojiā. Suǒyǐ wǒ duìjiā méiyǒu tèbié de gǎnqíng.
It wasn't my home, not my hometown. So I have no special feelings about home.
但到了后来，我工作了，然后我的爸爸妈妈他们回到我的老家，我可能每年都会回去看他们。
Dàn dào le hòulái, wǒ gōngzuò le, ránhòu wǒ de bàbàmāmā tāmen huídào wǒ de lǎojiā, wǒ kěnéng měinián dōu huì huíqu kàn tāmen.
But later, when I was working and my parents moved back to my hometown, I'd go back to see them every year.
慢慢地，爸爸妈妈对你很好。回家的时候，他们对你很好，你会觉得：有人每天给你做饭，给你水果，哎呀，有人爱你，感觉很幸福嘛，对吧？
Mànmàn dì, bàbàmāmā duì nǐ hěn hǎo. Huíjiā de shíhou, tāmen duì nǐ hěn hǎo, nǐ huì juéde: yǒurén měitiān gěi nǐ zuòfàn, gěi nǐ shuǐguǒ, āiyā, yǒurén ài nǐ, gǎnjué hěn xìngfú ma, duì ba?
Gradually — your parents are good to you. When you go home they treat you well, and you feel: someone cooks for you every day, gives you fruit; someone loves you — you feel happy, right?
你会觉得，好像我开始长大了，我慢慢地成为了这个家里面的一个成员，我成为了这个家里面的一部分。
Nǐ huì juéde, hǎoxiàng wǒ kāishǐ zhǎngdà le, wǒ mànmàn dì chéngwéi le zhège jiā lǐmiàn de yíge chéngyuán, wǒ chéngwéi le zhège jiā lǐmiàn de yībùfen.
You feel you've grown up and slowly become a member of the family, a part of this home.
你觉得自己在家里面很重要。在前两年的时候，我是这么觉得的。我觉得我的父母需要我。
Nǐ juéde zìjǐ zàijiā lǐmiàn hěn zhòngyào. Zài qián liǎngnián de shíhou, wǒ shì zhème juéde de. Wǒ juéde wǒ de fùmǔ xūyào wǒ.
You feel you matter in the family. A couple of years ago that's how I felt. I felt my parents needed me.
我回去住了一年多的时间。
Wǒ huíqu zhù le yīnián duō de shíjiān.
I went back and lived there for over a year.
然后今年有一个比较特殊的情况，有一个特别的情况发生了。
Ránhòu jīnnián yǒu yíge bǐjiào tèshū de qíngkuàng, yǒu yíge tèbié de qíngkuàng fāshēng le.
Then this year something unusual happened.
哦？我跟我的爸爸吵架了。我跟我的爸爸吵架了。
O? Wǒ gēn wǒ de bàba chǎojià le. Wǒ gēn wǒ de bàba chǎojià le.
Oh? I had a fight with my dad. I had a fight with my dad.
然后呢，我爸爸在生气的时候说了一句话。
Ránhòu ne, wǒ bàba zài shēngqì de shíhou shuō le yījù huà.
And when he was angry my dad said something.
他说：“你在家里住的这一年，你给过我房租吗？
Tā shuō: "nǐ zài jiālǐ zhù de zhè yīnián, nǐ gěi guo wǒ fángzū ma?
He said: "This year you've lived at home, have you ever paid me rent?
你在我这里吃饭，你给过钱吗？我的房租你给了吗？”
Nǐ zài wǒ zhèlǐ chīfàn, nǐ gěi guo qián ma? Wǒ de fángzū nǐ gěi le ma?"
You eat here — have you ever paid? Have you paid me my rent?"
我那一下我有一点……哦，原来我在这个家里住，我是需要付房租的。
Wǒ nà yīxià wǒ yǒu yìdiǎn…… O, yuánlái wǒ zài zhège jiālǐ zhù, wǒ shì xūyào fù fángzū de.
At that moment I was a bit… oh, so to live in this home I have to pay rent.
那就跟我去外面、去别的城市住有什么区别呢？
Nà jiù gēn wǒ qù wàimiàn, qù biéde chéngshì zhù yǒu shénme qūbié ne?
Then what's the difference from living outside, in another city?
然后我就发现了一件很有意思的事情。
Ránhòu wǒ jiù fāxiàn le yījiàn hěn yǒuyìsi de shìqing.
And I discovered something interesting.
我身边的朋友，差不多到了我这个年纪的时候，他们会发现一件事情。
Wǒ shēnbiān de péngyou, chàbuduō dào le wǒ zhège niánjì de shíhou, tāmen huì fāxiàn yījiàn shìqing.
My friends, at about my age, all discover the same thing.
因为在广东，我们都是多子女家庭为主嘛，我们都会偷偷地生。
Yīnwèi zài guǎngdōng, wǒmen dōu shì duō zǐnǚ jiātíng wéizhǔ ma, wǒmen dōu huì tōutōudì shēng.
Because in Guangdong most families have several children; people have them secretly.
你知道吧？对对，是的是的，就是会想要生一个儿子嘛。
Nǐ zhīdào ba? Duì duì, shì de shì de, jiùshì huì xiǎngyào shēng yíge érzi ma.
You know? Yes, yes — they want to have a son.
所以很多广东的家庭，他们都是可能三个子女、四个子女，最后一个一般都是一个儿子啦。
Suǒyǐ hěnduō guǎngdōng de jiātíng, tāmen dōu shì kěnéng sāngè zǐnǚ, sìgè zǐnǚ, zuìhòu yíge yìbān dōu shì yíge érzi la.
So lots of Guangdong families have three or four children, and the last one is usually a son.
所以我们在这个时候会发现一件事情。
Suǒyǐ wǒmen zài zhège shíhou huì fāxiàn yījiàn shìqing.
So at this point we discover something.
平时父母对你是很好的，也很爱你。但是那个家不是留给你的。
Píngshí fùmǔ duì nǐ shì hěn hǎo de, yě hěn ài nǐ. Dànshì nàge jiā búshi liúgěi nǐ de.
Normally your parents treat you well and love you. But that home isn't being kept for you.
那个家不是留给女儿的。
Nàge jiā búshi liúgěi nǚér de.
That home isn't left to the daughters.
我明白，原来女儿在这个家里是没有一个房间的。对，是的。
Wǒ míngbai, yuánlái nǚér zài zhège jiālǐ shì méiyǒu yíge fángjiān de. Duì, shì de.
I see — so daughters don't even have a room in that home. Right, yes.
我听过太多这样的故事。
Wǒ tīng guo tài duō zhèyàng de gùshi.
I've heard too many stories like this.
我觉得还好我的妈妈没有钱。如果我的妈妈有钱，我需要和我的兄弟姐妹吵架。
Wǒ juéde háihǎo wǒ de māma méiyǒu qián. Rúguǒ wǒ de māma yǒuqián, wǒ xūyào hé wǒ de xiōngdìjiěmèi chǎojià.
I think it's lucky my mum has no money. If she had money, I'd have to fight with my siblings.
对。但是我妈妈没有钱，太好了，我不需要因为妈妈的钱和他们吵架。
Duì. Dànshì wǒ māma méiyǒu qián, tàihǎole, wǒ bù xūyào yīnwèi māma de qián hé tāmen chǎojià.
Right. But my mum has no money — great, I don't have to fight with them over her money.
哦。对，所以我会觉得，你看，广东和福建真的不是非常喜欢女人的地方。
O. Duì, suǒyǐ wǒhuì juéde, nǐ kàn, guǎngdōng hé fújiàn zhēnde búshi fēicháng xǐhuan nǚren de dìfang.
Oh. Right, so you see, Guangdong and Fujian really aren't places that like women very much.
我觉得如果我住在那里，我会常常注意到这种不爱女人的东西。
Wǒ juéde rúguǒ wǒ zhù zài nàli, wǒhuì chángcháng zhùyì dào zhèzhǒng bù àinǚrén de dōngxi.
I think if I lived there I'd constantly notice this lack of love for women.
然后不欢迎女人的这个东西，我会觉得：我为什么要住在那样的地方？
Ránhòu bù huānyíng nǚren de zhège dōngxi, wǒhuì juéde: wǒ wèishénme yào zhù zài nàyàng de dìfang?
This unwelcoming attitude to women — I'd think: why would I live in a place like that?
但我觉得也不是它就真的是不爱女人，而是有很多家庭……
Dàn wǒ juéde yě búshi tā jiù zhēnde shì bù àinǚrén, érshì yǒu hěnduō jiātíng……
But I don't think it really doesn't love women; it's that many families…
他们的想法，可能是我们的妈妈呀、叔叔他们这一辈，他们会觉得女人就不是家里面的一部分，他们会有这样的想法。
Tāmen de xiǎngfǎ, kěnéng shì wǒmen de māma ya, shūshu tāmen zhè yībèi, tāmen huì juéde nǚren jiù búshi jiā lǐmiàn de yībùfen, tāmen huì yǒu zhèyàng de xiǎngfǎ.
their thinking — maybe our mothers' and uncles' generation — they feel women aren't really part of the family; they think like that.
但我会觉得年轻人会有新的想法。
Dàn wǒhuì juéde niánqīngrén huì yǒu xīn de xiǎngfǎ.
But I think young people will have new ideas.
所以不能说全部的人都不爱女人。我觉得它需要进步。
Suǒyǐ bùnéng shuō quánbù de rén dōu bù àinǚrén. Wǒ juéde tā xūyào jìnbù.
So you can't say everyone doesn't love women. I think it needs to progress.
对，进步了，我再回去。
Duì, jìnbù le, wǒ zài huíqu.
Right — once it's progressed, I'll go back.
对，是的是的。但是我也不会觉得说我想回去，因为对我来说，那已经是一个我需要交房租的地方了。
Duì, shì de shì de. Dànshì wǒ yě búhuì juéde shuō wǒ xiǎng huíqu, yīnwèi duì wǒ láishuō, nà yǐjīng shì yíge wǒ xūyào jiāo fángzū de dìfang le.
Right, yes. But I still wouldn't want to go back, because for me it's become a place where I have to pay rent.
我为什么要去交房租，住在一个我已经熟悉了的地方呢？
Wǒ wèishénme yào qù jiāo fángzū, zhù zài yíge wǒ yǐjīng shúxī le de dìfang ne?
Why would I pay rent to live somewhere I already know?
对，那我觉得我还是去别的地方吧。
Duì, nà wǒ juéde wǒ háishi qù biéde dìfang ba.
Right, so I think I'll go somewhere else.
blocks.h: 女儿和家 · Daughters and home

lines: 我也想到一件事情。我每一次回家，我是去看我的妈妈，但是我的妈妈跟我哥哥的孩子，还有哥哥的老婆住在一起。
Wǒ yě xiǎngdào yījiàn shìqing. Wǒ měi yīcì huíjiā, wǒ shì qù kàn wǒ de māma, dànshì wǒ de māma gēn wǒ gēge de háizi, háiyǒu gēge de lǎopó zhùzàiyìqǐ.
That reminds me of something. Every time I go home it's to see my mum, but she lives with my brother's children and my brother's wife.
然后呢，我觉得我回中国，我当然要去看我的妈妈，这是最最重要的人，对不对？
Ránhòu ne, wǒ juéde wǒ huí zhōngguó, wǒ dāngrán yào qù kàn wǒ de māma, zhèshì zuìzuì zhòngyào de rén, duì bù duì?
And when I go back to China of course I visit my mum; she's the most important person, right?
然后我有一天发现，我的哥哥的老婆，她觉得每一次我去她的家，我都没有带礼物。
Ránhòu wǒ yǒu yītiān fāxiàn, wǒ de gēge de lǎopó, tā juéde měi yīcì wǒ qù tā de jiā, wǒ dōu méiyǒu dài lǐwù.
Then one day I found out that my brother's wife felt that every time I came to her home, I didn't bring a gift.
然后我想：哈，我原来需要给他们买礼物。
Ránhòu wǒ xiǎng: hā, wǒ yuánlái xūyào gěi tāmen mǎi lǐwù.
And I thought: ha, so I'm supposed to buy them gifts.
对，我会觉得：哎，这不是我妈妈在的地方，就是我的家嘛。
Duì, wǒhuì juéde: āi, zhè búshi wǒ māma zài de dìfang, jiùshì wǒ de jiā ma.
Right, I felt: hey, isn't the place where my mum lives just my home?
对，所以啊，你不是这个家的一部分。对，你一定要带礼物，你是客人的感觉。
Duì, suǒyǐ a, nǐ búshi zhège jiā de yībùfen. Duì, nǐ yídìng yào dài lǐwù, nǐ shì kèrén de gǎnjué.
Right, so you're not part of that home. Yes, you have to bring gifts — you're a guest.
对，就是他们说的时候，他们会说：“这个房间是你的。我们建了一个房子，你要哪一个房间？这个房间是你的。”
Duì, jiùshì tāmen shuō de shíhou, tāmen huì shuō: "zhège fángjiān shì nǐ de. Wǒmen jiànle yíge fángzi, nǐ yào na yíge fángjiān? Zhège fángjiān shì nǐ de."
Right, when they talk about it they say: "This room is yours. We built a house — which room do you want? This room is yours."
但是我真的没有想到，我回去看妈妈的时候，我需要给他们礼物。
Dànshì wǒ zhēnde méiyǒu xiǎngdào, wǒ huíqu kàn māma de shíhou, wǒ xūyào gěi tāmen lǐwù.
But I really never imagined I'd need to give them gifts when I went back to see my mum.
听起来非常的奇怪。对，让我觉得如果我的妈妈走了，我不想再去他们的家。
Tīng qǐlai fēicháng de qíguài. Duì, ràng wǒ juéde rúguǒ wǒ de māma zǒu le, wǒ bùxiǎng zài qù tāmen de jiā.
It sounds very strange. Right — it makes me feel that if my mum passed away, I wouldn't want to go to their home any more.
对，你看你刚刚也说了：“我不想再去他们的家。”你从头到尾一直不会觉得那是你的家。
Duì, nǐ kàn nǐ gānggang yě shuō le: "wǒ bùxiǎng zài qù tāmen de jiā."nǐ cóngtóudàowěi yìzhí búhuì juéde nà shì nǐ de jiā.
Right, you just said it yourself: "I wouldn't want to go to their home." From start to finish you never felt it was your home.
我本来觉得……不是说是我的家，但是我不会觉得是别人的家，我觉得是我哥哥的家嘛。
Wǒ běnlái juéde…… Búshi shuō shì wǒ de jiā, dànshì wǒ búhuì juéde shì biéren de jiā, wǒ juéde shì wǒ gēge de jiā ma.
I used to feel… not that it was my home, but I didn't feel it was someone else's home either; it was my brother's home.
所以如果他们觉得我去他们的家，我需要带礼物，好，那我妈妈走了以后，我不想再去他的家。
Suǒyǐ rúguǒ tāmen juéde wǒ qù tāmen de jiā, wǒ xūyào dài lǐwù, hǎo, nà wǒ māma zǒu le yǐhòu, wǒ bùxiǎng zài qù tā de jiā.
So if they think I need to bring gifts when I visit, fine — after my mum passes away, I won't want to go to his home again.
我觉得我回中国，我就是要看我的妈妈，别的人不太重要。
Wǒ juéde wǒ huí zhōngguó, wǒ jiùshì yào kàn wǒ de māma, biéde rénbùtài zhòngyào.
I go back to China to see my mum; other people aren't so important.
是的，我也有同样的想法。我觉得我回家也是为了看我妈妈。
Shì de, wǒ yě yǒu tóngyàng de xiǎngfǎ. Wǒ juéde wǒ huíjiā yě shì wèile kàn wǒ māma.
Yes, I feel the same. I go home to see my mum too.
对。如果妈妈走了，我真的会觉得在中国就是真的没有家了。可能有朋友，有很好的朋友，但是真的会觉得……
Duì. Rúguǒ māma zǒu le, wǒ zhēnde huì juéde zài zhōngguó jiùshì zhēnde méiyǒu jiā le. Kěnéng yǒu péngyou, yǒu hěn hǎo de péngyou, dànshì zhēnde huì juéde……
Right. If my mum passed away, I'd really feel I had no home in China. I might have friends, very good friends, but I'd really feel…
这个家，有一大部分的东西已经走了，跟妈妈一起走了。
Zhège jiā, yǒu yīdàbùfèn de dōngxi yǐjīng zǒu le, gēn māma yìqǐ zǒu le.
a big part of home was gone, gone with my mum.
blocks.h: 客人的感觉 · Feeling like a guest

lines: 哎，我突然想到一个事情。你知道在网上，前段时间有一个很流行的说法，在中国的互联网上有一个说法是……
Āi, wǒ tūrán xiǎngdào yíge shìqing. Nǐ zhīdào zài wǎngshàng, qiánduànshíjiān yǒu yíge hěn liúxíng de shuōfa, zài zhōngguó de hùliánwǎng shàng yǒu yíge shuōfa shì……
Oh, I've just thought of something. A while ago there was a popular saying on the Chinese internet…
男人一直想回家，而女人一直想逃离她的家乡。
Nánrén yìzhí xiǎng huíjiā, ér nǚren yìzhí xiǎng táolí tā de jiāxiāng.
Men always want to go home, while women always want to escape their hometown.
就是故乡是不喜欢女人的，所以女人要逃；故乡是服务男人的，所以男人要回去，要当皇帝嘛。
Jiùshì gùxiāng shì bù xǐhuan nǚren de, suǒyǐ nǚren yào táo; gùxiāng shì fúwù nánrén de, suǒyǐ nánrén yào huíqu, yào dāng huángdì ma.
Because the hometown doesn't like women, so women flee; the hometown serves men, so men go back to be emperors.
对，是的，回去当皇帝！太对了，真的就是回去当皇帝。
Duì, shì de, huíqu dāng huángdì! Tàiduì le, zhēnde jiùshì huíqu dāng huángdì.
Yes, go back to be emperors! So true — really, going back to be emperors.
我们今天关于老家的播客到这里。大家对老家的想法是什么？
Wǒmen jīntiān guānyú lǎojiā de bōkè dào zhèlǐ. Dàjiā duì lǎojiā de xiǎngfǎ shì shénme?
That's it for today's podcast about hometowns. What do you all think about your hometowns?
你们想要离开，快点离开老家，还是想要一直生活在老家？可以告诉我们为什么。
Nǐmen xiǎngyào líkāi, kuàidiǎn líkāi lǎojiā, háishi xiǎngyào yìzhí shēnghuó zài lǎojiā? Kěyǐ gàosu wǒmen wèishénme.
Do you want to leave your hometown quickly, or live there forever? Tell us why.
我们下一个视频见。拜拜！
Wǒmen xià yíge shìpín jiàn. Bàibai!
See you in the next video. Bye!
blocks.h: 男人回家当皇帝 · Men go home to be emperors

q: 素清和阿慧上一次见面是在泉州。
Sù Qīng hé Ā Huì shàng yīcì jiànmiàn shì zài Quánzhōu.
Su Qing and A Hui last met in Quanzhou.
tf.why: Last time was in Quanzhou.

q: 阿慧的老家在福建。
Ā Huì de lǎojiā zài fújiàn.
A Hui's hometown is in Fujian.
tf.why: Her hometown is Maoming in Guangdong; Su Qing is from Fujian.

q: 素清在澳大利亚常常吃很便宜的荔枝。
Sù Qīng zài Àodàlìyà chángcháng chī hěn piányi de lìzhī.
Su Qing often eats cheap lychees in Australia.
tf.why: Lychees there are too expensive for her.

q: 那个英国人觉得荔枝不好吃，是因为他只吃过罐头荔枝。
Nàge yīngguórén juéde lìzhī bù hǎochī, shìyīnwèi tā zhǐ chī guo guàntou lìzhī.
The English person disliked lychees because he'd only had tinned ones.
tf.why: He had never eaten fresh lychees.

q: 阿慧现在住在贵州，坐高铁回老家要六个小时左右。
Ā Huì xiànzài zhù zài guìzhōu, zuò gāotiě huílǎojiā yào liùgè xiǎoshí zuǒyòu.
A Hui lives in Guizhou now; it's about six hours home by high-speed train.
tf.why: About six hours by high-speed train.

q: 阿慧的妈妈和奶奶是同一天生日。
Ā Huì de māma hé nǎinai shì tóngyītiān shēngrì.
A Hui's mother and grandmother share a birthday.
tf.why: Her mother shares a birthday with her grandfather.

q: 生日那天，家里有两个蛋糕。
Shēngrì nàtiān, jiālǐ yǒu liǎnggè dàngāo.
On the birthday there were two cakes.
tf.why: There was only one cake for both of them.

q: 素清觉得悉尼是她住过最好的地方。
Sù Qīng juéde xīní shì tā zhù guo zuìhǎo de dìfang.
Su Qing thinks Sydney is the best place she has lived.
tf.why: She says so directly.

q: 在泉州，有人给神仙带奶茶。
Zài Quánzhōu, yǒurén gěi shénxiān dài nǎichá.
In Quanzhou some people bring milk tea to the gods.
tf.why: They chat with the gods and bring them milk tea.

q: 素清小时候很喜欢春节去拜神仙。
Sù Qīng xiǎoshíhou hěn xǐhuan chūnjié qù bài shénxiān.
As a child Su Qing loved going to worship the gods at Spring Festival.
tf.why: She hated it; the walk was long and tiring.

q: 阿慧亲眼看过苗族的蛊虫。
Ā Huì qīnyǎn kànguò miáozú de gǔ chóng.
A Hui has seen a Miao gu worm with her own eyes.
tf.why: She's only seen videos.

q: 阿慧的爸爸问她有没有给过房租。
Ā Huì de bàba wèn tā yǒuméiyǒu gěi guo fángzū.
A Hui's father asked if she had ever paid rent.
tf.why: He said it during an argument.

q: 素清的哥哥每年都去澳大利亚看她。
Sù Qīng de gēge měinián dōu qù Àodàlìyà kàn tā.
Su Qing's brother visits her in Australia every year.
tf.why: Nothing is said about her brother visiting Australia.

q: 素清为什么不喜欢她的老家？
Sù Qīng wèishénme bù xǐhuan tā de lǎojiā?
Why doesn't Su Qing like her hometown?
o: 那里重男轻女，女人很辛苦
sons are valued over daughters, and women work very hard
mc.why: Women cook and clean while men eat first and drink tea.

q: 素清为什么在悉尼觉得很舒服？
Sù Qīng wèishénme zài xīní juéde hěn shūfu?
Why does Su Qing feel comfortable in Sydney?
o: Nàli de rén hé tā yīyàng
那里的人和她不一样，但是可以接受她
Nàli de rén hé tā bù yīyàng, dànshì kěyǐ jiēshòu tā
people there are different from her but accept her
Tā de māma zhù zài nàli
mc.why: Everyone is a foreigner, so she isn't the strange one.

q: “情蛊”是什么？
"qínggǔ"shì shénme?
What is 情蛊 'love gu'?
o: 让喜欢的人爱上你的一条虫
Ràng xǐhuan de rén àishàngnǐ de yìtiáo chóng
a worm that makes the person you like love you
mc.why: You feed it your blood and get the person you like to swallow it.

q: 网上的说法：为什么男人想回老家？
Wǎngshàng de shuōfa: wèishénme nánrén xiǎng huílǎojiā?
According to the online saying, why do men want to go back home?
o: 因为故乡服务男人，回去可以当皇帝
Yīnwèi gùxiāng fúwù nánrén, huíqu kěyǐ dāng huángdì
the hometown serves men, so they go back to be emperors
mc.why: The hometown serves men, so they go back to be 'emperors'.

q: 素清觉得泉州的人和神的关系有什么特别？
Sù Qīng juéde Quánzhōu de rén hé shén de guānxi yǒu shénme tèbié?
What is special about the relationship between people and gods in Quanzhou?
ans: 人不只是向神要东西，他们也会跟神聊天、发牢骚、说心事，还会给神带奶茶。
Rén bù zhǐshì xiàng shényào dōngxi, tāmen yě huì gēn shén liáotiān, fāláosāo, shuō xīnshì, háihuì gěi shéndài nǎichá.
People don't just ask the gods for things; they chat, grumble, share what's on their minds and even bring them milk tea.

q: 阿慧为什么现在不想回老家住？
Ā Huì wèishénme xiànzài bùxiǎng huílǎojiā zhù?
Why doesn't A Hui want to live in her hometown now?
ans: 因为爸爸吵架时问她要房租，她觉得在家住和在别的城市住没有区别，而且那个家不是留给女儿的。
Yīnwèi bàba chǎojià shíwèn tā yào fángzū, tā juéde zài jiāzhù hé zài biéde chéngshì zhù méiyǒu qūbié, érqiě nàge jiā búshi liúgěi nǚér de.
Because during a fight her father asked her for rent; she feels living at home is no different from living elsewhere, and the home isn't kept for daughters.

q: 素清为什么觉得在哥哥家像一个客人？
Sù Qīng wèishénme juéde zài gēge jiāxiàng yíge kèrén?
Why does Su Qing feel like a guest at her brother's home?
ans: 因为哥哥的老婆觉得她每次去都应该带礼物。
Yīnwèi gēge de lǎopó juéde tā měicì qù dōu yīnggāi dài lǐwù.
Because her brother's wife thinks she should bring a gift every time she visits.

006.title: Murder on the cliff
006.transcriptNote: 素清 Sù Qīng tells 贝拉 Bèilā about a real case from 2019: a Chinese woman in Thailand who was pushed off a cliff by her husband and survived. Fillers like 嗯 and 呃 are mostly left out; a few unclear words were reconstructed from context.

lines: 大家好，欢迎来到今天的视频。
Dàjiā hǎo, huānyíng láidào jīntiān de shìpín.
Hello everyone, welcome to today's video.
今天是我素清和贝拉。
Jīntiān shì wǒ Sù Qīng hé Bèilā.
Today it's me, Su Qing, and Bella.
好，那今天我想和Bella分享一个中国的新闻。
Hǎo, nà jīntiān wǒ xiǎng hé ⁢Bella⁢ fēnxiǎng yíge zhōngguó de xīnwén.
OK, today I want to share a Chinese news story with Bella.
Bella，你知道最近，可能前……我忘了，四五年，可能在泰国有一个中国女人，她被她的老公推下山。你知道这个新闻吗？
⁢Bella⁢, nǐ zhīdào zuìjìn, kěnéng qián…… Wǒ wàng le, sìwǔnián, kěnéng zài tàiguó yǒu yíge zhōngguó nǚren, tā bèi tā de lǎogong tuī xiàshān. Nǐ zhīdào zhège xīnwén ma?
Bella, do you know — a while ago, I forget, maybe four or five years — in Thailand a Chinese woman was pushed off a mountain by her husband. Do you know this story?
没有听过，没有听过。哦，没有听过。这个新闻在中国非常非常大。
Méiyǒu tīngguò, méiyǒu tīngguò. O, méiyǒu tīngguò. Zhège xīnwén zài zhōngguó fēicháng fēicháng dà.
Never heard of it. Oh, you haven't. This story was huge in China.
我觉得我们都听过男人杀女人，或者女人杀男人的故事，对不对？对。
Wǒ juéde wǒmen dōu tīng guo nánrén shā nǚren, huòzhě nǚren shā nánrén de gùshi, duì bù duì? Duì.
I think we've all heard stories of men killing women or women killing men, right? Right.
但是这个新闻它很大，我觉得是因为有很多个点。
Dànshì zhège xīnwén tā hěndà, wǒ juéde shìyīnwèi yǒu hěnduō gèdiǎn.
But this one was huge, I think, for several reasons.
就是第一个点是这个女人那个时候她怀孕了，所以他杀了两个人。
Jiùshì dìyígè diǎn shì zhège nǚren nàge shíhou tā huáiyùn le, suǒyǐ tāshā le liǎnggè rén.
The first is that the woman was pregnant at the time, so he was killing two people.
对，然后呢，这个男人说：“我带你去看那个日出，太阳出来，很浪漫，我带你去看。”
Duì, ránhòu ne, zhège nánrén shuō: "wǒ dàinǐqù kàn nàge rìchū, tàiyang chulai, hěn làngmàn, wǒ dàinǐqù kàn."
Right. And the man said: "I'll take you to see the sunrise, when the sun comes up — very romantic. I'll take you."
然后呢这个女人，她其实她不想去，但是她的男朋友说：“我们一定要去。”所以他们去了。
Ránhòu ne zhège nǚren, tā qíshí tā bùxiǎng qù, dànshì tā de nánpéngyou shuō: "wǒmen yídìng yào qù."suǒyǐ tāmen qù le.
The woman didn't actually want to go, but her boyfriend said: "We have to go." So they went.
好。我觉得第一个点是因为她怀孕了，然后呢，她老公把她推下山。
Hǎo. Wǒ juéde dìyígè diǎn shìyīnwèi tā huáiyùn le, ránhòu ne, tā lǎogong bǎ tā tuī xiàshān.
OK. So the first point is that she was pregnant, and her husband pushed her off the mountain.
老公还是男朋友？我觉得是老公，是老公。
Lǎogong háishi nánpéngyou? Wǒ juéde shì lǎogong, shì lǎogong.
Husband or boyfriend? I think husband — yes, husband.
对。那你觉得她有没有死，这个女人？
Duì. Nà nǐ juéde tā yǒuméiyǒu sǐ, zhège nǚren?
Right. So do you think she died, this woman?
推下山，我觉得就算没有死，可能也快死了，应该很严重。
Tuī xiàshān, wǒ juéde jiùsuàn méiyǒu sǐ, kěnéng yě kuàisǐle, yīnggāi hěn yánzhòng.
Pushed off a mountain — I think even if she didn't die, she'd nearly be dead; it must be very serious.
是她的老公，他知道那个山很高，所以他带她去那个很高的山，然后把她推下去。应该会死的。
Shì tā de lǎogong, tā zhīdào nàge shān hěn gāo, suǒyǐ tā dài tā qù nàge hěn gāo de shān, ránhòu bǎ tā tuīxiàqù. Yīnggāi huì sǐ de.
It was her husband; he knew the mountain was very high, so he took her up there and pushed her off. She should have died.
但是她在掉下去的时候，有一棵树，所以她掉到了树上，然后呢，她从这个树上掉到地上，所以她没有直接到地上。
Dànshì tā zài diàoxiàqù de shíhou, yǒu yīkēshù, suǒyǐ tā diào dào le shùshàng, ránhòu ne, tā cóng zhège shùshàng diào dào dìshang, suǒyǐ tā méiyǒu zhíjiē dào dìshang.
But as she fell there was a tree, so she landed in the tree, and then fell from the tree to the ground; she didn't hit the ground directly.
树保护了她。差不多，树保护了她，然后她没有直接从很高的地方掉到地上，她是先掉到树上再掉到地上。
Shù bǎohù le tā. Chàbuduō, shù bǎohù le tā, ránhòu tā méiyǒu zhíjiē cóng hěn gāo de dìfang diào dào dìshang, tā shì xiān diào dào shùshàng zài diào dào dìshang.
The tree protected her. Pretty much — the tree protected her, so she didn't fall straight from that height to the ground; she hit the tree first.
所以她没有死。
Suǒyǐ tā méiyǒu sǐ.
So she didn't die.
哦，那她的老公不知道她有没有死？他推完以后就离开了吗？
O, nà tā de lǎogong bù zhīdào tā yǒuméiyǒu sǐ? Tā tuīwán yǐhòu jiù líkāi le ma?
Oh, so her husband didn't know if she was dead? Did he leave after pushing her?
她的老公觉得她应该死了，因为她的老公知道那座山很高。所以他推的时候，他说：“你去死吧。”然后他推完以后呢，他开车走了。
Tā de lǎogong juéde tā yīnggāi sǐ le, yīnwèi tā de lǎogong zhīdào nàzuò shān hěn gāo. Suǒyǐ tā tuī de shíhou, tā shuō: "nǐ qùsǐba."ránhòu tā tuīwán yǐhòu ne, tā kāichē zǒu le.
Her husband thought she must be dead, because he knew how high it was. As he pushed her he said: "Go and die." And afterwards he drove off.
blocks.h: 推下山 · Pushed off the mountain

lines: 对。但是这个女人没有死，那有人救她吗？有人救她吗？
Duì. Dànshì zhège nǚren méiyǒu sǐ, nà yǒurén jiù tā ma? Yǒurén jiù tā ma?
Right. But she didn't die — did anyone rescue her?
本来是没有的，因为她掉在山的下面，那个地方是没有人的，山底。
Běnlái shì méiyǒu de, yīnwèi tā diào zài shān de xiàmiàn, nàge dìfang shì méiyǒu rén de, shāndǐ.
At first, no, because she fell to the bottom of the mountain, where there was nobody.
但是这个女人的运气非常非常好。她掉到那个地方的时候，我记得是有两个泰国人，他们在爬山，然后呢他们迷路了：“哎，我在哪儿？我在哪儿？”
Dànshì zhège nǚren de yùnqi fēicháng fēicháng hǎo. Tā diào dào nàge dìfang de shíhou, wǒ jìde shì yǒu liǎnggè tàiguórén, tāmen zài páshān, ránhòu ne tāmen mílù le: "āi, wǒ zài nǎér? Wǒ zài nǎér?"
But this woman was very, very lucky. When she fell there, I remember two Thai people were hiking, and they got lost: "Hey, where are we? Where are we?"
他们迷路了，所以他们看到了这个女人。
Tāmen mílù le, suǒyǐ tāmen kàndào le zhège nǚren.
They got lost, and so they found this woman.
哇，很幸运！对，她运气很好。所以他们打电话给医院，然后医院有人来。
Wa, hěn xìngyùn! Duì, tā yùnqi hěn hǎo. Suǒyǐ tāmen dǎdiànhuà gěi yīyuàn, ránhòu yīyuàn yǒurén lái.
Wow, so lucky! Yes, she was very lucky. So they phoned the hospital, and people from the hospital came.
好，那OK，医生来了，医生救她，那可能没有什么问题，对不对？
Hǎo, nà ⁢OK⁢, yīshēng lái le, yīshēng jiù tā, nà kěnéng méiyǒu shénme wèntí, duì bù duì?
OK, so the doctors came and saved her, so maybe there was no problem, right?
对。但是医生来的时候，她的老公看到了医生的车，所以她的老公知道了她没有死。
Duì. Dànshì yīshēng lái de shíhou, tā de lǎogong kàndào le yīshēng de chē, suǒyǐ tā de lǎogong zhīdào le tā méiyǒu sǐ.
Right. But when the doctors came, her husband saw the ambulance, so he knew she wasn't dead.
blocks.h: 被救了 · Rescued

lines: 那你觉得她的老公现在会做什么？
Nà nǐ juéde tā de lǎogong xiànzài huì zuò shénme?
So what do you think the husband did then?
会不会他杀医生？他开车撞医生的车吗？
Huì búhuì tāshā yīshēng? Tā kāichē zhuàng yīshēng de chē ma?
Would he kill the doctors? Would he ram the ambulance with his car?
我觉得他开车的时候，他看到医院的车，他其实可能还在想：“哎，为什么有医院的车？”
Wǒ juéde tā kāichē de shíhou, tā kàndào yīyuàn de chē, tā qíshí kěnéng hái zài xiǎng: "āi, wèishénme yǒu yīyuàn de chē?"
I think when he was driving and saw the ambulance, he probably wondered: "Hey, why is there an ambulance?"
然后他想：是不是我的老婆没有死？
Ránhòu tā xiǎng: shìbúshì wǒ de lǎopó méiyǒu sǐ?
Then he thought: did my wife not die?
这么坏！对，这么坏。那他怎么做呢？
Zhème huài! Duì, zhème huài. Nà tā zěnme zuò ne?
So evil! Yes, so evil. So what did he do?
然后呢，他去到了那个医院，然后他在很远的地方看是不是他的老婆。
Ránhòu ne, tā qù dào le nàge yīyuàn, ránhòu tā zài hěn yuǎn de dìfang kàn shìbúshì tā de lǎopó.
He went to the hospital and watched from a distance to see if it was his wife.
哦，你说医院的车到了那里救他的老婆，然后开车回到医院。
O, nǐ shuō yīyuàn de chē dào le nàli jiù tā de lǎopó, ránhòu kāichē huídào yīyuàn.
Oh — you mean the ambulance came to rescue his wife and drove back to the hospital.
对，那个老公看到了，他就跟着去医院。
Duì, nàge lǎogong kàndào le, tā jiù gēnzhe qù yīyuàn.
Right, the husband saw it and followed it to the hospital.
对，他也去了那个医院，因为他要确认是不是他的老婆。然后他发现是他的老婆，那他就开始表演了。
Duì, tā yě qù le nàge yīyuàn, yīnwèi tā yào quèrèn shìbúshì tā de lǎopó. Ránhòu tā fāxiàn shì tā de lǎopó, nà tā jiù kāishǐ biǎoyǎn le.
Right, he went to the hospital too, because he wanted to confirm it was his wife. When he found it was her, he started putting on a show.
因为他不要让别人知道是他杀了他的老婆，对不对？
Yīnwèi tā búyào ràng biéren zhīdào shì tāshā le tā de lǎopó, duì bù duì?
Because he didn't want anyone to know he'd tried to kill his wife, right?
所以他那个时候就开始哭，然后说：“老婆，你在哪里？我找不到你，我很担心你。”但是他的老婆记得。
Suǒyǐ tā nàge shíhou jiù kāishǐ kū, ránhòu shuō: "lǎopó, nǐ zài nǎlǐ? Wǒ zhǎo búdào nǐ, wǒ hěn dānxīn nǐ."dànshì tā de lǎopó jìde.
So he started crying and saying: "Darling, where were you? I couldn't find you, I was so worried." But his wife remembered.
他的老婆那个时候是醒着，还是……？被推下去的时候，应该是晕过去，然后可能过了一段时间醒过来。
Tā de lǎopó nàge shíhou shì xǐng zhe, háishi……? Bèi tuīxiàqù de shíhou, yīnggāi shì yùnguòqù, ránhòu kěnéng guo le yīduànshíjiān xǐngguòlái.
Was his wife conscious then, or…? When she was pushed she probably passed out, and then came round after a while.
但是她记得她的老公说：“你去死吧。”
Dànshì tā jìde tā de lǎogong shuō: "nǐ qùsǐba."
But she remembered her husband saying: "Go and die."
好，那现在她的老公知道他的老婆在这个医院，很多医生在救她，对不对？对。
Hǎo, nà xiànzài tā de lǎogong zhīdào tā de lǎopó zài zhège yīyuàn, hěnduō yīshēng zài jiù tā, duì bù duì? Duì.
OK, so now the husband knows his wife is in the hospital, with lots of doctors saving her, right? Right.
那你觉得这个老公会做什么？
Nà nǐ juéde zhège lǎogong huì zuò shénme?
What do you think he'll do?
我觉得他可能趁大家都不在旁边的时候，他可能对老婆再做不好的事情，再让她死一次。
Wǒ juéde tā kěnéng chèn dàjiā dōu bù zài pángbiān de shíhou, tā kěnéng duì lǎopó zài zuò bùhǎo de shìqing, zài ràng tā sǐ yīcì.
I think when nobody's around he might do something bad to his wife again — try to kill her a second time.
对，我觉得他当然很想很想做这个，可是在医院现在有一点难，对不对？所有人都看着他。
Duì, wǒ juéde tā dāngrán hěn xiǎng hěn xiǎng zuò zhège, kěshì zài yīyuàn xiànzài yǒu yìdiǎn nán, duì bù duì? Suǒyǒurén dōu kànzhe tā.
Right, of course he really wanted to, but in a hospital it's a bit hard, right? Everyone's watching him.
对对，所以在医院杀人，他可能会想：会不会有人知道？
Duì duì, suǒyǐ zài yīyuàn shārén, tā kěnéng huìxiǎng: huì búhuì yǒurén zhīdào?
Right, so killing someone in a hospital — he'd think: will someone find out?
对。如果你在山上推一个人，旁边没有人，没有人知道，对不对？
Duì. Rúguǒ nǐ zài shānshàng tuī yíge rén, pángbiān méiyǒu rén, méiyǒu rén zhīdào, duì bù duì?
Right. If you push someone off a mountain, there's nobody around, nobody knows, right?
对，但是在医院他比较小心。
Duì, dànshì zài yīyuàn tā bǐjiào xiǎoxīn.
Right, but in the hospital he was more careful.
然后呢，他在医院的时候，他说：“我是她的老公，我找不到她，我很担心她。”
Ránhòu ne, tā zài yīyuàn de shíhou, tā shuō: "wǒ shì tā de lǎogong, wǒ zhǎo búdào tā, wǒ hěn dānxīn tā."
In the hospital he said: "I'm her husband; I couldn't find her, I was so worried about her."
所以呢，他一直在他的老婆旁边。
Suǒyǐ ne, tā yìzhí zài tā de lǎopó pángbiān.
So he stayed by his wife's side the whole time.
如果我是他的老婆，我应该吓死了：“走开走开！”对，要杀你的老公一直在你的旁边。
Rúguǒ wǒ shì tā de lǎopó, wǒ yīnggāi xiàsǐ le: "zǒukāi zǒukāi!"duì, yào shā nǐ de lǎogong yìzhí zài nǐ de pángbiān.
If I were his wife I'd be scared to death: "Go away, go away!" Right — the husband who tried to kill you is right beside you all the time.
然后那个时候他的老婆受了很重很重的伤。
Ránhòu nàge shíhou tā de lǎopó shòu le hěnzhòng hěnzhòng de shāng.
And at that time his wife was very, very badly injured.
她的身体有很多很多地方碎了，她也不可以说话，对吧？
Tā de shēntǐ yǒu hěnduōhěnduō dìfang suì le, tā yě bù kěyǐ shuōhuà, duì ba?
Many, many bones in her body were broken, and she couldn't speak, right?
她可能没有办法很好地说话。
Tā kěnéng méiyǒu bànfǎ hěn hǎo dì shuōhuà.
She probably couldn't speak properly.
对，然后她的老公二十四小时都在她的旁边，因为她的老公要看着他的老婆：“你不要乱说话。”
Duì, ránhòu tā de lǎogong èrshísì xiǎoshí dōu zài tā de pángbiān, yīnwèi tā de lǎogong yào kànzhe tā de lǎopó: "nǐ búyào luànshuōhuà."
Right, and her husband was by her side 24 hours a day, because he wanted to keep an eye on her: "Don't say anything you shouldn't."
啊，对，然后她的老公有告诉她：“我在这里，你不要乱说话。”
A, duì, ránhòu tā de lǎogong yǒu gàosu tā: "wǒ zài zhèlǐ, nǐ búyào luànshuōhuà."
Oh, right, and her husband told her: "I'm here — don't say anything."
我觉得如果是我，我还是会说出来，因为在医院有人会保护我嘛。
Wǒ juéde rúguǒ shì wǒ, wǒ háishi huì shuō chulai, yīnwèi zài yīyuàn yǒurén huì bǎohù wǒ ma.
I think if it were me, I'd still speak up, because in the hospital people would protect me.
所以我觉得我会说出来：他是杀我的人，这个男人要杀我。
Suǒyǐ wǒ juéde wǒhuì shuō chulai: tā shì shā wǒ de rén, zhège nánrén yào shā wǒ.
So I think I'd say: he's the one who tried to kill me; this man tried to kill me.
但是我觉得这个男人太危险，所以这个女人她要想：OK，那我现在怎么办？对吧？对。
Dànshì wǒ juéde zhège nánrén tài wēixiǎn, suǒyǐ zhège nǚren tā yào xiǎng: ⁢OK⁢, nà wǒ xiànzài zěnmebàn? Duì ba? Duì.
But this man was too dangerous, so the woman had to think: OK, what do I do now? Right? Right.
真的很难很难。她怎么做？我觉得她想了很多办法，这个故事非常非常复杂。
Zhēnde hěnnán hěn nán. Tā zěnme zuò? Wǒ juéde tā xiǎng le hěnduō bànfǎ, zhège gùshi fēicháng fēichángfùzá.
It was really, really hard. What did she do? I think she tried lots of ways; the story is very complicated.
对，然后她最后是有一个中国的朋友去泰国看她，然后帮了她。
Duì, ránhòu tā zuìhòu shì yǒu yíge zhōngguó de péngyou qù tàiguó kàn tā, ránhòu bāng le tā.
Right, in the end a Chinese friend went to Thailand to see her and helped her.
但是这个过程非常非常复杂，然后也和这个男人的妈妈有关系。
Dànshì zhège guòchéng fēicháng fēichángfùzá, ránhòu yě hé zhège nánrén de māma yǒu guānxi.
But the process was very complicated, and it also involved the man's mother.
那最后，最后警察知道了是这个男人要杀她。所以他们抓这个男的吗？对，他们抓了这个男的。
Nà zuìhòu, zuìhòu jǐngchá zhīdào le shì zhège nánrén yào shā tā. Suǒyǐ tāmen zhuā zhège nán de ma? Duì, tāmen zhuā le zhège nán de.
In the end the police found out the man had tried to kill her. So did they arrest him? Yes, they arrested him.

lines: 但是Bella，你觉得，如果你的老公是这么危险的一个男人，你觉得你在平时的生活里，你可以看得出来吗？
Dànshì ⁢Bella⁢, nǐ juéde, rúguǒ nǐ de lǎogong shì zhème wēixiǎn de yíge nánrén, nǐ juéde nǐ zài píngshí de shēnghuó lǐ, nǐ kěyǐ kàndéchūlái ma?
But Bella, if your husband were such a dangerous man, do you think you could tell in everyday life?
可以，一定可以。对吧？一定可以，一定可以，是吧？
Kěyǐ, yídìng kěyǐ. Duì ba? Yídìng kěyǐ, yídìng kěyǐ, shì ba?
Yes, definitely. Right? Definitely, definitely, right?
我觉得人不可能是突然马上变得很坏，他一定是有做过不好的事情，对不对？
Wǒ juéde rén bù kěnéng shì tūrán mǎshàng biànde hěnhuài, tā yídìng shì yǒu zuò guo bùhǎo de shìqing, duì bù duì?
I don't think people suddenly become very bad; he must have done bad things before, right?
没错，一定看得出。对。
Méicuò, yídìng kàndechū. Duì.
Exactly, you'd definitely see it. Right.
所以我有时候觉得，这个中国女人，她赚钱非常的厉害，她在泰国赚了很多很多钱，但是她怎么会看不出来这个男人有那么大的问题？
Suǒyǐ wǒ yǒushíhou juéde, zhège zhōngguó nǚren, tā zhuànqián fēicháng de lìhai, tā zài tàiguó zhuàn le hěnduōhěnduō qián, dànshì tā zěnme huì kànbùchūlái zhège nánrén yǒu nàme dà de wèntí?
So sometimes I think: this Chinese woman was very good at making money — she made lots of money in Thailand — so how could she not see that this man had such big problems?
我有一个问题，老师：这个男的，他杀他的老婆是为了钱吗？
Wǒ yǒu yíge wèntí, lǎoshī: zhège nán de, tāshā tā de lǎopó shì wèile qián ma?
I have a question, teacher: did this man try to kill his wife for money?
对啊。她赚很多钱。
Duì a. Tā zhuàn hěnduō qián.
Yes. She made a lot of money.
是的，她赚很多钱，但是她给了他一次、两次、三次、四次，她说：“我不可以再给你了。”
Shì de, tā zhuàn hěnduō qián, dànshì tā gěi le tā yīcì, liǎngcì, sāncì, sìcì, tā shuō: "wǒ bù kěyǐ zài gěi nǐ le."
Yes, she made lots of money, but after giving him money once, twice, three, four times, she said: "I can't give you any more."
对，然后她的老公很生气，他说：“你不是真的爱我。”
Duì, ránhòu tā de lǎogong hěn shēngqì, tā shuō: "nǐ búshi zhēnde ài wǒ."
Right, and her husband got very angry and said: "You don't really love me."
所以呢，他觉得如果他的老婆死了，他老婆所有的钱都是他的。所以为了钱杀她。是的，就是为了钱。
Suǒyǐ ne, tā juéde rúguǒ tā de lǎopó sǐ le, tā lǎopó suǒyǒu de qián dōu shì tā de. Suǒyǐ wèile qián shā tā. Shì de, jiùshì wèile qián.
So he thought if his wife died, all her money would be his. So he tried to kill her for money. Yes, just for money.
然后我觉得，就是他的老婆已经知道这个男人是有问题的。
Ránhòu wǒ juéde, jiùshì tā de lǎopó yǐjīng zhīdào zhège nánrén shì yǒu wèntí de.
And I think his wife already knew this man had problems.
比如说，她发现这个男人没有工作。
Bǐrúshuō, tā fāxiàn zhège nánrén méiyǒu gōngzuò.
For example, she found out he had no job.
第二个是这个男人喜欢赌博。
Dìèrgè shì zhège nánrén xǐhuan dǔbó.
Second, he liked gambling.
啊，非常不好，非常不好。
A, fēicháng bùhǎo, fēicháng bùhǎo.
Oh, that's very bad, very bad.
对。然后骗她，骗她很多很多次。会打她吗？
Duì. Ránhòu piàn tā, piàn tā hěnduōhěnduō cì. Huì dǎ tā ma?
Right. And he lied to her many, many times. Did he hit her?
他好像没有打她，就是很喜欢说假话，很喜欢骗人。
Tā hǎoxiàng méiyǒu dǎ tā, jiùshì hěn xǐhuan shuō jiǎhuà, hěn xǐhuan piànrén.
I don't think he hit her; he just loved telling lies and cheating people.

And there's another very strange point: this man was very, very close to his mother; he was a mummy's boy.
对，他是妈宝，你知道吗？如果他们三个人一起去旅行，这个男人会和他的妈妈睡在一个床上。

Right, he was a mummy's boy, you know? When the three of them travelled together, he'd sleep in the same bed as his mother.
对，他们三个一起睡一个房间，然后他的妈妈和儿子睡在一个床上。好奇怪，非常奇怪。
Duì, tāmen sāngè yìqǐ shuì yíge fángjiān, ránhòu tā de māma hé érzi shuì zài yíge chuángshàng. Hǎo qíguài, fēicháng qíguài.
Right, the three of them slept in one room, and the mother and son shared a bed. So strange, very strange.
所以这个女人，她知道这所有的东西。对。
Suǒyǐ zhège nǚren, tā zhīdào zhè suǒyǒu de dōngxi. Duì.
So this woman knew all of this. Right.
然后呢，我觉得她发现这个男人是有问题的，对不对？对。
Ránhòu ne, wǒ juéde tā fāxiàn zhège nánrén shì yǒu wèntí de, duì bù duì? Duì.
So I think she found out this man had problems, right? Right.
然后她也可能觉得说：“我现在有了孩子……”
Ránhòu tā yě kěnéng juéde shuō: "wǒ xiànzài yǒu le háizi……"
And she may also have thought: "Now I'm having a child…"
不知道，可能那个时候她可能想：“哦，可能我要想一个办法”，可能是离婚或者是什么。
Bù zhīdào, kěnéng nàge shíhou tā kěnéng xiǎng: "o, kěnéng wǒyào xiǎng yíge bànfǎ", kěnéng shì líhūn huòzhě shì shénme.
I don't know — maybe she thought: "I need to find a way out", maybe divorce or something.
然后呢，就是她的老公骗了她很多很多次以后，突然她的老公变好了。
Ránhòu ne, jiùshì tā de lǎogong piàn le tā hěnduōhěnduō cì yǐhòu, tūrán tā de lǎogong biànhǎo le.
And then, after lying to her many, many times, her husband suddenly became nice.
我觉得变好是因为他想要拿她的钱，他想要杀她，不是突然变好。
Wǒ juéde biàn hǎo shìyīnwèi tā xiǎngyào ná tā de qián, tā xiǎngyào shā tā, búshi tūrán biàn hǎo.
I think he became nice because he wanted her money — he wanted to kill her. It wasn't a real change.
对，我觉得突然变好这个东西也很奇怪。
Duì, wǒ juéde tūrán biàn hǎo zhège dōngxi yě hěn qíguài.
Right, I think suddenly becoming nice is strange too.
你会知道：哦，为什么他以前那么不好，现在突然变好？是不是他想要拿我的钱，还是什么原因？对吧？
Nǐ huì zhīdào: o, wèishénme tā yǐqián nàme bùhǎo, xiànzài tūrán biàn hǎo? Shìbúshì tā xiǎngyào ná wǒ de qián, háishi shénme yuányīn? Duì ba?
You'd think: why was he so bad before and suddenly so nice now? Does he want my money, or what? Right?
对呀。就是那个时候，他们两个人的关系，他们的感情有很大的问题。
Duì ya. Jiùshì nàge shíhou, tāmen liǎnggè rén de guānxi, tāmen de gǎnqíng yǒu hěndà de wèntí.
Exactly. At that time their relationship had big problems.
然后突然她的老公变好了，然后呢就是开始认真地工作，开始每天做饭给她吃，照顾她。
