Then suddenly her husband became nice — started working seriously, cooking for her every day, taking care of her.
然后这个时候这个女人觉得……我觉得可能因为她怀孕了。
Ránhòu zhège shíhou zhège nǚren juéde…… Wǒ juéde kěnéng yīnwèi tā huáiyùn le.
And at that point the woman felt… I think maybe because she was pregnant.
她的身体有一点不一样，她的想法可能觉得：“我的孩子出生没有爸爸，很难过。”所以为了孩子……
Tā de shēntǐ yǒu yìdiǎn bù yīyàng, tā de xiǎngfǎ kěnéng juéde: "wǒ de háizi chūshēng méiyǒu bàba, hěn nánguò."suǒyǐ wèile háizi……
Her body was a bit different, and she may have thought: "My child would be born without a father, how sad." So for the child…
对，她想：“如果我的老公变好了，可能我们可以一起好好地生活。”
Duì, tā xiǎng: "rúguǒ wǒ de lǎogong biànhǎo le, kěnéng wǒmen kěyǐ yìqǐ hǎohǎo dì shēnghuó."
Right, she thought: "If my husband has changed, maybe we can live happily together."
所以我就觉得，她是这么聪明的一个女人，然后呢她都没有办法看清楚这个男人。
Suǒyǐ wǒ jiù juéde, tā shì zhème cōngming de yíge nǚren, ránhòu ne tā dōu méiyǒu bànfǎ kànqīngchǔ zhège nánrén.
So I feel: she was such a smart woman, and yet she couldn't see this man clearly.
我觉得……我不知道老师你有没有这种朋友，就是有些朋友，她可能什么事情都做得很好。
Wǒ juéde…… Wǒ bù zhīdào lǎoshī nǐ yǒuméiyǒu zhèzhǒng péngyou, jiùshì yǒuxiē péngyou, tā kěnéng shénme shìqing dōu zuò de hěn hǎo.
I think… I don't know if you have friends like this, teacher — some friends do everything well.
比如说工作很好，在爸爸妈妈面前也是很好的孩子。
Bǐrúshuō gōngzuò hěn hǎo, zài bàbàmāmā miànqián yě shì hěn hǎo de háizi.
For example, they're good at their jobs and good children to their parents.
但是只有选男朋友的时候，她们总是选对她们非常不好的男生。
Dànshì zhǐyǒu xuǎn nánpéngyou de shíhou, tāmen zǒngshì xuǎn duì tāmen fēicháng bùhǎo de nánshēng.
But when choosing boyfriends, they always pick guys who treat them very badly.
对，可能她是这种人，会不会？
Duì, kěnéng tā shì zhèzhǒng rén, huì búhuì?
Right — could she be that kind of person?
我觉得有可能。我觉得这个女人，她可能对男人没有很多的经验。
Wǒ juéde yǒu kěnéng. Wǒ juéde zhège nǚren, tā kěnéng duì nánrén méiyǒu hěnduō de jīngyàn.
I think it's possible. I think this woman may not have had much experience with men.
因为她可能在学生的时候呢，她就是每天学习，然后她去泰国赚钱，就是工作，她没有交男朋友的经验。
Yīnwèi tā kěnéng zài xuésheng de shíhou ne, tā jiùshì měitiān xuéxí, ránhòu tā qù tàiguó zhuànqián, jiùshì gōngzuò, tā méiyǒu jiāo nánpéngyou de jīngyàn.
Because as a student she probably just studied every day, then went to Thailand to make money — just work; no experience of having boyfriends.
所以她不太知道，比如说这个男人做了这个，你是一定不可以接受的。
Suǒyǐ tā bù tài zhīdào, bǐrúshuō zhège nánrén zuò le zhège, nǐ shì yídìng bù kěyǐ jiēshòu de.
So she didn't really know that if a man does certain things, you absolutely can't accept it.
比如说他赌博，他骗你一次又一次，一次又一次，这是一定不可以接受的。
Bǐrúshuō tā dǔbó, tā piàn nǐ yīcì yòu yīcì, yīcì yòu yīcì, zhèshì yídìng bù kěyǐ jiēshòu de.
Like gambling, or lying to you again and again — that's absolutely unacceptable.
可能知道这些事情都不是好的：他赌博，他不工作。
Kěnéng zhīdào zhèxiē shìqing dōu búshi hǎo de: tā dǔbó, tā bù gōngzuò.
She probably knew these things were bad: he gambled, he didn't work.
可是她可能觉得：“哦，我有一个孩子，我不要孩子出生的时候没有爸爸。所以为了孩子，我可以不要想他没有工作，我可以不要想他去赌博。”
Kěshì tā kěnéng juéde: "o, wǒ yǒu yíge háizi, wǒ búyào háizi chūshēng de shíhou méiyǒu bàba. Suǒyǐ wèile háizi, wǒ kěyǐ búyào xiǎng tā méiyǒu gōngzuò, wǒ kěyǐ búyào xiǎng tā qù dǔbó."
But she may have thought: "I'm having a child; I don't want it born without a father. So for the child I can stop thinking about his not working and his gambling."
是，对，她觉得：“我的孩子应该要有一个爸爸，所以他以前的问题我不想了，但是现在我们好好地一起生活。”
Shì, duì, tā juéde: "wǒ de háizi yīnggāi yào yǒu yíge bàba, suǒyǐ tā yǐqián de wèntí wǒ bùxiǎng le, dànshì xiànzài wǒmen hǎohǎo dì yìqǐ shēnghuó."
Yes, she thought: "My child should have a father, so I'll forget his past problems, and now we'll live well together."
对。我真的觉得非常非常可怕，就是有这么危险的男人在你的旁边。
Duì. Wǒ zhēnde juéde fēicháng fēicháng kěpà, jiùshì yǒu zhème wēixiǎn de nánrén zài nǐ de pángbiān.
Right. I really find it terrifying to have such a dangerous man beside you.
然后他做了那么多不好的事情：他没有工作，这个我不能接受；他赌博，我不能接受；他骗人，我不能接受；他和妈妈的关系那么奇怪，我都不能接受。

Ránhòu tā zuò le nàme duō bùhǎo de shìqing: tā méiyǒu gōngzuò, zhège wǒ bùnéng jiēshòu; tā dǔbó, wǒ bùnéng jiēshòu; tā piànrén, wǒ bùnéng jiēshòu; tā hé māma de guānxi nàme qíguài, wǒ dōu bùnéng jiēshòu.

And he did so many bad things: no job — I couldn't accept that; gambling — I couldn't accept that; lying — I couldn't accept that; such a strange relationship with his mother — I couldn't accept any of it.
有这么多不好的点，这么多危险的点，然后这个女人她没有觉得这些问题是很大的问题，我觉得很奇怪。
Yǒu zhème duō bùhǎo de diǎn, zhème duō wēixiǎn de diǎn, ránhòu zhège nǚren tā méiyǒu juéde zhèxiē wèntí shì hěndà de wèntí, wǒ juéde hěn qíguài.
So many bad points, so many danger signs, and she didn't see them as big problems. I find that strange.
我觉得有的时候，你不是没有看到这些问题，是你选择你不去看这些问题。
Wǒ juéde yǒu de shíhou, nǐ búshi méiyǒu kàndào zhèxiē wèntí, shì nǐ xuǎnzé nǐ bù qù kàn zhèxiē wèntí.
I think sometimes it's not that you don't see the problems — you choose not to look at them.
有可能。
Yǒu kěnéng.
Possibly.
blocks.h: 看得出来吗？ · Could she have seen it coming?

lines: 所以我想问一下老师：最后这个老公，他去坐牢了吗？
Suǒyǐ wǒ xiǎng wèn yīxià lǎoshī: zuìhòu zhège lǎogong, tā qù zuòláo le ma?
So I'd like to ask, teacher: did the husband go to prison in the end?
他去坐牢，他现在在泰国坐牢。但是我觉得好像他不是死刑，我记得。所以有可能他还会出来。
Tā qù zuòláo, tā xiànzài zài tàiguó zuòláo. Dànshì wǒ juéde hǎoxiàng tā búshi sǐxíng, wǒ jìde. Suǒyǐ yǒu kěnéng tā hái huì chulai.
Yes, he's in prison in Thailand now. But I don't think it was the death penalty, as I recall. So he may get out one day.
是的。那他出来以后，这个女的不怕吗？会怕呀，一定会怕的。
Shì de. Nà tā chulai yǐhòu, zhège nǚ de búpà ma? Huìpà ya, yídìng huìpà de.
Right. So when he gets out, won't she be scared? She will — she definitely will.
对。但是我不知道，我觉得可能他出来以后……我不知道，可能在中国可以再想一想办法，说：“这个男人很危险，可不可以帮我、保护我，然后不要让这个男人离我很近。”

Duì. Dànshì wǒ bù zhīdào, wǒ juéde kěnéng tā chulai yǐhòu…… Wǒ bù zhīdào, kěnéng zài zhōngguó kěyǐ zài xiǎngyīxiǎng bànfǎ, shuō: "zhège nánrén hěn wēixiǎn, kěbùkěyǐ bāng wǒ, bǎohù wǒ, ránhòu búyào ràng zhège nánrén lí wǒ hěn jìn."
Right. But I don't know — maybe when he's out, she can find a way in China to say: "This man is dangerous; can you help and protect me, and keep him away from me?"
对，懂了懂了。
Duì, dǒng le dǒng le.
Right, I see.
他在泰国的监狱。然后我以前就是觉得：哦，这个女人她真的很倒霉，就是她有一个这样的老公，她的运气不好，很倒霉。
Tā zài tàiguó de jiānyù. Ránhòu wǒ yǐqián jiùshì juéde: o, zhège nǚren tā zhēnde hěn dǎoméi, jiùshì tā yǒu yíge zhèyàng de lǎogong, tā de yùnqi bùhǎo, hěn dǎoméi.
He's in a Thai prison. I used to think: oh, this woman was really unlucky to have a husband like that — bad luck, really unlucky.
虽然我也觉得她的老公做了那么多不好的事情，她应该是可以离开的。
Suīrán wǒ yě juéde tā de lǎogong zuò le nàme duō bùhǎo de shìqing, tā yīnggāi shì kěyǐ líkāi de.
Although I also thought that, with all the bad things her husband did, she could have left.
然后最近她生病了，她最近因为工作太多，突然晕倒了。
Ránhòu zuìjìn tā shēngbìng le, tā zuìjìn yīnwèi gōngzuò tài duō, tūrán yūndǎo le.
And recently she fell ill — she suddenly fainted from working too much.
对，我心里的感觉不是她很倒霉，我心里的感觉是我很生气。
Duì, wǒ xīnli de gǎnjué búshi tā hěn dǎoméi, wǒ xīnli de gǎnjué shì wǒ hěn shēngqì.
Right, and what I feel now isn't that she's unlucky — what I feel is anger.
就是我觉得：上一次你没有死，就是有那么多的人帮你，医生帮你，然后泰国人帮你，很多很多人帮你。
Jiùshì wǒ juéde: shàng yīcì nǐ méiyǒu sǐ, jiùshì yǒu nàme duō de rén bāng nǐ, yīshēng bāng nǐ, ránhòu tàiguórén bāng nǐ, hěnduōhěnduō rénbāng nǐ.
I think: last time you didn't die — so many people helped you: doctors, Thai people, lots and lots of people.
所以你现在因为工作晕倒了，我觉得：你为什么不好好照顾你自己？
Suǒyǐ nǐ xiànzài yīnwèi gōngzuò yūndǎo le, wǒ juéde: nǐ wèishénme bù hǎohǎo zhàogu nǐ zìjǐ?
So now you faint from overwork, and I think: why don't you take good care of yourself?
我觉得是有一点生气的。我的想法是：你上次遇到了什么？然后你不要再让这个事情再发生一次。
Wǒ juéde shì yǒu yìdiǎn shēngqì de. Wǒ de xiǎngfǎ shì: nǐ shàngcì yùdào le shénme? Ránhòu nǐ búyào zài ràng zhège shìqing zài fāshēng yīcì.
I feel a bit angry. My thought is: remember what happened to you last time? Don't let something like that happen again.
她是不是很爱赚钱呢？她是很爱赚钱。
Tā shìbúshì hěn ài zhuànqián ne? Tā shì hěn ài zhuànqián.
Does she really love making money? She does.
不知道她那个赚钱是因为她需要那么多的钱，还是说她就是喜欢赚钱，我不太知道。但是我就是觉得很生气：你为什么没有很好地照顾你自己？

Bù zhīdào tā nàge zhuànqián shìyīnwèi tā xūyào nàme duō de qián, háishi shuō tā jiùshì xǐhuan zhuànqián, wǒ bù tài zhīdào. Dànshì wǒ jiùshì juéde hěn shēngqì: nǐ wèishénme méiyǒu hěn hǎo dì zhàogu nǐ zìjǐ?
I don't know if it's because she needs that much money or just likes making money. But I just feel angry: why didn't you take good care of yourself?
我觉得听了这个故事以后，我觉得有的时候每个人都有自己觉得最重要的事情。对她来说，可能赚钱是最重要的。所以我不知道这是她觉得更好，还是更不好。

Wǒ juéde tīng le zhège gùshi yǐhòu, wǒ juéde yǒu de shíhou měigè rén dōu yǒu zìjǐ juéde zuì zhòngyào de shìqing. Duì tā láishuō, kěnéng zhuànqián shì zuì zhòngyào de. Suǒyǐ wǒ bù zhīdào zhè shì tā juéde gènghǎo, háishi gèng bùhǎo.
After hearing this story, I think everyone has something they consider most important. For her, maybe making money is the most important thing. So I don't know whether that's better or worse for her.
blocks.h: 后来怎么样了？ · What happened next?

q: 贝拉以前就听过这个新闻。
Bèilā yǐqián jiù tīng guo zhège xīnwén.
Bella had heard this news before.
tf.why: She had never heard of it, although it was huge in China.

q: 那个女人被推下山的时候怀孕了。
Nàge nǚren bèi tuī xiàshān de shíhou huáiyùn le.
The woman was pregnant when she was pushed off the mountain.
tf.why: That's why it was like killing two people.

q: 那个女人很想去看日出。
Nàge nǚren hěn xiǎng qù kàn rìchū.
The woman really wanted to see the sunrise.
tf.why: She didn't want to go, but he insisted.

q: 女人掉下去的时候先掉到了一棵树上。
Nǚren diàoxiàqù de shíhou xiāndiào dào le yīkēshù shàng.
As she fell, the woman landed in a tree first.
tf.why: The tree protected her.

q: 老公推完以后马上打电话叫了医生。
Lǎogong tuīwán yǐhòu mǎshàng dǎdiànhuà jiào le yīshēng.
Right after pushing her, the husband called a doctor.
tf.why: He drove away; two lost Thai hikers found her and called the hospital.

q: 发现她的是两个迷路的泰国人。
Fāxiàn tā de shì liǎnggè mílù de tàiguórén.
She was found by two Thai people who were lost.
tf.why: Two Thai hikers got lost and found her.

q: 在医院，老公假装很担心他的老婆。
Zài yīyuàn, lǎogong jiǎzhuāng hěn dānxīn tā de lǎopó.
At the hospital the husband pretended to be very worried about his wife.
tf.why: He cried and said he couldn't find her and was worried.

q: 那个女人在医院可以很好地说话。
Nàge nǚren zài yīyuàn kěyǐ hěn hǎo dì shuōhuà.
In hospital the woman could speak well.
tf.why: She was badly hurt and couldn't speak properly.

q: 那个男人想要老婆的钱。
Nàge nánrén xiǎngyào lǎopó de qián.
The man wanted his wife's money.
tf.why: If she died, all her money would be his.

q: 那个男人常常打他的老婆。
Nàge nánrén chángcháng dǎ tā de lǎopó.
The man often hit his wife.
tf.why: He doesn't seem to have hit her; he lied and cheated a lot.

q: 那个男人被判了死刑。
Nàge nánrén bèipàn le sǐxíng.
The man was sentenced to death.
tf.why: He's in prison in Thailand; Su Qing thinks it wasn't the death penalty.

q: 那个女人现在住在泰国的一个小村子里。
Nàge nǚren xiànzài zhù zài tàiguó de yíge xiǎocūnzi lǐ.
The woman now lives in a small village in Thailand.
tf.why: Where she lives now isn't mentioned.

q: 老公是怎么知道老婆没有死的？
Lǎogong shì zěnme zhīdào lǎopó méiyǒu sǐ de?
How did the husband find out his wife wasn't dead?
o: Tā kàndào le yīyuàn de chē
Lǎopó gěi tā dǎ le diànhuà
he went back up the mountain
mc.why: While driving he saw the ambulance and followed it to the hospital.

q: 老婆为什么说“我不可以再给你了”？
Lǎopó wèishénme shuō "wǒ bù kěyǐ zài gěi nǐ le"?
Why did the wife say 'I can't give you any more'?
o: 她已经给了他好几次钱
Tā yǐjīng gěi le tā hǎo jǐcì qián
she had already given him money several times
she wanted to give money to her mother
mc.why: She'd given him money four times already.

q: 下面哪一个不是那个男人的问题？
Xiàmiàn na yíge búshi nàge nánrén de wèntí?
Which of these was NOT one of the man's problems?
mc.why: Drinking isn't mentioned; no job, gambling, lying and a strange bond with his mother are.

q: 素清最近为什么对这个女人很生气？
Sù Qīng zuìjìn wèishénme duì zhège nǚren hěn shēngqì?
Why is Su Qing angry with the woman lately?
o: 她又和那个男人在一起了
Tā yòu hé nàge nánrén zài yìqǐ le
she got back together with the man
她因为工作太多晕倒了，没有好好照顾自己
Tā yīnwèi gōngzuò tài duō yūndǎo le, méiyǒu hǎohǎo zhàogu zìjǐ
she fainted from overwork and didn't look after herself
mc.why: So many people saved her, yet she doesn't take care of herself.

q: 老公在医院的时候，老婆为什么不马上说出真相？
Lǎogong zài yīyuàn de shíhou, lǎopó wèishénme bù mǎshàng shuōchū zhēnxiàng?
Why didn't the wife tell the truth straight away in hospital?
ans: 因为她受了很重的伤，不能好好说话，而且老公二十四小时都在旁边看着她，叫她不要乱说话，她觉得很危险。
Yīnwèi tā shòu le hěn zhòng de shāng, bùnéng hǎohǎo shuōhuà, érqiě lǎogong èrshísì xiǎoshí dōu zài pángbiān kànzhe tā, jiào tā búyào luànshuōhuà, tā juéde hěn wēixiǎn.
Because she was badly hurt and couldn't speak properly, and her husband watched her 24 hours a day and told her not to say anything; it was dangerous.

q: 老公突然“变好”以后，老婆为什么相信了他？
Lǎogong tūrán "biàn hǎo"yǐhòu, lǎopó wèishénme xiāngxìn le tā?
After the husband suddenly 'became nice', why did the wife believe him?
ans: 因为她怀孕了，不想孩子出生的时候没有爸爸，希望他们可以一起好好生活。
Yīnwèi tā huáiyùn le, bùxiǎng háizi chūshēng de shíhou méiyǒu bàba, xīwàng tāmen kěyǐ yìqǐ hǎohǎo shēnghuó.
Because she was pregnant and didn't want the child to be born without a father; she hoped they could live well together.

q: 贝拉觉得这个女人为什么看不清楚这个男人？
Bèilā juéde zhège nǚren wèishénme kànbùqīngchǔ zhège nánrén?
Why does Bella think the woman couldn't see the man clearly?
ans: 她可能对男人没有经验，以前一直学习、工作，没有交过男朋友；也可能是她选择不去看这些问题。
Tā kěnéng duì nánrén méiyǒu jīngyàn, yǐqián yìzhí xuéxí, gōngzuò, méiyǒu jiāo guo nánpéngyou; yě kěnéng shì tā xuǎnzé bùqù kàn zhèxiē wèntí.
She may have had no experience with men — she'd always studied and worked and never had boyfriends; or she chose not to look at the problems.

007.title: The most wanted killer of 2004
007.transcriptNote: 素清 Sù Qīng tells the story of the 2004 Ma Jiajue case at Yunnan University. Short sentences and a slow pace — a good first listen. Fillers like 嗯 are mostly left out.

lines: 在二零零四年的二月十四号，是情人节。很多男朋友、女朋友应该一起过情人节。
Zài èrlínglíngsìnián de èryuè shísìhào, shì qíngrénjié. Hěnduō nánpéngyou, nǚpéngyou yīnggāi yìqǐ guo qíngrénjié.
On 14 February 2004 it was Valentine's Day. Lots of boyfriends and girlfriends would spend it together.
那个时候在中国的一所大学，叫云南大学，有一个女生……
Nàge shíhou zài zhōngguó de yīsuǒ dàxué, jiào Yúnnán Dàxué, yǒu yíge nǚshēng……
At that time, at a Chinese university called Yunnan University, there was a girl…
她联系她的男朋友，因为她想一起过情人节，想一起庆祝情人节。
Tā liánxì tā de nánpéngyou, yīnwèi tā xiǎng yìqǐ guo qíngrénjié, xiǎng yìqǐ qìngzhù qíngrénjié.
She contacted her boyfriend, because she wanted to spend Valentine's Day together, to celebrate it together.
可是怎么都联系不上，联系不上她的男朋友。
Kěshì zěnme dōu liánxì bùshàng, liánxì bùshàng tā de nánpéngyou.
But she couldn't reach him whatever she tried — she couldn't get hold of her boyfriend.
很奇怪，为什么呢？
Hěn qíguài, wèishénme ne?
Strange — why?
blocks.h: 联系不上 · Unreachable

lines: 在二月二十三号的时候，在云南大学的宿舍，有一个同学，他姓苗，苗同学……
Zài èryuè èrshísān hào de shíhou, zài Yúnnán Dàxué de sùshè, yǒu yíge tóngxué, tā xìng miáo, Miáo tóngxué……
On 23 February, in a Yunnan University dormitory, a student surnamed Miao — student Miao…
闻到他的宿舍有很臭的味道。很臭的味道，他觉得很奇怪。
Wéndào tā de sùshè yǒu hěn chòu de wèidao. Hěn chòu de wèidao, tā juéde hěn qíguài.
smelled a terrible smell in his dormitory. A terrible smell; he found it strange.
所以呢他报警了，他打电话给警察。
Suǒyǐ ne tā bàojǐng le, tā dǎdiànhuà gěi jǐngchá.
So he called the police; he phoned them.
在中国，他打了110，他打电话报警。
Zài zhōngguó, tā dǎ le 110, tā dǎdiànhuà bàojǐng.
In China he dialled 110 — he called the police.
然后警察来到他的宿舍。警察来到宿舍……
Ránhòu jǐngchá láidào tā de sùshè. Jǐngchá láidào sùshè……
Then the police came to the dormitory. The police came…
他们在衣柜里发现了四个尸体。
Tāmen zài yīguì lǐ fāxiàn le sìgè shītǐ.
and found four bodies in the wardrobes.
这个宿舍有三个人都死了。
Zhège sùshè yǒu sāngè rén dōu sǐ le.
Three people from this dormitory were all dead.
还有一个人不在这里。在哪里？
Háiyǒu yíge rén bù zài zhèlǐ. Zài nǎlǐ?
And one person wasn't there. Where was he?
这个不在的人，他的名字叫马加爵。
Zhège bù zài de rén, tā de míngzi jiào Mǎ Jiājué.
The missing person was called Ma Jiajue.
他是二零零四年在中国最有名的人，因为他杀了四个人。
Tā shì èrlínglíngsìnián zài zhōngguó zuì yǒumíng de rén, yīnwèi tāshā le sìgè rén.
He was the most famous person in China in 2004, because he killed four people.
blocks.h: 宿舍里的味道 · The smell in the dormitory

lines: 那个时候，警察很快确定这个杀人犯就是马加爵。
Nàge shíhou, jǐngchá hěnkuài quèdìng zhège shārénfàn jiùshì Mǎ Jiājué.
At that time the police quickly established that the killer was Ma Jiajue.
所以在那个时候，他们在电视里发了通缉令。
Suǒyǐ zài nàge shíhou, tāmen zài diànshì lǐfā le tōngjīlìng.
So they issued a wanted notice on TV.
就是他们告诉所有的人：“我们要抓马加爵。
Jiùshì tāmen gàosu suǒyǒu de rén: "wǒmen yào zhuā Mǎ Jiājué.
They told everyone: "We want to catch Ma Jiajue.
如果你们看到马加爵，你要告诉我们。”
Rúguǒ nǐmen kàndào Mǎ Jiājué, nǐ yào gàosu wǒmen."
If you see Ma Jiajue, tell us."
在这个通缉令里，他们说了马加爵的身高、他的样子，还有他的特点。
Zài zhège tōngjīlìng lǐ, tāmen shuō le Mǎ Jiājué de shēngāo, tā de yàngzi, háiyǒu tā de tèdiǎn.
The wanted notice gave Ma Jiajue's height, his appearance and his distinguishing features.
那个时候，警察说：“如果你帮我们找到了这个凶手，我们会给你二十万的人民币。”
Nàge shíhou, jǐngchá shuō: "rúguǒ nǐ bāng wǒmen zhǎodào le zhège xiōngshǒu, wǒmen huì gěi nǐ èrshíwàn de rénmínbì."
The police said: "If you help us find this murderer, we'll give you 200,000 yuan."
在那个时候，二十万的人民币是很多的钱。
Zài nàge shíhou, èrshíwàn de rénmínbì shì hěnduō de qián.
At that time 200,000 yuan was a lot of money.
你可以在中国的云南买到一个房子。
Nǐ kěyǐ zài zhōngguó de yúnnán mǎi dào yíge fángzi.
You could buy a house in Yunnan.
那个时候普通的人一年可以赚一万块。
Nàge shíhou pǔtōng de rén yīnián kěyǐ zhuàn yīwànkuài.
An ordinary person then could earn ten thousand yuan a year.
所以二十万，你要工作二十年。
Suǒyǐ èrshíwàn, nǐ yào gōngzuò èrshínián.
So for 200,000 you'd have to work twenty years.
所以对普通的人，那个钱是很多很多的。
Suǒyǐ duì pǔtōng de rén, nàge qián shì hěnduōhěnduō de.
So for ordinary people it was a huge amount of money.
blocks.h: 通缉令 · The wanted notice

lines: 那现在警察知道了杀人犯是谁，全中国的人也认识这个杀人犯。
Nà xiànzài jǐngchá zhīdào le shārénfàn shì shuí, quán zhōngguó de rén yě rènshi zhège shārénfàn.
Now the police knew who the killer was, and everyone in China knew him too.
那警察可以很快抓到他吗？
Nà jǐngchá kěyǐ hěnkuài zhuādào tā ma?
So could the police catch him quickly?
我们来看看凶手在做什么。
Wǒmen lái kànkan xiōngshǒu zài zuò shénme.
Let's look at what the murderer was doing.
在二月十三号以前，马加爵买了杀人的工具。
Zài èryuè shísānhào yǐqián, Mǎ Jiājué mǎi le shārén de gōngjù.
Before 13 February, Ma Jiajue bought a tool for killing.
他买了一把锤子，这个锤子是用来杀人的。
Tā mǎi le yībǎ chuízi, zhège chuízi shì yònglái shārén de.
He bought a hammer; the hammer was for killing.
然后呢，他还买了假的身份证。
Ránhòu ne, tā hái mǎi le jiǎ de shēnfènzhèng.
He also bought a fake ID card.
因为在中国，你做很多事情都需要身份证。
Yīnwèi zài zhōngguó, nǐ zuò hěnduō shìqing dōu xūyào shēnfènzhèng.
Because in China you need an ID card for lots of things.
所以呢他在做准备，因为他知道他杀人以后需要逃跑。所以他买了假的身份证。
Suǒyǐ ne tā zài zuò zhǔnbèi, yīnwèi tā zhīdào tā shārén yǐhòu xūyào táopǎo. Suǒyǐ tā mǎi le jiǎ de shēnfènzhèng.
So he was preparing, because he knew he'd have to flee after killing. So he bought a fake ID.
那在二月十三号到二月十五号，就三天……
Nà zài èryuè shísānhào dào èryuè shíwǔhào, jiù sāntiān……
Then from 13 to 15 February — just three days…
他用锤子杀了四个人，然后用他的假身份证逃跑。
Tāyòng chuízi shā le sìgè rén, ránhòu yòng tā de jiǎ shēnfènzhèng táopǎo.
he killed four people with the hammer and fled using his fake ID.
他从云南坐火车到广州。
Tā cóng yúnnán zuòhuǒchē dào guǎngzhōu.
He took a train from Yunnan to Guangzhou.
然后从广州坐火车到海南。
Ránhòu cóng guǎngzhōu zuòhuǒchē dào hǎinán.
And from Guangzhou, a train to Hainan.
那个时候，因为全中国的人都看到了这个通缉令，所以呢马加爵也看到了。
Nàge shíhou, yīnwèi quán zhōngguó de rén dōu kàndào le zhège tōngjīlìng, suǒyǐ ne Mǎ Jiājué yě kàndào le.
Since everyone in China had seen the wanted notice, Ma Jiajue saw it too.
所以他不敢和别的人说话，不敢用他的钱买吃的东西。
Suǒyǐ tā bùgǎn hé biéde rén shuōhuà, bùgǎn yòng tā de qián mǎi chī de dōngxi.
So he didn't dare talk to anyone or use his money to buy food.
那个时候他像一个乞丐一样的，睡在路上，然后在垃圾桶里找吃的东西。
Nàge shíhou tā xiàng yíge qǐgài yīyàng de, shuì zài lùshang, ránhòu zài lājītǒng lǐ zhǎo chī de dōngxi.
He was like a beggar, sleeping in the street and looking for food in bins.
所以那时候他看起来和平时很不一样。
Suǒyǐ nà shíhou tā kànqǐlai hé píngshí hěn bù yīyàng.
So he looked very different from usual.
我记得那个时候，我每天打开电视，我都可以看到那个通缉令。
Wǒ jìde nàge shíhou, wǒ měitiān dǎkāi diànshì, wǒ dōu kěyǐ kàndào nàge tōngjīlìng.
I remember that every day when I turned on the TV, I could see that wanted notice.
所以全中国的人都知道这个马加爵杀了很多人。
Suǒyǐ quán zhōngguó de rén dōu zhīdào zhège Mǎ Jiājué shā le hěnduō rén.
So everyone in China knew this Ma Jiajue had killed many people.
全中国的人都在注意：马加爵在哪里？
Quán zhōngguó de rén dōu zài zhùyì: Mǎ Jiājué zài nǎlǐ?
The whole country was watching out: where is Ma Jiajue?
过了差不多一个月，也就是差不多三月十五号的时候……
Guo le chàbuduō yígèyuè, yě jiùshì chàbuduō sānyuè shíwǔhào de shíhou……
After about a month — around 15 March…
终于，终于在海南，有一个司机，他是摩托车的司机，看到了马加爵。
Zhōngyú, zhōngyú zài hǎinán, yǒu yíge sījī, tā shì mótuōchē de sījī, kàndào le Mǎ Jiājué.
at last, in Hainan, a driver — a motorbike-taxi driver — spotted Ma Jiajue.
然后呢他报警，所以警察抓到了马加爵。
Ránhòu ne tā bàojǐng, suǒyǐ jǐngchá zhuādào le Mǎ Jiājué.
He called the police, and the police caught Ma Jiajue.
blocks.h: 逃跑 · On the run

lines: 现在我们抓到了马加爵，我们来看看马加爵为什么杀人。
Xiànzài wǒmen zhuādào le Mǎ Jiājué, wǒmen lái kànkan Mǎ Jiājué wèishénme shārén.
Now that he's been caught, let's look at why Ma Jiajue killed.
那有很多人说：是不是因为马加爵被他的同学欺负？
Nàyǒu hěnduō rén shuō: shìbúshì yīnwèi Mǎ Jiājué bèi tā de tóngxué qīfu?
Many people said: was it because his classmates bullied him?
可能他的同学对他不好，欺负他，所以他杀了他的同学。
Kěnéng tā de tóngxué duì tā bùhǎo, qīfu tā, suǒyǐ tāshā le tā de tóngxué.
Maybe his classmates treated him badly and bullied him, so he killed them.
还是因为马加爵他的家非常的穷，那他的同学可能更有钱。
Háishi yīnwèi Mǎ Jiājué tā de jiā fēicháng de qióng, nà tā de tóngxué kěnéng gèng yǒuqián.
Or was it because his family was very poor and his classmates may have been richer?
所以马加爵讨厌比他有钱的人。
Suǒyǐ Mǎ Jiājué tǎoyàn bǐ tā yǒuqián de rén.
So Ma Jiajue hated people richer than him.
是不是因为这些原因呢？
Shìbúshì yīnwèi zhèxiē yuányīn ne?
Was it for these reasons?
第一个，我们先来看看他杀人的直接原因。
Dìyígè, wǒmen xiān lái kànkan tā shārén de zhíjiēyuányīn.
First, let's look at the immediate cause of the killings.
直接的原因是马加爵和他的同学，他们在打牌。
Zhíjiē de yuányīn shì Mǎ Jiājué hé tā de tóngxué, tāmen zài dǎpái.
The immediate cause: Ma Jiajue and his classmates were playing cards.
有一个同学说马加爵作弊。
Yǒu yíge tóngxué shuō Mǎ Jiājué zuòbì.
One classmate said Ma Jiajue was cheating.
然后他又说：“马加爵，你真的是一个不好的人，你是一个有问题的人，大家都不喜欢你。”
Ránhòu tā yòu shuō: "Mǎ Jiājué, nǐ zhēnde shì yíge bùhǎo de rén, nǐ shì yíge yǒu wèntí de rén, dàjiā dōu bù xǐhuan nǐ."
Then he said: "Ma Jiajue, you're really a bad person, there's something wrong with you; nobody likes you."
那因为这件事情，他们吵架。
Nà yīnwèi zhèjiàn shìqing, tāmen chǎojià.
Because of this, they quarrelled.
然后可能在吵架的时候，他们有说到马加爵去找妓女这件事情。
Ránhòu kěnéng zài chǎojià de shíhou, tāmen yǒu shuō dào Mǎ Jiājué qù zhǎo jìnǚ zhèjiàn shìqing.
And during the quarrel they may have mentioned that Ma Jiajue went to prostitutes.
因为马加爵在他的大学找不到女朋友，他不是一个很受欢迎的男生。
Yīnwèi Mǎ Jiājué zài tā de dàxué zhǎo búdào nǚpéngyou, tā búshi yíge hěn shòuhuānyíng de nánshēng.
Because he couldn't find a girlfriend at university; he wasn't a popular guy.
所以他有的时候会去花钱找女生睡觉。
Suǒyǐ tā yǒu de shíhou huì qù huāqián zhǎo nǚshēng shuìjiào.
So he sometimes paid women to sleep with him.
可能他们聊到了这个找妓女的事情。
Kěnéng tāmen liáodào le zhège zhǎo jìnǚ de shìqing.
They may have talked about this.
那你们知道，中国还是一个比较传统的国家。
Nà nǐmen zhīdào, zhōngguó háishi yíge bǐjiào chuántǒng de guójiā.
You know China is still a fairly traditional country.
所以有可能马加爵觉得：哇，这件事情很丢脸，如果大家都知道他找了妓女，那他很没有面子。
Suǒyǐ yǒu kěnéng Mǎ Jiājué juéde: wa, zhèjiàn shìqing hěn diūliǎn, rúguǒ dàjiā dōu zhīdào tā zhǎo le jìnǚ, nà tā hěn méiyǒu miànzi.
So Ma Jiajue may have felt it was shameful: if everyone knew he'd been to prostitutes, he'd lose face.
所以有的人觉得，马加爵可能是害怕大家发现他找了妓女，他就把知道这件事的所有的人都杀了。
Suǒyǐ yǒu de rén juéde, Mǎ Jiājué kěnéng shì hàipà dàjiā fāxiàn tā zhǎo le jìnǚ, tā jiù bǎ zhīdào zhèjiàn shì de suǒyǒu de rén dōu shā le.
So some people think he was afraid people would find out, so he killed everyone who knew.
在中文我们叫“杀人灭口”，因为你把人杀了，他们就不可以说话了。
Zài zhōngwén wǒmen jiào "shārénmièkǒu", yīnwèi nǐ bǎ rén shā le, tāmen jiù bù kěyǐ shuōhuà le.
In Chinese we call it 杀人灭口, "killing to silence", because once you kill people they can't talk.
所以呢，好，所以听起来这个吵架是他杀人的直接原因。
Suǒyǐ ne, hǎo, suǒyǐ tīng qǐlai zhège chǎojià shì tā shārén de zhíjiēyuányīn.
So it sounds like the quarrel was the immediate cause of the killings.
blocks.h: 为什么杀人？ · Why did he kill?

lines: 那我们现在来看一看，马加爵到底是一个什么样的人呢？
Nà wǒmen xiànzài láikàn yīkàn, Mǎ Jiājué dàodǐ shì yíge shénmeyàng de rén ne?
Now let's look at what kind of person Ma Jiajue really was.
马加爵呢，他在云南上大学，但是他不是一个云南人，他是来自中国广西的。
Mǎ Jiājué ne, tā zài yúnnán shàng dàxué, dànshì tā búshi yíge yúnnán rén, tā shì láizì zhōngguó guǎngxī de.
He studied in Yunnan, but he wasn't from Yunnan; he came from Guangxi.
他小的时候家里很穷。
Tā xiǎo de shíhou jiālǐ hěnqióng.
His family was very poor when he was little.
有两个哥哥，一个姐姐，爸爸妈妈都是农民，非常非常穷。
Yǒu liǎnggè gēge, yíge jiějie, bàbàmāmā dōu shì nóngmín, fēicháng fēicháng qióng.
He had two older brothers and an older sister; his parents were farmers, very, very poor.
他们一年的收入是一千人民币，不到两百美金，所以真的是很穷很穷的农民。
Tāmen yīnián de shōurù shì yīqiān rénmínbì, búdào liǎngbǎi měijīn, suǒyǐ zhēnde shì hěnqióng hěnqióng de nóngmín.
Their yearly income was a thousand yuan, less than two hundred US dollars — really, really poor farmers.
但是马加爵的学习是最好的。他的两个哥哥和一个姐姐都不是很好的学生，他们的学习一般般，但是马加爵的学习是非常好的。
Dànshì Mǎ Jiājué de xuéxí shì zuìhǎo de. Tā de liǎnggè gēge hé yíge jiějie dōu búshi hěn hǎo de xuésheng, tāmen de xuéxí yìbānbān, dànshì Mǎ Jiājué de xuéxí shì fēicháng hǎo de.
But Ma Jiajue was the best at school. His two brothers and sister weren't good students — just average — but he did very well.
那马加爵的父母和很多中国的父母差不多，他们觉得：这个孩子……
Nà Mǎ Jiājué de fùmǔ hé hěnduō zhōngguó de fùmǔ chàbuduō, tāmen juéde: zhège háizi……
His parents were like many Chinese parents; they thought: this child…
他不常常和我们说话，但是他的学习很好，是一个很安静的孩子，所以他是一个好孩子。
Tā bù chángcháng hé wǒmen shuōhuà, dànshì tā de xuéxí hěn hǎo, shì yíge hěn ānjìng de háizi, suǒyǐ tā shì yíge hǎoháizi.
doesn't talk to us much, but he studies well and he's quiet, so he's a good kid.
但是他们不知道，马加爵在学校非常不开心。
Dànshì tāmen bù zhīdào, Mǎ Jiājué zài xuéxiào fēicháng bù kāixīn.
But they didn't know he was very unhappy at school.
他没有交到很好的朋友，没有女朋友。
Tā méiyǒu jiāodào hěn hǎo de péngyou, méiyǒu nǚpéngyou.
He didn't make good friends and had no girlfriend.
他也觉得自己很穷，所以他心里不自信。
Tā yě juéde zìjǐ hěnqióng, suǒyǐ tā xīnli bù zìxìn.
He also felt poor, so inside he lacked confidence.
马加爵呢，在他的日记里也有写，他说，他看到爸爸妈妈吵架，很生气，他说他想要杀了他的爸爸。
Mǎ Jiājué ne, zài tā de rìjì lǐ yě yǒu xiě, tā shuō, tā kàndào bàbàmāmā chǎojià, hěn shēngqì, tā shuō tā xiǎngyào shā le tā de bàba.
Ma Jiajue also wrote in his diary that when he saw his parents arguing, he was so angry he wanted to kill his father.
还有一次呢，他在日记里写，他和他的奶奶在吵架。
Háiyǒu yīcì ne, tā zài rìjì lǐ xiě, tā hé tā de nǎinai zài chǎojià.
Another time he wrote that he'd argued with his grandmother.
因为他们都在看电视，奶奶想看的东西和他想看的东西不一样，所以他说……
Yīnwèi tāmen dōu zài kàndiànshì, nǎinai xiǎng kàn de dōngxi hé tā xiǎng kàn de dōngxi bù yīyàng, suǒyǐ tā shuō……
Because they were both watching TV and wanted to watch different things, so he wrote…
“我恨我的奶奶。”
"wǒ hèn wǒ de nǎinai."
"I hate my grandmother."
那中国有一个心理学家，他是非常有名的心理学家。
Nà zhōngguó yǒu yíge xīnlǐxuéjiā, tā shì fēicháng yǒumíng de xīnlǐxuéjiā.
A very famous Chinese psychologist…
他觉得马加爵杀人，不是因为他的家很贫穷，别的同学更有钱。因为其实马加爵的同学也都是很穷的人。
Tā juéde Mǎ Jiājué shārén, búshi yīnwèi tā de jiā hěn pínqióng, biéde tóngxué gèng yǒuqián. Yīnwèi qíshí Mǎ Jiājué de tóngxué yě dōu shì hěnqióng de rén.
believed Ma Jiajue didn't kill because his family was poor and others were richer — in fact his classmates were also poor.
所以并不是因为马加爵的同学更有钱，然后他比较穷，他讨厌有钱的人。
Suǒyǐ bìng búshi yīnwèi Mǎ Jiājué de tóngxué gèng yǒuqián, ránhòu tā bǐjiào qióng, tā tǎoyàn yǒuqián de rén.
So it wasn't that his classmates were richer, he was poorer, and he hated the rich.
这个心理学家觉得最重要的原因，可能是因为他的内心很迷茫，不知道他要什么东西。
Zhège xīnlǐxuéjiā juéde zuì zhòngyào de yuányīn, kěnéng shìyīnwèi tā de nèixīn hěn mímáng, bù zhīdào tā yào shénme dōngxi.
The psychologist thought the most important reason was probably that he was lost inside and didn't know what he wanted.
他也不知道生活的意义是什么。
Tā yě bù zhīdào shēnghuó de yìyì shì shénme.
He didn't know what the meaning of life was either.
那时候他有了电脑，所以他打很多游戏。
Nà shíhou tā yǒu le diànnǎo, suǒyǐ tā dǎ hěnduō yóuxì.
At that time he had a computer, so he played lots of games.
他习惯了游戏里的暴力，所以在现实生活中，他也杀了人。
Tā xíguàn le yóuxì lǐ de bàolì, suǒyǐ zài xiànshíshēnghuó zhōng, tā yě shālerén.
He got used to the violence in games, so in real life he killed people too.
blocks.h: 马加爵是什么样的人？ · What kind of person was he?

lines: 所以在二零零四年的四月二十四号，他被判了死刑。
Suǒyǐ zài èrlínglíngsìnián de sìyuè èrshísì hào, tā bèipàn le sǐxíng.
So on 24 April 2004 he was sentenced to death.
我记得马加爵这个案子在二零零四年的时候，真的是一个很大很大的新闻，因为真的每一天的电视都在说他的事情。
Wǒ jìde Mǎ Jiājué zhège ànzi zài èrlínglíngsìnián de shíhou, zhēnde shì yíge hěndà hěndà de xīnwén, yīnwèi zhēnde měi yītiān de diànshì dōu zài shuō tā de shìqing.
I remember the Ma Jiajue case was huge news in 2004, because the TV talked about him every single day.
我觉得我们没有办法真的知道他到底为什么杀人。
Wǒ juéde wǒmen méiyǒu bànfǎ zhēnde zhīdào tā dàodǐ wèishénme shārén.
I think we can never really know why he killed.
可能他的脑子和普通人的脑子是不一样的。
Kěnéng tā de nǎozi hé pǔtōngrén de nǎozi shì bù yīyàng de.
Maybe his brain was different from ordinary people's.
所以我也没有办法知道他杀人的真正的原因。
Suǒyǐ wǒ yě méiyǒu bànfǎ zhīdào tā shārén de zhēnzhèng de yuányīn.
So I can't know the real reason he killed either.
你们呢？你们觉得马加爵为什么杀人？
Nǐmen ne? Nǐmen juéde Mǎ Jiājué wèishénme shārén?
What about you? Why do you think Ma Jiajue killed?
在你们的国家有没有差不多的案子？就是在大学的宿舍里杀了很多人。
Zài nǐmen de guójiā yǒuméiyǒu chàbuduō de ànzi? Jiùshì zài dàxué de sùshè lǐ shā le hěnduō rén.
Are there similar cases in your country — someone killing many people in a university dormitory?
那这个就是今天的案子。以后我会跟你们分享更多的案子。我们下个视频见！
Nà zhège jiùshì jīntiān de ànzi. Yǐhòu wǒhuì gēn nǐmen fēnxiǎng gèng duō de ànzi. Wǒmen xiàge shìpín jiàn!
That's today's case. I'll share more cases with you in future. See you in the next video!

q: 情人节那天，那个女生联系不上她的男朋友。
Qíngrénjié nàtiān, nàge nǚshēng liánxì bùshàng tā de nánpéngyou.
On Valentine's Day the girl couldn't reach her boyfriend.
tf.why: She couldn't get hold of him however she tried.

q: 苗同学是在二月十四号报警的。
Miáo tóngxué shì zài èryuè shísìhào bàojǐng de.
Student Miao called the police on 14 February.
tf.why: It was on 23 February.

q: 警察在床下面发现了尸体。
Jǐngchá zài chuáng xiàmiàn fāxiàn le shītǐ.
The police found the bodies under the beds.
tf.why: They were found in the wardrobes.

q: 马加爵一共杀了四个人。
Mǎ Jiājué yīgòng shā le sìgè rén.
Ma Jiajue killed four people in total.
tf.why: He killed four people with a hammer.

q: 警察说，帮忙找到凶手的人可以得到二十万人民币。
Jǐngchá shuō, bāngmáng zhǎodào xiōngshǒu de rén kěyǐ dédào èrshíwàn rénmínbì.
The police offered 200,000 yuan to anyone who helped find the killer.
tf.why: That was about twenty years' income for an ordinary person.

q: 马加爵坐飞机从云南逃到了海南。
Mǎ Jiājué zuòfēijī cóng yúnnán táodào le hǎinán.
Ma Jiajue flew from Yunnan to Hainan.
tf.why: He took trains: Yunnan to Guangzhou, then Guangzhou to Hainan.

q: 逃跑的时候，他像乞丐一样在垃圾桶里找吃的。
Táopǎo de shíhou, tā xiàng qǐgài yīyàng zài lājītǒng lǐ zhǎo chī de.
While on the run he looked for food in bins like a beggar.
tf.why: He didn't dare use his money.

q: 是一个出租车司机发现了马加爵。
Shì yíge chūzūchē sījī fāxiàn le Mǎ Jiājué.
A taxi driver spotted Ma Jiajue.
tf.why: It was a motorbike-taxi driver in Hainan.

q: 马加爵是云南人。
Mǎ Jiājué shì yúnnán rén.
Ma Jiajue was from Yunnan.
tf.why: He studied in Yunnan but came from Guangxi.

q: 马加爵的哥哥姐姐学习比他好。
Mǎ Jiājué de gēge jiějie xuéxí bǐ tā hǎo.
His brothers and sister did better at school than he did.
tf.why: He was the best student; they were average.

q: 那个心理学家觉得，马加爵杀人主要是因为他的同学都很有钱。
Nàge xīnlǐxuéjiā juéde, Mǎ Jiājué shārén zhǔyào shìyīnwèi tā de tóngxué dōu hěn yǒuqián.
The psychologist thought he killed mainly because his classmates were rich.
tf.why: His classmates were poor too; the psychologist thought he was lost inside.

q: 马加爵在监狱里写了一本书。
Mǎ Jiājué zài jiānyù lǐ xiě le yī běnshū.
Ma Jiajue wrote a book in prison.
tf.why: Only his diary is mentioned, not a book.

q: 马加爵为什么买假的身份证？
Mǎ Jiājué wèishénme mǎijiǎ de shēnfènzhèng?
Why did Ma Jiajue buy a fake ID card?
o: because he'd have to flee after the killings
mc.why: In China you need an ID for lots of things, and he planned to flee.

q: 他杀人的直接原因是什么？
Tā shārén de zhíjiēyuányīn shì shénme?
What was the immediate cause of the killings?
o: Tóngxué tōu le tā de qián
打牌的时候和同学吵架
Dǎpái de shíhou hé tóngxué chǎojià
a quarrel with classmates over cards
mc.why: A classmate said he cheated at cards, and they quarrelled.

q: “杀人灭口”是什么意思？
"shārénmièkǒu"shì shénme yìsi?
What does 杀人灭口 mean?
o: 把知道秘密的人杀了，让他们不能说话
Bǎ zhīdào mìmì de rén shā le, ràng tāmen bùnéng shuōhuà
to kill people who know a secret so they can't talk
mc.why: Once you kill people, they can't talk.

q: 马加爵家一年的收入大概是多少？
Mǎ Jiājué jiā yīnián de shōurù dàgài shì duōshao?
About how much did Ma Jiajue's family earn a year?
mc.why: A thousand yuan — less than two hundred US dollars.

q: 为什么二十万人民币在那个时候是很多钱？
Wèishénme èrshíwàn rénmínbì zài nàge shíhou shì hěnduō qián?
Why was 200,000 yuan a lot of money then?
ans: 因为普通人一年只赚一万块，要工作二十年才能赚二十万，还可以在云南买一个房子。
Yīnwèi pǔtōngrén yīnián zhǐ zhuàn yīwànkuài, yào gōngzuò èrshínián cáinéng zhuàn èrshíwàn, hái kěyǐ zài yúnnán mǎi yíge fángzi.
Because an ordinary person earned only 10,000 a year, so it was twenty years' pay, and enough to buy a house in Yunnan.

q: 马加爵的父母为什么觉得他是一个好孩子？
Mǎ Jiājué de fùmǔ wèishénme juéde tā shì yíge hǎoháizi?
Why did Ma Jiajue's parents think he was a good child?
ans: 因为他学习很好，很安静；他们不知道他在学校非常不开心。
Yīnwèi tā xuéxí hěn hǎo, hěn ānjìng; tāmen bù zhīdào tā zài xuéxiào fēicháng bù kāixīn.
Because he studied well and was quiet; they didn't know he was very unhappy at school.

q: 那个心理学家认为马加爵杀人最重要的原因是什么？
Nàge xīnlǐxuéjiā rènwéi Mǎ Jiājué shārén zuì zhòngyào de yuányīn shì shénme?
What did the psychologist think was the main reason Ma Jiajue killed?
ans: 他的内心很迷茫，不知道自己要什么，也不知道生活的意义；他还习惯了游戏里的暴力。
Tā de nèixīn hěn mímáng, bù zhīdào zìjǐ yào shénme, yě bù zhīdào shēnghuó de yìyì; tā hái xíguàn le yóuxì lǐ de bàolì.
He was lost inside, didn't know what he wanted or what life meant, and had got used to violence in games.

008.title: Does China have slums?
008.transcriptNote: 素清 Sù Qīng talks about slums: Dharavi in India, and China's shantytowns and "villages in the city". Short clips from another video (in English and Hindi) are left out of the text. Fillers like 嗯 and 呃 are mostly left out.

lines: 在很多国家，比如说印度、巴西、孟加拉，你可以看到有城市的一些地方……
Zài hěnduō guójiā, bǐrúshuō yìndù, bāxī, mèngjiālā, nǐ kěyǐ kàndào yǒu chéngshì de yìxiē dìfang……
In many countries, such as India, Brazil and Bangladesh, you can see some parts of cities…
那里有很多人挤在一起。
Nàli yǒu hěnduō rénjǐ zài yìqǐ.
where lots of people are crowded together.
他们的房子看起来不是非常好。
Tāmen de fángzi kànqǐlai búshi fēicháng hǎo.
Their houses don't look very good.
可能没有水，可能没有电，可能没有很多卫生间。
Kěnéng méiyǒu shuǐ, kěnéng méiyǒu diàn, kěnéng méiyǒu hěnduō wèishēngjiān.
Maybe there's no water, no electricity, not many toilets.
而且房子可能也不安全。
Érqiě fángzi kěnéng yě bù ānquán.
And the houses may not be safe either.
那这样的地方我们叫贫民窟。
Nà zhèyàng de dìfang wǒmen jiào pínmínkū.
We call places like this 贫民窟, slums.
“贫民”的意思就是贫穷、没有钱的人民。
"pínmín"de yìsi jiùshì pínqióng, méiyǒu qián de rénmín.
贫民 means poor people, people with no money.
“窟”的意思就是一个洞。
"kū"de yìsi jiùshì yíge dòng.
窟 means a hole, a cave.
所以你可以想象，贫民窟就是一个非常穷的人住的地方。
Suǒyǐ nǐ kěyǐ xiǎngxiàng, pínmínkū jiùshì yíge fēicháng qióng de rén zhù de dìfang.
So you can imagine a slum is a place where very poor people live.
那现在是二零二六年。
Nà xiànzài shì èrlíngèr liùnián.
Now it's 2026.
中国还是一个发展中国家。
Zhōngguó háishi yíge fāzhǎnzhōngguójiā.
China is still a developing country.
也就是说，在中国还有很多的穷人，因为中国还在发展。
Yějiùshìshuō, zài zhōngguó háiyǒu hěnduō de qióngrén, yīnwèi zhōngguó hái zài fāzhǎn.
That is, there are still many poor people in China, because China is still developing.
那中国有没有贫民窟呢？
Nà zhōngguó yǒuméiyǒu pínmínkū ne?
So does China have slums?
今天我们就来找一找。
Jīntiān wǒmen jiù lái zhǎo yī zhǎo.
Today let's look for them.
blocks.h: 什么是贫民窟？ · What is a slum?

lines: 我们先看看印度的贫民窟。
Wǒmen xiān kànkan yìndù de pínmínkū.
First let's look at a slum in India.
当然我没有去过印度的贫民窟。
Dāngrán wǒ méiyǒu qùguò yìndù de pínmínkū.
Of course I've never been to a slum in India.
所以呢我找了一个视频。这个是两个中国人，他们在印度的贫民窟……
Suǒyǐ ne wǒ zhǎo le yíge shìpín. Zhège shì liǎnggè zhōngguó rén, tāmen zài yìndù de pínmínkū……
So I found a video. It's two Chinese people in an Indian slum…
叫达拉维，Dharavi，是不是？达拉维。
Jiào Dálāwéi, ⁢Dharavi⁢, shìbúshì? Dálāwéi.
called Dharavi — 达拉维, right? Dharavi.
在这个贫民窟住了三天，所以可以看到贫民窟比较真实的生活。
Zài zhège pínmínkū zhù le sāntiān, suǒyǐ kěyǐ kàndào pínmínkū bǐjiào zhēnshí de shēnghuó.
They lived in this slum for three days, so you can see fairly real slum life.
所以这个贫民窟是真的没有钱吗？
Suǒyǐ zhège pínmínkū shì zhēnde méiyǒu qián ma?
So is this slum really without money?
对，也不对，因为这个贫民窟每年可以赚十亿美金。十亿美金是多少个零？
Duì, yě bù duì, yīnwèi zhège pínmínkū měinián kěyǐ zhuànshí yìměijīn. Shí yìměijīn shì duōshao gè líng?
Yes and no, because this slum earns a billion US dollars a year. How many zeros is a billion?
应该是九个零。非常非常多的钱。
Yīnggāi shì jiǔgè líng. Fēicháng fēicháng duō de qián.
It should be nine zeros. A huge amount of money.
所以在这个贫民窟里，有的人他们的工资比较低，那可能有的人还是可以赚到钱的。
Suǒyǐ zài zhège pínmínkū lǐ, yǒu de rén tāmen de gōngzī bǐjiào dī, nà kěnéng yǒu de rén háishi kěyǐ zhuàn dào qián de.
So in this slum some people have low wages, but some can still make money.
我看到这个贫民窟，他们是二十四小时都有电。
Wǒ kàndào zhège pínmínkū, tāmen shì èrshísì xiǎoshí dōu yǒu diàn.
I saw that in this slum they have electricity 24 hours a day.
但是不是二十四小时都有水。
Dànshì búshi èrshísì xiǎoshí dōu yǒu shuǐ.
But they don't have water 24 hours a day.
应该每天差不多三个小时可以接水。
Yīnggāi měitiān chàbuduō sāngè xiǎoshí kěyǐ jiē shuǐ.
There are about three hours a day when you can collect water.
所以他们没有自来水。
Suǒyǐ tāmen méiyǒu zìláishuǐ.
So they don't have running water.
我也看到这个贫民窟，他们有医院、学校，有很多很多超市、饭店，还有很多的工厂。
Wǒ yě kàndào zhège pínmínkū, tāmen yǒu yīyuàn, xuéxiào, yǒu hěnduōhěnduō chāoshì, fàndiàn, háiyǒu hěnduō de gōngchǎng.
I also saw that the slum has hospitals and schools, lots of shops and restaurants, and lots of workshops.
我看到他们有的人在制作食物，有的人在做垃圾的分类。
Wǒ kàndào tāmen yǒu de rén zài zhìzuò shíwù, yǒu de rén zài zuò lājī de fēnlèi.
I saw some people making food and some sorting rubbish.
他们有很多塑料的垃圾，然后呢在做垃圾的分类。
Tāmen yǒu hěnduō sùliào de lājī, ránhòu ne zài zuò lājī de fēnlèi.
They have lots of plastic waste, and they sort it.
还有很多人他们做包包。
Háiyǒu hěnduō rén tāmen zuò bāobāo.
And lots of people make bags.
所以呢这个贫民窟里面有很多很多的工作。
Suǒyǐ ne zhège pínmínkū lǐmiàn yǒu hěnduōhěnduō de gōngzuò.
So there's lots and lots of work in this slum.
然后呢，我去看了一下，现在贫民窟里一个房间，可能大概要六七十美金。
Ránhòu ne, wǒ qù kàn le yīxià, xiànzài pínmínkū lǐ yíge fángjiān, kěnéng dàgài yào liùqīshí měijīn.
Then I looked it up: a room in the slum now costs about sixty or seventy US dollars.
你觉得贵不贵？
Nǐ juéde guìbùguì?
Do you think that's expensive?
我觉得有一点点贵。
Wǒ juéde yǒu yìdiǎndiǎn guì.
I think it's a little expensive.
因为看起来不是非常好的地方，但是一个月还是要六七十美金。我觉得有一点贵。
Yīnwèi kànqǐlai búshi fēicháng hǎo de dìfang, dànshì yígèyuè háishi yào liùqīshí měijīn. Wǒ juéde yǒu yìdiǎn guì.
Because it doesn't look like a very nice place, but it still costs sixty or seventy dollars a month. I think that's a bit expensive.
blocks.h: 印度的达拉维 · Dharavi in India

lines: 那看了印度的贫民窟以后，我们来看看中国有没有贫民窟呢？
Nà kàn le yìndù de pínmínkū yǐhòu, wǒmen lái kànkan zhōngguó yǒuméiyǒu pínmínkū ne?
Now that we've seen an Indian slum, let's see whether China has slums.
那在最早的时候呢，中国有一个东西叫棚户区。
Nà zài zuìzǎo de shíhou ne, zhōngguó yǒu yíge dōngxi jiào pénghùqū.
Earlier on, China had something called 棚户区, shantytowns.
我没有看到过棚户区，现在在中国可能很少很少，差不多没有了。
Wǒ méiyǒu kàndào guo pénghùqū, xiànzài zài zhōngguó kěnéng hěnshǎo hěnshǎo, chàbuduō méiyǒu le.
I've never seen one; there are probably very, very few in China now — almost none.
你们可以看一看棚户区的照片。
Nǐmen kěyǐ kànyīkàn pénghùqū de zhàopiān.
You can look at photos of shantytowns.
看起来和贫民窟有一点点像，看起来条件也不是很好。
Kànqǐlai hé pínmínkū yǒu yìdiǎndiǎn xiàng, kànqǐlai tiáojiàn yě búshi hěn hǎo.
They look a little like slums, and the conditions don't look very good either.
我不知道他们有没有水和电，我觉得应该是有的。
Wǒ bù zhīdào tāmen yǒuméiyǒu shuǐhédiàn, wǒ juéde yīnggāi shì yǒu de.
I don't know if they had water and electricity; I think they probably did.
但是现在还有一个东西叫城中村。
Dànshì xiànzài háiyǒu yíge dōngxi jiào chéngzhōngcūn.
But now there's something called 城中村.
城中村的意思呢，就是城市中的一个村子。
Chéngzhōngcūn de yìsi ne, jiùshì chéngshì zhōng de yíge cūnzi.
城中村 means a village in the middle of a city.
好，现在深圳还有很多的城中村。
Hǎo, xiànzài Shēnzhèn háiyǒu hěnduō de chéngzhōngcūn.
Shenzhen still has lots of these urban villages.
我去过深圳的城中村。
Wǒ qùguò Shēnzhèn de chéngzhōngcūn.
I've been to Shenzhen's urban villages.
他们看起来比较像中国的一些小城市，很小的城市。
Tāmen kànqǐlai bǐjiào xiàng zhōngguó de yìxiē xiǎo chéngshì, hěnxiǎo de chéngshì.
They look rather like some small Chinese towns, very small towns.
就是可能那个楼比较矮，不是很高很漂亮。
Jiùshì kěnéng nàge lóu bǐjiào ǎi, búshi hěn gāo hěnpiàoliàng.
The buildings may be fairly low, not very tall or pretty.
对，然后呢路上不是非常的干净，但是也不是非常脏。
Duì, ránhòu ne lùshang búshi fēicháng de gānjìng, dànshì yě búshi fēicháng zàng.
And the streets aren't very clean, but not very dirty either.
有很多很多人在卖东西，在做生意。
Yǒu hěnduōhěnduō rén zài màidōngxī, zài zuòshēngyì.
Lots and lots of people are selling things, doing business.
然后呢，城中村的房子呢，是农民——因为以前他们都是农民——是农民自己建的。
Ránhòu ne, chéngzhōngcūn de fángzi ne, shì nóngmín—— yīnwèi yǐqián tāmen dōu shì nóngmín—— shì nóngmín zìjǐ jiàn de.
And the houses in urban villages were built by farmers themselves — because they used to be farmers.
所以他们的房子是有水有电的。
Suǒyǐ tāmen de fángzi shì yǒu shuǐyǒu diàn de.
So their houses have water and electricity.
然后房子里当然也有卫生间。
Ránhòu fángzi lǐ dāngrán yě yǒu wèishēngjiān.
And of course the houses have toilets.
blocks.h: 棚户区和城中村 · Shantytowns and urban villages

lines: 好的。看了城中村的视频，你觉得这个算不算贫民窟呢？
Hǎo de. Kàn le chéngzhōngcūn de shìpín, nǐ juéde zhège suànbúsuàn pínmínkū ne?
OK. Having seen the video of an urban village, do you think it counts as a slum?
这个贫民窟和别的国家的贫民窟，你们觉得是一样的吗？
Zhège pínmínkū hé biéde guójiā de pínmínkū, nǐmen juéde shì yīyàng de ma?
Do you think it's the same as slums in other countries?
那中国的政府是觉得中国是没有贫民窟的。
Nà zhōngguó de zhèngfǔ shì juéde zhōngguó shì méiyǒu pínmínkū de.
The Chinese government believes China has no slums.
因为中国的情况跟很多国家有一点不一样。
Yīnwèi zhōngguó de qíngkuàng gēn hěnduō guójiā yǒu yìdiǎn bù yīyàng.
Because China's situation is a bit different from many countries.
所以呢中国政府觉得我们是没有的。
Suǒyǐ ne zhōngguózhèngfǔ juéde wǒmen shì méiyǒu de.
So the Chinese government thinks we don't have any.
然后呢，以前也有很多条件不好的地方，那中国的政府说我们要改，所以呢很多地方也拆了，然后建了新的漂亮的房子。
Ránhòu ne, yǐqián yě yǒu hěnduō tiáojiàn bùhǎo de dìfang, nà zhōngguó de zhèngfǔ shuō wǒmen yào gǎi, suǒyǐ ne hěnduō dìfang yě chāi le, ránhòu jiànle xīn de piàoliang de fángzi.
In the past there were many places with poor conditions, and the government said we must change them, so many were demolished and new, nice buildings were built.
我没有去过贫民窟，所以我没有办法很好地比较。
Wǒ méiyǒu qùguò pínmínkū, suǒyǐ wǒ méiyǒu bànfǎ hěn hǎo dì bǐjiào.
I've never been to a slum, so I can't compare very well.
但是我觉得中国还是一个发展中国家。
Dànshì wǒ juéde zhōngguó háishi yíge fāzhǎnzhōngguójiā.
But I think China is still a developing country.
可能我们的生活真的越来越好。
Kěnéng wǒmen de shēnghuó zhēnde yuèláiyuè hǎo.
Our lives may really be getting better and better.
但是我知道还是有很多的房子条件不是那么好，一般般。
Dànshì wǒ zhīdào háishi yǒu hěnduō de fángzi tiáojiàn búshi nàme hǎo, yìbānbān.
But I know there are still many homes whose conditions aren't that good — just so-so.
可能这个房子里有水有电，没有问题，但是住了很多人。
Kěnéng zhège fángzi lǐ yǒu shuǐyǒu diàn, méiyǒu wèntí, dànshì zhù le hěnduō rén.
The home may have water and electricity, no problem, but lots of people live in it.
然后呢，可能还有很多人住在工厂里。
Ránhòu ne, kěnéng háiyǒu hěnduō rénzhù zài gōngchǎng lǐ.
And maybe lots of people still live in factories.
以前我的姐姐、我的妈妈，她们住在工厂里。
Yǐqián wǒ de jiějie, wǒ de māma, tāmen zhù zài gōngchǎng lǐ.
My sister and my mum used to live in a factory.
那这个工厂呢，就是一个房间，一个大的房间，然后里边可以睡觉，然后可以做饭，然后也有厕所。
Nà zhège gōngchǎng ne, jiùshì yíge fángjiān, yíge dà de fángjiān, ránhòu lǐbian kěyǐ shuìjiào, ránhòu kěyǐ zuòfàn, ránhòu yě yǒu cèsuǒ.
The factory had one room, a big room, where you could sleep and cook, and there was a toilet too.
但是呢我觉得那个条件也不是很好。
Dànshì ne wǒ juéde nàge tiáojiàn yě búshi hěn hǎo.
But I think the conditions weren't very good.
所以我觉得还是有很多中国人住在条件不是很好的地方。
Suǒyǐ wǒ juéde háishi yǒu hěnduō zhōngguó rénzhù zài tiáojiàn búshi hěn hǎo de dìfang.
So I think there are still many Chinese people living in places with poor conditions.
所以在你们的国家，你们有没有贫民窟？欢迎你们留言告诉我。
Suǒyǐ zài nǐmen de guójiā, nǐmen yǒuméiyǒu pínmínkū? Huānyíng nǐmen liúyán gàosu wǒ.
So, are there slums in your country? Leave a comment and tell me.
那我们下个视频见，拜拜！
Nà wǒmen xiàge shìpín jiàn, bàibai!
See you in the next video, bye!

，贫民窟就是一个非常穷的人住的地方。
在这个贫民窟住了三天，所以可以看到贫民窟比较
所以在这个贫民窟里，有的人他们的
比较低，那可能有的人还是可以赚到钱的。
我也看到这个贫民窟，他们有医院、学校，有很多很多超市、饭店，还有很多的
我看到他们有的人在制作食物，有的人在做
的垃圾，然后呢在做垃圾的分类。
那在最早的时候呢，中国有一个东西叫

了，然后建了新的漂亮的房子。

q: “窟”的意思是一个洞。
"kū"de yìsi shì yíge dòng.
窟 means a hole.
tf.why: She explains 窟 as a hole.

q: 素清自己去过印度的贫民窟。
Sù Qīng zìjǐ qùguò yìndù de pínmínkū.
Su Qing has been to a slum in India herself.
tf.why: She found a video by two Chinese people who stayed there.

q: 视频里的两个中国人在达拉维住了三天。
Shìpín lǐ de liǎnggè zhōngguó rén zài Dálāwéi zhù le sāntiān.
The two Chinese people in the video stayed in Dharavi for three days.
tf.why: They lived there for three days.

q: 达拉维每年可以赚十亿美金。
Dálāwéi měinián kěyǐ zhuànshí yìměijīn.
Dharavi earns a billion US dollars a year.
tf.why: So it's not simply a place with no money.

q: 达拉维二十四小时都有水。
Dálāwéi èrshísì xiǎoshí dōu yǒu shuǐ.
Dharavi has water 24 hours a day.
tf.why: Electricity is 24 hours, but water only about three hours a day.

q: 达拉维没有学校和医院。
Dálāwéi méiyǒu xuéxiào hé yīyuàn.
Dharavi has no schools or hospitals.
tf.why: It has hospitals, schools, shops, restaurants and workshops.

q: 素清觉得达拉维的房间一点都不贵。
Sù Qīng juéde Dálāwéi de fángjiān yìdiǎn dōu bùguì.
Su Qing thinks rooms in Dharavi aren't expensive at all.
tf.why: She thinks 60–70 dollars a month is a bit expensive.

q: 素清去过深圳的城中村。
Sù Qīng qùguò Shēnzhèn de chéngzhōngcūn.
Su Qing has been to Shenzhen's urban villages.
tf.why: She says she's been there.

q: 城中村的房子没有水和电。
Chéngzhōngcūn de fángzi méiyǒu shuǐhédiàn.
Houses in urban villages have no water or electricity.
tf.why: The farmers built them with water, electricity and toilets.

q: 中国政府觉得中国没有贫民窟。
Zhōngguózhèngfǔ juéde zhōngguó méiyǒu pínmínkū.
The Chinese government thinks China has no slums.
tf.why: It says China's situation is different.

q: 素清的姐姐和妈妈以前住在工厂里。
Sù Qīng de jiějie hé māma yǐqián zhù zài gōngchǎng lǐ.
Su Qing's sister and mother used to live in a factory.
tf.why: One big room for sleeping and cooking, with a toilet.

q: 素清的妈妈现在住在深圳。
Sù Qīng de māma xiànzài zhù zài Shēnzhèn.
Su Qing's mother now lives in Shenzhen.
tf.why: Where her mother lives now isn't mentioned.

q: 在达拉维，人们做哪些工作？
Zài Dálāwéi, rénmen zuò nǎxiē gōngzuò?
What work do people do in Dharavi?
o: making food, sorting rubbish, making bags
mc.why: There's lots of work: food, sorting plastic waste, making bags.

q: “城中村”是什么意思？
"chéngzhōngcūn"shì shénme yìsi?
What does 城中村 mean?
o: a mountain next to a city
a village in the middle of a city
mc.why: Literally a village inside a city.

q: 素清觉得深圳的城中村看起来像什么？
Sù Qīng juéde Shēnzhèn de chéngzhōngcūn kànqǐlai xiàng shénme?
What does Su Qing think Shenzhen's urban villages look like?
mc.why: Low buildings, streets neither very clean nor very dirty.

q: 以前条件不好的地方，中国政府做了什么？
Yǐqián tiáojiàn bùhǎo de dìfang, zhōngguózhèngfǔ zuò le shénme?
What did the Chinese government do with places in poor condition?
o: 拆了，建了新的漂亮的房子
Chāi le, jiànle xīn de piàoliang de fángzi
demolished them and built new, nice housing
mc.why: Many were demolished and rebuilt.

q: 为什么说达拉维“没有钱”是“对也不对”？
Wèishénme shuō Dálāwéi "méiyǒu qián"shì "duì yě bù duì"?
Why is saying Dharavi 'has no money' both right and wrong?
ans: 因为很多人工资比较低，但是整个贫民窟每年可以赚十亿美金，有的人还是可以赚到钱。
Yīnwèi hěnduō rén gōngzī bǐjiào dī, dànshì zhěnggè pínmínkū měinián kěyǐ zhuànshí yìměijīn, yǒu de rén háishi kěyǐ zhuàn dào qián.
Because many people have low wages, but the whole slum earns a billion dollars a year and some people can still make money.

q: 素清觉得中国现在还有什么居住问题？
Sù Qīng juéde zhōngguó xiànzài háiyǒu shénme jūzhù wèntí?
What housing problems does Su Qing think China still has?
ans: 很多房子条件一般，虽然有水有电，但是住了很多人；还有很多人住在工厂里。
Hěnduō fángzi tiáojiàn yìbān, suīrán yǒushuǐ yǒu diàn, dànshì zhù le hěnduō rén; háiyǒu hěnduō rénzhù zài gōngchǎng lǐ.
Many homes are just so-so: they have water and electricity but are crowded; and many people still live in factories.

009.title: Learn Chinese in a restaurant
009.transcriptNote: A vlog: a teacher in Changsha eats at a seafood restaurant with his girlfriend and explains everyday words along the way (lift, toilet, seafood, tableware, tea, takeaway box). Fillers like 嗯 and 啊 are mostly left out; a few unclear words were reconstructed from context.

lines: 嗨，大家好，欢迎回到我的频道。
Hāi, dàjiā hǎo, huānyíng huídào wǒ de píndào.
Hi everyone, welcome back to my channel.
今天呢，我们出来吃饭。今天将通过我们在餐厅里遇到的一些简单易懂的中文表达，带大家继续通过可理解性输入的方式学习中文。
Jīntiān ne, wǒmen chulai chīfàn. Jīntiān jiāng tōngguò wǒmen zài cāntīng lǐ yùdào de yìxiē jiǎndān yìdǒng de zhōngwén biǎodá, dài dàjiā jìxù tōngguò kě lǐjiě xìng shūrù de fāngshì xuéxí zhōngwén.
Today we're eating out. Through some simple, easy Chinese expressions we come across in a restaurant, I'll keep helping you learn Chinese with comprehensible input.
你只需要跟着我的视频先看，然后再听，接下来呢，跟着我的视频多次地重复，相信你很快就会学会这些简单的中文。
Nǐ zhǐ xūyào gēnzhe wǒ de shìpín xiānkàn, ránhòu zài tīng, jiēxiàlái ne, gēnzhe wǒ de shìpín duōcì dì chóngfù, xiāngxìn nǐ hěnkuài jiù huì xuéhuì zhèxiē jiǎndān de zhōngwén.
You just need to watch my video first, then listen, and then repeat after me many times. I'm sure you'll learn this simple Chinese very quickly.
那今天我们要去的一家餐厅是吃什么的？
Nà jīntiān wǒmen yào qù de yìjiā cāntīng shì chī shénme de?
So what kind of food does today's restaurant serve?
海鲜。海鲜，好。
Hǎixiān. Hǎixiān, hǎo.
Seafood. Seafood, OK.
大家知道海鲜是什么吗？就是在海里游的一些动物。
Dàjiā zhīdào hǎixiān shì shénme ma? Jiùshì zài hǎilǐ yóu de yìxiē dòngwù.
Do you know what 海鲜 is? It's animals that swim in the sea.
我们今天来试一试这家海鲜餐厅。
Wǒmen jīntiān lái shìyīshì zhèjiā hǎixiān cāntīng.
Today we're going to try this seafood restaurant.
它的菜好不好吃呢？我去看一看。
Tā de cài hǎobuhǎo chī ne? Wǒ qù kànyīkàn.
Is its food good? Let me go and see.
我今天刚刚下班。刚刚下班，然后我们一起来吃饭。
Wǒ jīntiān gānggang xiàbān. Gānggang xiàbān, ránhòu wǒmen yī qǐlai chīfàn.
I've just finished work today. Just finished work, and now we're going to eat together.
这家餐厅的名字叫做“你好，大海”。
Zhèjiā cāntīng de míngzi jiàozuò "nǐhǎo, dàhǎi".
The restaurant is called "Hello, Sea".
这个名字也很简单啊，“你好”，大家都知道什么意思。
Zhège míngzi yě hěn jiǎndān a, "nǐhǎo", dàjiā dōu zhīdào shénme yìsi.
The name is simple too: everyone knows what 你好 means.
“大海”就是海洋，很大的一片海洋。
"dàhǎi"jiùshì hǎiyáng, hěndà de yīpiàn hǎiyáng.
大海 means the ocean, a very big stretch of sea.
那我们来看看这个餐厅里有什么好吃的呢？走吧！
Nà wǒmen lái kànkan zhège cāntīng lǐ yǒu shénme hǎochī de ne? Zǒu ba!
Let's see what delicious food this restaurant has. Let's go!
blocks.h: 开场：今天去吃海鲜 · Intro: seafood today

lines: 现在我在这儿等待，等待电梯下来。
Xiànzài wǒ zài zhèér děngdài, děngdài diàntī xiàlai.
Now I'm waiting here, waiting for the lift to come down.
这个是电梯，还记得吗？
Zhège shì diàntī, hái jìde ma?
This is a lift, remember?
它是一个直达电梯。
Tā shì yíge zhídá diàntī.
It's a direct lift.
那我会用手按，按这个“向上”。
Nà wǒhuì yòngshǒu àn, àn zhège "xiàngshàng".
I press with my hand — press this "up" button.
我们现在要上楼。走！
Wǒmen xiànzài yào shànglóu. Zǒu!
We're going upstairs now. Let's go!
你好……谢谢。来，我们来验一个券。验一个券。
Nǐhǎo…… Xièxie. Lái, wǒmen láiyàn yíge quàn. Yàn yíge quàn.
Hello… thank you. Come on, let's validate a voucher. Validate a voucher.
现在就上吧。好的，上菜，上菜。
Xiànzài jiù shàng ba. Hǎo de, shàngcài, shàngcài.
Serve it now, please. OK, serve the food.
blocks.h: 电梯 · The lift

lines: 那我们刚刚点了一个套餐，双人套餐。这是一个双人套餐，就是我和我的亲爱的女朋友，我们两个人一起吃的一个双人套餐。
Nà wǒmen gānggang diǎn le yíge tàocān, shuāngrén tàocān. Zhèshì yíge shuāngrén tàocān, jiùshì wǒ hé wǒ de qīnài de nǚpéngyou, wǒmen liǎnggè rén yìqǐ chī de yíge shuāngrén tàocān.
We've just ordered a set meal, a set meal for two — for me and my dear girlfriend, the two of us eating together.
大家来到中国之后，会发现我们很多的餐厅点餐都是可以在手机上，在线上的一些App、一些软件上去购买套餐。
Dàjiā láidào zhōngguó zhīhòu, huì fāxiàn wǒmen hěnduō de cāntīng diǎncān dōu shì kěyǐ zài shǒujī shàng, zàixiàn shàng de yìxiē ⁢App⁢, yìxiē ruǎnjiàn shàngqù gòumǎi tàocān.
When you come to China, you'll find that at many restaurants you can order on your phone, buying set meals through online apps.
因为套餐呢会更加地划算，更加地划算。
Yīnwèi tàocān ne huì gèngjiā dì huásuàn, gèngjiā dì huásuàn.
Because set meals are better value, better value.
就是你可以花更少的钱，获得什么样的服务啊……划算。
Jiùshì nǐ kěyǐ huā gèng shǎo de qián, huòdé shénmeyàng de fúwù a…… Huásuàn.
It means you spend less money and get… good value — 划算.
大家可以记住这个词。
Dàjiā kěyǐ jìzhu zhège cí.
Remember this word.
blocks.h: 套餐和点餐 · Set meals and ordering

lines: 请问洗手间在哪里？
Qǐngwèn xǐshǒujiān zài nǎlǐ?
Excuse me, where is the toilet?
洗手间。
Xǐshǒujiān.
Toilet.
水池。水池。
Shuǐchí. Shuǐchí.
Sink. Sink.
还有水龙头。水龙头。
Háiyǒu shuǐlóngtóu. Shuǐlóngtóu.
And the tap. Tap.
我打开水龙头，在这里洗手。
Wǒ dǎkāi shuǐlóngtóu, zài zhèlǐ xǐshǒu.
I turn on the tap and wash my hands here.
一定要学会“洗手”这个动作。
Yídìng yào xuéhuì "xǐshǒu"zhège dòngzuò.
You must learn the action 洗手, washing your hands.
洗手液。马桶。马桶。
Xǐshǒuyè. Mǎtǒng. Mǎtǒng.
Hand soap. Toilet bowl. Toilet bowl.
上完厕所，可别忘了冲水。
Shàng wán cèsuǒ, kě biéwàngle chōngshuǐ.
After using the toilet, don't forget to flush.
冲水。
Chōngshuǐ.
Flush.
也不要忘了洗手。
Yě búyào wàng le xǐshǒu.
And don't forget to wash your hands.
用纸巾擦手。
Yòng zhǐjīn cāshǒu.
Dry your hands with a paper towel.
我的手擦干净了。
Wǒ de shǒu cā gānjìng le.
My hands are dry and clean.
别忘了把垃圾也带走。
Biéwàngle bǎ lājī yě dàizǒu.
Don't forget to take the rubbish with you.
把垃圾丢到垃圾桶里。
Bǎ lājī diū dào lājītǒng lǐ.
Throw the rubbish into the bin.

lines: 非常地新鲜啊，有很多海鲜在这个水池里。这个应该是螃蟹，螃蟹、大闸蟹。
Fēicháng dì xīnxiān a, yǒu hěnduō hǎixiān zài zhège shuǐchí lǐ. Zhège yīnggāi shì pángxiè, pángxiè, dàzháxiè.
Very fresh — lots of seafood in this tank. These should be crabs — crabs, hairy crabs.
这个是大闸蟹。生蚝。
Zhège shì dàzháxiè. Shēng háo.
These are hairy crabs. Oysters.
我懂。我也喜欢吃这个扇贝。扇贝。
Wǒ dǒng. Wǒ yě xǐhuan chī zhège shànbèi. Shànbèi.
I see. I also like eating these scallops. Scallops.
我们健康所需的很多的微量元素都在海鲜里面，非常好。这个是海参。
Wǒmen jiànkāng suǒ xū de hěnduō de wēiliàngyuánsù dōu zài hǎixiān lǐmiàn, fēicháng hǎo. Zhège shì hǎishēn.
Many trace elements our health needs are in seafood — very good. This is a sea cucumber.
海参，还有这个小海螺，小的海螺。
Hǎishēn, háiyǒu zhège xiǎo hǎiluó, xiǎo de hǎiluó.
Sea cucumber, and these little sea snails, small sea snails.
这是厨房。我们看到这是厨房。厨房。
Zhèshì chúfáng. Wǒmen kàndào zhèshì chúfáng. Chúfáng.
This is the kitchen. We can see the kitchen. Kitchen.
厨房是炒菜做饭的地方。这个餐厅里有很多厨师。有美食，当然也要配上好喝的饮品。
Chúfáng shì chǎocài zuòfàn de dìfang. Zhège cāntīng lǐ yǒu hěnduō chúshī. Yǒu měishí, dāngrán yě yào pèishàng hǎohē de yǐnpǐn.
The kitchen is where food is cooked. This restaurant has lots of chefs. With good food, of course you need nice drinks to go with it.
blocks.h: 海鲜池和厨房 · The seafood tanks and the kitchen

lines: 那这里呢，就是我们长沙非常有名的奶茶。我们把它打开看一看：一杯奶茶，还有另外一杯是果茶，就是水果茶。
Nà zhèlǐ ne, jiùshì wǒmen Chángshā fēicháng yǒumíng de nǎichá. Wǒmen bǎ tā dǎkāi kànyīkàn: yībēi nǎichá, háiyǒu lìngwài yībēi shì guǒchá, jiùshì shuǐguǒ chá.
And here is Changsha's very famous milk tea. Let's open it up: one cup of milk tea, and the other is fruit tea.
我更喜欢喝奶茶，所以我点的是奶茶。
Wǒ gèng xǐhuan hē nǎichá, suǒyǐ wǒdiǎn de shì nǎichá.
I prefer milk tea, so I ordered milk tea.
这是一个小的吸管。吸管，还记得吗？吸管。
Zhèshì yíge xiǎo de xīguǎn. Xīguǎn, hái jìde ma? Xīguǎn.
This is a small straw. 吸管, remember? Straw.
也可以用这个吸管来搅拌我的奶茶。
Yě kěyǐ yòng zhège xīguǎn lái jiǎobàn wǒ de nǎichá.
I can also use this straw to stir my milk tea.
blocks.h: 奶茶和吸管 · Milk tea and straws

lines: 那我们吃饭会要用到怎样的一些餐具呢？这些餐具有……
Nà wǒmen chīfàn huìyào yòngdào zěnyàng de yìxiē cānjù ne? Zhèxiē cānjù yǒu……
So what tableware do we use when eating? The tableware includes…
勺子，勺子。我们用勺子来喝汤，喝汤。然后呢，还有碗，这个是碗。
Sháozi, sháozi. Wǒmen yòng sháozi lái hētāng, hētāng. Ránhòu ne, háiyǒu wǎn, zhège shì wǎn.
Spoon, spoon. We use a spoon to drink soup. And there's a bowl — this is a bowl.
碗是用来装食物的，装各种固体类的食物，或者装汤也可以。
Wǎn shì yònglái zhuāng shíwù de, zhuāng gèzhǒng gùtǐ lèi de shíwù, huòzhě zhuāngtāng yě kěyǐ.
A bowl holds food — all kinds of solid food, or soup.
现在会用上这个筷子，这个是筷子。筷子。
Xiànzài huìyòng shàng zhège kuàizi, zhège shì kuàizi. Kuàizi.
Now we'll use these chopsticks — these are chopsticks. Chopsticks.
点了一壶茶，这个茶是罗汉果茶。罗汉果茶对嗓子好。
Diǎn le yīhú chá, zhège chá shì luóhànguǒ chá. Luóhànguǒ chá duì sǎngzi hǎo.
We ordered a pot of tea — monk fruit tea. Monk fruit tea is good for the throat.
还有……冷热交替啊。
Háiyǒu…… Lěngrè jiāotì a.
And… alternating cold and hot.
我们又喝冰的奶茶，又喝这么热的罗汉果茶。
Wǒmen yòu hē bīng de nǎichá, yòu hē zhème rè de luóhànguǒ chá.
We drink iced milk tea and also this hot monk fruit tea.
既要爽到，又要健康啊！我们年轻人就是这样的，都要，我都要，不选择，我们都要。
Jìyào shuǎngdào, yòu yào jiànkāng a! Wǒmen niánqīngrén jiùshì zhèyàng de, dōu yào, wǒ dōu yào, bù xuǎnzé, wǒmen dōu yào.
We want it refreshing and healthy! That's young people for you — we want both, no choosing, we want it all.
湿巾。因为吃海鲜，手上可能会沾到很多食物或者油，我们就用这个湿巾来擦手。
Shījīn. Yīnwèi chīhǎixiān, shǒushàng kěnéng huì zhān dào hěnduō shíwù huòzhě yóu, wǒmen jiù yòng zhège shījīn lái cā shǒu.
Wet wipes. Because eating seafood can get lots of food or oil on your hands, we use these wipes to clean them.
blocks.h: 餐具 · Tableware

lines: 沙拉来了。今天的食物还是比较清淡的啊。干杯！
Shālā lái le. Jīntiān de shíwù háishi bǐjiào qīngdàn de a. Gānbēi!
The salad's here. Today's food is fairly light. Cheers!
好喝！
Hǎohē!
Tasty!
这个茶味非常地浓郁。我点的这个是红茶底的奶茶，红茶做的奶茶，所以这个茶的味道很浓。
Zhège cháwèi fēicháng dì nóngyù. Wǒdiǎn de zhège shì hóngchá dǐ de nǎichá, hóngchá zuò de nǎichá, suǒyǐ zhège chá de wèidao hěnnóng.
The tea flavour is very rich. I ordered milk tea with a black-tea base, made with black tea, so the tea taste is strong.
茶味很浓。
Cháwèi hěnnóng.
A strong tea taste.
我喜欢这种比较浓厚的味道。
Wǒ xǐhuan zhèzhǒng bǐjiào nónghòu de wèidao.
I like this kind of rich flavour.
豆芽炒鸡蛋。豆芽炒鸡蛋。
Dòuyá chǎojīdàn. Dòuyá chǎojīdàn.
Stir-fried bean sprouts with egg.
这个是什么？香干炒肉。
Zhège shì shénme? Xiānggān chǎoròu.
What's this? Stir-fried smoked tofu with pork.
这个菜是粉丝蒸鲍鱼。鲍鱼，你们喜欢吃鲍鱼吗？
Zhège cài shì fěnsī zhēng bàoyú. Bàoyú, nǐmen xǐhuan chī bàoyú ma?
This dish is steamed abalone with glass noodles. Abalone — do you like abalone?
来，粉丝先吃。请朋友们吃鲍鱼。
Lái, fěnsī xiān chī. Qǐng péngyou men chī bàoyú.
Come on, viewers first. Let our friends have the abalone.
其实我很喜欢吃这个粉丝啊，这个粉丝。
Qíshí wǒ hěn xǐhuan chī zhège fěnsī a, zhège fěnsī.
Actually I really like these glass noodles, these noodles.
blocks.h: 干杯，上菜 · Cheers — the dishes arrive

lines: 我们这边做海鲜，经常会在里面加一些调料。
Wǒmen zhèbiān zuò hǎixiān, jīngcháng huì zài lǐmiàn jiā yìxiē tiáoliào.
Around here, when we cook seafood we often add some seasonings.
比如说在这个鲍鱼上，我们看到有葱。
Bǐrúshuō zài zhège bàoyú shàng, wǒmen kàndào yǒu cōng.
For example, on this abalone we can see spring onion.
这个绿色的是葱，然后白色的这个是蒜。
Zhège lǜsè de shì cōng, ránhòu báisè de zhège shì suàn.
The green stuff is spring onion, and the white stuff is garlic.
会把这个葱和蒜放在海鲜上，旁边可能会再加上一些粉丝。
Huì bǎ zhège cōng hé suàn fàngzài hǎixiān shàng, pángbiān kěnéng huì zài jiāshàng yìxiē fěnsī.
They put the spring onion and garlic on the seafood, and maybe add some glass noodles at the side.
这样搭配起来一起来吃这道菜，非常地鲜美，很好吃。
Zhèyàng dāpèi qǐlai yī qǐlai chī zhè dàocài, fēicháng dì xiānměi, hěn hǎochī.
Eaten together like this, the dish is really delicious.
现在我用筷子夹菜。
Xiànzài wǒyòng kuàizi jiācài.
Now I pick up food with chopsticks.
夹菜，用筷子把它夹起来。这个动作叫做“夹”。
Jiācài, yòng kuàizi bǎ tā jiāqǐlái. Zhège dòngzuò jiàozuò "jiā".
Picking up food — lifting it with chopsticks. This action is called 夹.
夹起来。夹菜。
Jiāqǐlái. Jiācài.
Pick it up. Pick up food.
当然，我们用各种工具，如果想要把某一样东西夹起来，都可以用这个动作来表达。
Dāngrán, wǒmen yòng gèzhǒng gōngjù, rúguǒ xiǎngyào bǎ mǒu yīyàng dōngxi jiāqǐlái, dōu kěyǐ yòng zhège dòngzuò lái biǎodá.
Of course, whatever tool we use, if we want to pick something up by gripping it, we can use this verb.
把菜夹到碗里。夹菜，夹到碗里。
Bǎ cài jiā dào wǎn lǐ. Jiācài, jiādào wǎn lǐ.
Put the food into the bowl. Pick up food, into the bowl.
好吃。我最喜欢的鸡蛋，每天都要吃好多的鸡蛋。
Hǎochī. Wǒ zuì xǐhuan de jīdàn, měitiān dōu yào chī hǎoduō de jīdàn.
Delicious. My favourite — eggs. I eat lots of eggs every day.
再吃一个鲍鱼。
Zài chī yíge bàoyú.
Let's have another abalone.
鲍鱼有很多用来调味的配料。
Bàoyú yǒu hěnduō yònglái tiáowèi de pèiliào.
The abalone has lots of seasoning ingredients.
比如说，这个是蒜，这个是蒜，大蒜啊，还有这个绿色的是葱。
Bǐrúshuō, zhège shì suàn, zhège shì suàn, dàsuàn a, háiyǒu zhège lǜsè de shì cōng.
For example, this is garlic, garlic, and the green stuff is spring onion.
好吃！然后我用筷子把这个鲍鱼夹出来，夹出来，然后大口地品尝一下。
Hǎochī! Ránhòu wǒyòng kuàizi bǎ zhège bàoyú jiā chulai, jiā chulai, ránhòu dàkǒu dì pǐncháng yīxià.
Delicious! Then I pick the abalone out with my chopsticks and take a big bite.
好吃吗？非常嫩。
Hǎochī ma? Fēicháng nèn.
Is it good? Very tender.
blocks.h: 调料和“夹” · Seasonings and the verb 夹

lines: 米饭吧。对，米饭。上菜了。
Mǐfàn ba. Duì, mǐfàn. Shàngcài le.
Rice, please. Yes, rice. The dishes are coming.
这个菜叫什么？
Zhège cài jiào shénme?
What's this dish called?
这个叫……烤大明虾，烤大明虾。哦，大明虾，这个是烤的大明虾。
Zhège jiào…… Kǎo dàmíngxiā, kǎo dàmíngxiā. O, dàmíngxiā, zhège shì kǎo de dàmíngxiā.
It's called… grilled king prawns. Oh, king prawns — these are grilled king prawns.
粉丝先吃。
Fěnsī xiān chī.
Viewers first.
它的表皮烤得是这种焦黄的，焦黄的状态，上面会有一些调料。
Tā de biǎopí kǎo de shì zhèzhǒng jiāohuáng de, jiāohuáng de zhuàngtài, shàngmiàn huì yǒu yìxiē tiáoliào.
The skin is grilled golden brown, with some seasoning on top.
她戴上了手套。对，吃海鲜肯定会需要这个手套。
Tā dài shàng le shǒutào. Duì, chīhǎixiān kěndìng huì xūyào zhège shǒutào.
She's put on gloves. Right, you definitely need gloves for seafood.
因为我们要剥这个虾或者蟹啊，戴上这个手套。
Yīnwèi wǒmen yào bō zhège xiā huòzhě xiè a, dàishang zhège shǒutào.
Because we have to peel the prawns or crabs, so we put on gloves.
这个手套呢，一般我们只会用一次，只会用一次，不会反复地使用。
Zhège shǒutào ne, yìbān wǒmen zhǐhuìyòng yīcì, zhǐhuìyòng yīcì, búhuì fǎnfù dì shǐyòng.
We usually only use these gloves once, only once — we don't reuse them.
所以这个手套我们叫它“一次性手套”。
Suǒyǐ zhège shǒutào wǒmen jiào tā "yícìxìng shǒutào".
So we call these gloves 一次性手套, disposable gloves.
一次性，就是只用一次。有很多工具只用一次，不会重复使用的，都可以在它的前面加上一个“一次性”。
Yícìxìng, jiùshì zhǐyòng yīcì. Yǒu hěnduō gōngjù zhǐyòng yīcì, búhuì chóngfùshǐyòng de, dōu kěyǐ zài tā de qiánmiàn jiāshàng yíge "yícìxìng".
一次性 means used only once. Lots of things that are used once and not reused can have 一次性 put in front of them.
她剥虾的手法非常地高超，一看平时就吃得很好，平时吃了很多的海鲜。
Tā bō xiā de shǒufǎ fēicháng dì gāochāo, yīkàn píngshí jiù chī de hěn hǎo, píngshí chī le hěnduō de hǎixiān.
Her prawn-peeling technique is excellent — you can tell she eats well and has eaten lots of seafood.
把这个虾清理得非常干净了，然后我们请粉丝先吃。
Bǎ zhège xiā qīnglǐ de fēicháng gānjìng le, ránhòu wǒmen qǐng fěnsī xiān chī.
She's cleaned the prawn really well, and then we offer it to the viewers first.
蘸一点酱。好，谢谢。
Zhàn yìdiǎn jiàng. Hǎo, xièxie.
Dip it in a little sauce. OK, thanks.
米饭。这么好的菜，这么美味的食物，一定要搭配一碗米饭。这是我们今天的……
Mǐfàn. Zhème hǎo de cài, zhème měiwèi de shíwù, yídìng yào dāpèi yīwǎn mǐfàn. Zhèshì wǒmen jīntiān de……
Rice. With such good dishes, such tasty food, you must have a bowl of rice. This is our…
碳水。碳水。
Tànshuǐ. Tànshuǐ.
Carbs. Carbs.
你吃吧，这么大，你吃吧。
Nǐ chī ba, zhème dà, nǐ chī ba.
You eat it — it's so big, you have it.
就蘸了一点这个辣椒粉。
Jiù zhàn le yìdiǎn zhège làjiāofěn.
Just dipped in a bit of chilli powder.
好不好吃？好不好吃？这个虾，评价一下。
Hǎobuhǎo chī? Hǎobuhǎo chī? Zhège xiā, píngjià yīxià.
Is it good? Is it good? Give this prawn a review.
很新鲜，很新鲜，非常新鲜。
Hěn xīnxiān, hěn xīnxiān, fēicháng xīnxiān.
Very fresh, very fresh, really fresh.
我觉得这就是对海鲜最重要的一个评价啊，就是一定要新鲜，新鲜的食材。
Wǒ juéde zhè jiùshì duì hǎixiān zuì zhòngyào de yíge píngjià a, jiùshì yídìng yào xīnxiān, xīnxiān de shícái.
I think that's the most important thing to say about seafood: it must be fresh — fresh ingredients.
blocks.h: 烤大明虾和一次性手套 · Grilled king prawns and disposable gloves

lines: 那我吃虾，我跟她不一样。
Nà wǒ chī xiā, wǒ gēn tā bù yīyàng.
When I eat prawns, I'm different from her.
我不喜欢用手去剥，可能我比较懒吧，我比较懒，我吃虾喜欢直接用嘴咬。
Wǒ bù xǐhuan yòngshǒu qù bō, kěnéng wǒ bǐjiào lǎn ba, wǒ bǐjiào lǎn, wǒ chī xiā xǐhuan zhíjiē yòng zuǐ yǎo.
I don't like peeling with my hands — maybe I'm a bit lazy. I'm lazy; I like to bite the prawn directly.
直接用嘴大口地咬它。
Zhíjiē yòng zuǐdàkǒu dì yǎo tā.
Bite into it with a big mouthful.
好吃，直接吃它的原味，很不错，很新鲜。
Hǎochī, zhíjiē chī tā de yuánwèi, hěn búcuò, hěn xīnxiān.
Delicious — eating its natural flavour directly, very nice, very fresh.
为了让她吃一口完整的虾，那我现在戴上了手套，戴上了一次性手套，开始剥这个非常大个、非常新鲜的虾。
Wèile ràng tā chī yīkǒu wánzhěng de xiā, nà wǒ xiànzài dàishang le shǒutào, dàishang le yícìxìng shǒutào, kāishǐ bō zhège fēicháng dà gè, fēicháng xīnxiān de xiā.
So she can have a whole prawn, I've now put on gloves — disposable gloves — and I'm starting to peel this very big, very fresh prawn.
现在我要把手套取下来。取下来，但是手上还是会有很多油。
Xiànzài wǒyào bǎshou tàoqǔ xiàlai. Qǔ xiàlai, dànshì shǒushàng háishi huì yǒu hěnduō yóu.
Now I'm taking the gloves off. Off — but there's still lots of oil on my hands.
你吃完饭之后有很多油，怎么办？
Nǐ chīwánfàn zhīhòu yǒu hěnduō yóu, zěnmebàn?
After eating there's lots of oil — what do you do?
湿纸巾。然后你看，这里有个小口，我们沿着这个小口，把这个湿纸巾的包装给撕开。
Shīzhǐjīn. Ránhòu nǐ kàn, zhèlǐ yǒugè xiǎokǒu, wǒmen yánzhe zhège xiǎo kǒu, bǎ zhège shīzhǐjīn de bāozhuāng gěi sīkāi.
Wet wipes. Look, there's a little notch here; along this notch we tear open the wet wipe's packaging.
这个动作叫“撕”。撕开。撕开，然后把它拿出来。
Zhège dòngzuò jiào "sī". Sīkāi. Sīkāi, ránhòu bǎ tā ná chulai.
This action is called 撕, tearing. Tear it open. Tear it open, then take it out.
用这个纸巾就可以把手上的油污给擦掉，擦干净。
Yòng zhège zhǐjīn jiù kěyǐ bǎ shǒushàng de yóuwū gěi cādiào, cā gānjìng.
With this wipe you can wipe the grease off your hands, wipe them clean.
当然，别忘了还要擦一擦嘴巴，嘴巴上也有油。
Dāngrán, biéwàngle háiyào cā yīcā zuǐba, zuǐba shàng yě yǒu yóu.
And of course don't forget to wipe your mouth — there's oil on your mouth too.
blocks.h: 懒人吃法 · The lazy way

lines: 太好吃了，我们从白天吃到了晚上。天都黑了，白天吃到晚上了，真的。
Tài hǎochī le, wǒmen cóng báitiān chī dào le wǎnshang. Tiān dōu hēi le, báitiān chī dào wǎnshang le, zhēnde.
So good — we ate from daytime until evening. It's dark already — really, from day to night.
吃完了，但是其实还剩了很多菜。你们看要不要打包？你们知道“打包”是什么意思吗？
Chī wán le, dànshì qíshí hái shèng le hěnduō cài. Nǐmen kànyào búyào dǎbāo? Nǐmen zhīdào "dǎbāo"shì shénme yìsi ma?
We've finished, but there's actually lots of food left. Shall we take it away? Do you know what 打包 means?
打包就是咱们桌上的菜如果没有吃完，我们就会向服务员要一个打包盒，一个塑料盒，然后就把这些菜打包，装进这个盒子里。
Dǎbāo jiùshì zánmen zhuōshàng de cài rúguǒ méiyǒu chī wán, wǒmen jiù huì xiàng fúwùyuán yào yíge dǎbāohé, yíge sùliàohé, ránhòu jiù bǎ zhèxiē cài dǎbāo, zhuāngjìn zhège hézi lǐ.
打包 means that if we haven't finished the food on our table, we ask the waiter for a takeaway box, a plastic box, and pack the food into it.
带回去，带回家，这样就不会浪费，不会浪费这些食物。这个就叫做“打包”。
Dàihuíqù, dàihuíjiā, zhèyàng jiù búhuì làngfèi, búhuì làngfèi zhèxiē shíwù. Zhège jiù jiàozuò "dǎbāo".
Take it back, take it home, so it isn't wasted — the food isn't wasted. That's called 打包.
我们要不要打包？打包吧，好吧，那我们要一个打包盒。
Wǒmen yào búyào dǎbāo? Dǎbāo ba, hǎo ba, nà wǒmen yào yíge dǎbāohé.
Shall we take it away? Let's, OK — let's ask for a takeaway box.
吃完饭了，还是有一些菜会感觉有一些油腻啊，就不是那么舒服。
Chīwánfàn le, háishi yǒu yìxiē càihuì gǎnjué yǒu yìxiē yóunì a, jiù búshi nàme shūfu.
After the meal, some dishes still feel a bit greasy — not so comfortable.
所以我们倒一壶茶。我们拿这个茶壶来倒。
Suǒyǐ wǒmen dào yīhú chá. Wǒmen ná zhège cháhú lái dào.
So we pour some tea. We take the teapot and pour.
倒茶，这个动作叫“倒”。刚刚把茶倒出来，倒出来。
Dào chá, zhège dòngzuò jiào "dào". Gānggang bǎ chá dào chulai, dào chulai.
Pouring tea — this action is called 倒. I just poured the tea out.
倒了一杯茶。喝一口茶可以……
Dào le yībēi chá. Hē yīkǒu chá kěyǐ……
Poured a cup of tea. A sip of tea can…
解腻。解腻。就是刚刚吃了很多油腻的东西，喝一杯茶就可以解腻，更加地舒服。
Jiěnì. Jiěnì. Jiùshì gānggang chī le hěnduō yóunì de dōngxi, hēyībēi chá jiù kěyǐ jiěnì, gèngjiā dì shūfu.
cut the grease. 解腻. When you've just eaten lots of greasy food, a cup of tea cuts the grease and you feel more comfortable.
blocks.h: 打包和倒茶 · Taking leftovers home and pouring tea

lines: 好，那么这期视频呢，我是继续用慢速的中文教了大家一些在餐厅里，在海鲜餐厅里会用到的一些中文表达。
Hǎo, nàme zhè qī shìpín ne, wǒ shì jìxù yòng mànsù de zhōng wénjiào le dàjiā yìxiē zài cāntīng lǐ, zài hǎixiān cāntīng lǐhuì yòngdào de yìxiē zhōngwén biǎodá.
OK, in this video I've again used slow Chinese to teach you some expressions you'll use in a restaurant — in a seafood restaurant.
大家可以跟着我的视频多反复地看几遍，听几遍，然后跟着我多次地重复，希望这种学习方式能够让你很快地提升你的中文口语。
Dàjiā kěyǐ gēnzhe wǒ de shìpín duō fǎnfù dìkàn jǐbiàn, tīng jǐbiàn, ránhòu gēnzhe wǒ duōcì dì chóngfù, xīwàng zhèzhǒng xuéxí fāngshì nénggòu ràng nǐ hěnkuài dì tíshēng nǐ de zhōngwén kǒuyǔ.
Watch and listen to my video several times and repeat after me many times. I hope this way of learning helps you quickly improve your spoken Chinese.
那下一期视频大家还想学习什么？可以留在我的评论区。喜欢的话，别忘了点上一个订阅。
Nàxià yìqī shìpín dàjiā hái xiǎng xuéxí shénme? Kěyǐ liúzài wǒ de pínglùn qū. Xǐhuan dehuà, biéwàngle diǎnshàng yíge dìngyuè.
What would you like to learn in the next video? Leave it in my comments. If you like it, don't forget to subscribe.
拜拜！
Bàibai!
Bye!
blocks.h: 结束 · Wrap-up

vocab: to pack leftovers to take away

，勺子。我们用勺子来喝汤，喝汤。然后呢，还有碗，这个是碗。

沙拉来了。今天的食物还是比较

q: 今天他们去的是一家火锅店。
Jīntiān tāmen qù de shì yìjiā huǒguōdiàn.
Today they go to a hotpot restaurant.
tf.why: It's a seafood restaurant.

q: 说话人去吃饭以前刚刚下班。
Shuōhuà rénqù chīfàn yǐqián gānggang xiàbān.
The speaker has just finished work before the meal.
tf.why: He says he's just got off work.

q: 这家餐厅叫“你好，大海”。
Zhèjiā cāntīng jiào "nǐhǎo, dàhǎi".
The restaurant is called 'Hello, Sea'.
tf.why: That's its name.

q: 他们走楼梯上楼。
Tāmen zǒu lóutī shànglóu.
They walk up the stairs.
tf.why: They take a direct lift and press 'up'.

q: 他们点的是一个双人套餐。
Tāmen diǎn de shì yíge shuāngrén tàocān.
They ordered a set meal for two.
tf.why: A set meal for him and his girlfriend.

q: 说话人说，在中国用手机点套餐比较贵。
Shuōhuà rén shuō, zài zhōngguó yòng shǒujī diǎn tàocān bǐjiào guì.
He says ordering set meals by phone in China is more expensive.
tf.why: Set meals bought in apps are better value, 划算.

q: 上完厕所以后，他用毛巾擦手。
Shàng wán cèsuǒ yǐhòu, tāyòng máojīn cāshǒu.
After the toilet, he dries his hands with a towel.
tf.why: He uses a paper towel, 纸巾.

q: 他点的是奶茶，因为他更喜欢喝奶茶。
Tādiǎn de shì nǎichá, yīnwèi tā gèng xǐhuan hē nǎichá.
He ordered milk tea because he prefers it.
tf.why: The other cup is fruit tea.

q: 罗汉果茶是冰的。
Luóhànguǒ chá shì bīng de.
The monk fruit tea is iced.
tf.why: The milk tea is iced; the monk fruit tea is hot.

q: 他的奶茶是用绿茶做的。
Tā de nǎichá shì yòng lǜchá zuò de.
His milk tea is made with green tea.
tf.why: It has a black-tea base, 红茶.

q: 鲍鱼上面绿色的是葱，白色的是蒜。
Bàoyú shàngmiàn lǜsè de shì cōng, báisè de shì suàn.
On the abalone, the green is spring onion and the white is garlic.
tf.why: He explains both colours.

q: 他每天都要吃很多鸡蛋。
Tā měitiān dōu yào chī hěnduō jīdàn.
He eats lots of eggs every day.
tf.why: Eggs are his favourite.

q: 他吃虾的时候喜欢先用手剥。
Tā chī xiā de shíhou xǐhuan xiānyòng shǒu bō.
He likes to peel prawns with his hands first.
tf.why: He's lazy and bites them directly; his girlfriend peels them.

q: 他们吃完饭以后去看电影了。
Tāmen chīwánfàn yǐhòu qù kàn diànyǐng le.
After the meal they went to see a film.
tf.why: Nothing is said about a film.

q: “划算”是什么意思？
"huásuàn"shì shénme yìsi?
What does 划算 mean?
o: Huā gèng shǎo de qián, dédào gèng duō
mc.why: You spend less money and get the service — good value.

q: 为什么叫“一次性手套”？
Wèishénme jiào "yícìxìng shǒutào"?
Why are they called 一次性手套?
o: 因为只用一次，不重复使用
they're used only once, not reused
mc.why: 一次性 means used once and not reused.

q: 他说对海鲜最重要的评价是什么？
Tā shuō duì hǎixiān zuì zhòngyào de píngjià shì shénme?
What does he say is the most important thing about seafood?
mc.why: It must be fresh — fresh ingredients.

q: 吃完饭以后，为什么要喝茶？
Chīwánfàn yǐhòu, wèishénme yào hēchá?
Why drink tea after the meal?
o: 为了解腻，吃了油腻的东西会更舒服
Wèile jiěnì, chī le yóunì de dōngxi huì gèng shūfu
to cut the grease and feel better after greasy food
mc.why: Tea 解腻 — it cuts the grease.

q: “打包”是什么意思？
"dǎbāo"shì shénme yìsi?
What does 打包 mean?
ans: 菜没有吃完的时候，向服务员要一个打包盒，把菜装进去带回家，这样就不会浪费。
Cài méiyǒu chī wán de shíhou, xiàng fúwùyuán yào yíge dǎbāohé, bǎ cài zhuāngjìnqù dàihuíjiā, zhèyàng jiù búhuì làngfèi.
When you haven't finished the food, you ask the waiter for a takeaway box, put the food in and take it home so it isn't wasted.

q: “夹”这个动作怎么用？请举一个例子。
"jiā"zhège dòngzuò zěnme yòng? Qǐngjǔ yíge lìzi.
How is the verb 夹 used? Give an example.
ans: 用筷子或者别的工具把东西夹起来，比如“用筷子把菜夹到碗里”。
Yòng kuàizi huòzhě biéde gōngjù bǎ dōngxi jiāqǐlái, bǐrú "yòng kuàizi bǎ cài jiā dào wǎn lǐ".
It means picking something up by gripping it with chopsticks or another tool, e.g. 用筷子把菜夹到碗里.

q: 手上有油的时候，他怎么办？
Shǒushàng yǒuyóu de shíhou, tā zěnmebàn?
What does he do when his hands are oily?
ans: 他把湿纸巾的包装撕开，拿出湿纸巾，把手上的油擦干净，还擦了擦嘴巴。
Tā bǎ shīzhǐjīn de bāozhuāng sīkāi, náchū shīzhǐjīn, bǎ shǒushàng de yóu cā gānjìng, hái cā le cā zuǐba.
He tears open the wet wipe packet, takes one out, wipes the oil off his hands and also wipes his mouth.
